papers.title: Monolithic hybrid quantum dot devices in superconducting twisted bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: Gate-tunable superconductivity in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG) has enabled the realization of superconducting devices, such as Josephson junctions, within a single crystal. This interface-free platform provides a reconfigurable and scalable architecture that overcomes limitations of conventional superconducting-semiconducting systems. Incorporating single-electron control enables access to regimes in which flat-band superconductivity competes with strong Coulomb repulsion, providing a platform for studying correlated physics phenomena. Here, we report a new class of quantum devices that combines electrostatic confinement with tunable superconductivity in a monolithic MATBG architecture. Within a single device, we demonstrate two complementary hybrid systems: superconducting islands and proximitized quantum dots. The superconducting island exhibits $2e$-periodic transport, indicating a well-defined gap protected against quasiparticle poisoning. The proximitized quantum dot hosts subgap Andreev states together with a strongly parity-modulated supercurrent.

papers.title: Quantum geometrical description of hole spin qubits far away from the $Γ$-point
papers.abstract: Hole spin qubits provide one of the leading platforms for spin-based quantum computing due to their large intrinsic spin-orbit interaction (SOI), which enables fast electrical manipulation. The SOI of planar quantum dots has mostly been investigated in theoretical studies by examining the SOI already present in the two-dimensional hole gas (2DHG). Here, we study the SOI created by the in-plane confinement by deriving non-perturbative effective Hamiltonians numerically for hole spin qubits. We find that the quantum geometry of the 2DHG naturally emerges, leading to a meaningful non-perturbative definition of pseudospin valid far away from the $Γ$-point. The SOI of the 2DHG and of the in-plane confinement have different forms; therefore, they cannot be turned off simultaneously, ruining the perfect spin-orbit switch functionality of spin qubits. We construct effective Hamiltonians using the symmetry approach for various low-dimensional hole systems: (i) a heavy-hole confined in a SiGe/Ge/SiGe heterostructure, (ii) a light-hole confined in SnGe/Ge, (iii) a gate-defined nanowire in SiGe/Ge/SiGe, and (iv) a hole confined in a Ge/Si core/shell nanowire. The non-perturbative effective Hamiltonians provide results with excellent agreement with the full Hamiltonians.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：deriving non-perturbative effective Hamiltonians numerically、symmetry approach。；研究对象：空穴自旋量子比特，具体包括四种低维空穴系统：(i) SiGe/Ge/SiGe异质结中的重空穴，(ii) SnGe/Ge中的轻空穴，(iii) SiGe/Ge/SiGe中的栅极定义纳米线，(iv) Ge/Si核壳纳米线中的空穴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维空穴气的量子几何自然涌现，给出了远离Γ点仍有效的非微扰赝自旋定义；二维空穴气自旋轨道耦合与面内限制产生的自旋轨道耦合形式不同，无法同时关闭，破坏了自旋量子比特的完美自旋-轨道开关功能。

papers.title: Interfacial mass transfer resistance at fluid-fluid interfaces
papers.abstract: Complex chemistry in nano- and microscale compartments is often governed by how quickly reagents transit a fluid-fluid interface. Mass transport across interfaces is commonly modeled by assuming local equilibrium, enforcing continuity of chemical potential across the interface. While adequate at large scales, this approximation may break down at the microscale, where interfacial processes can become rate-limiting. Here, we extend linear irreversible thermodynamics to describe nonequilibrium interfacial mass transport. We identify an interface-limited regime, in which transport is governed by interfacial resistance and exhibits exponential relaxation. Combining microfluidic and spectroscopic techniques, we introduce an experimental technique that explores this regime and provides a direct measurement of the interfacial mass transfer coefficient. For a model system consisting of acetonitrile transport across a surfactant-stabilized water-oil interface, we obtain an interfacial transport coefficient ${M \sim 7\,{\rm nm/s}}$. These results establish interfacial mass transfer resistance as a governing mechanism in microscale transport and provide a framework to predict, control and measure mass transport in multiphase systems at microscale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论推导 + 实验测量）。关键词：线性不可逆热力学（理论）、微流控与光谱技术（实验）。；研究对象：流体-流体界面处的质量传输过程，具体为表面活性剂稳定的水-油界面上的乙腈跨界面输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在微尺度下，界面质量传输受界面阻力控制，表现出指数弛豫行为，并测得界面传输系数约为 7 nm/s。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在微尺度下，界面质量传输受界面阻力控制，表现出指数弛豫行为，并测得界面传输系数约为 7 nm/s。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：扩展线性不可逆热力学描述非平衡界面质量传输，识别出界面受限区域。实验方面：结合微流控与光谱技术，直接测量界面质量传输系数。

papers.title: Percolation of a rod-like particle in a static bed of spheres: trapping and passing
papers.abstract: We numerically investigate percolation of independent frictionless glued-sphere rod-like particles under gravity through a disordered static bed of larger spheres. We identify two distinct regimes: a \emph{trapping} regime, where rods stop after percolating a limited distance in the bed and a \emph{passing} regime, where rods percolate continuously with constant mean velocity. The transition between these regimes is governed by the length of the rod and the geometrical trapping threshold for spherical particles based on the rod diameter and the minimum pore throat diameter defined by three touching large spheres. The percolation velocity for all rod geometries, including the single sphere limit, collapses onto a single curve when scaled with the gravitational acceleration and the bed sphere diameter. The results also demonstrate that short rods percolate nearly twice as fast as long rods due to the geometric constraints associated with the disordered pore structure of the static bed. Consequently, long rods are more susceptible to trapping via specific contact configurations with the bed spheres, which differ from those for short rods. These results reveal how shape anisotropy introduces dynamical constraints and thresholds in granular percolation, with implications for predicting segregation in mixtures of non-spherical particles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：numerically investigate、glued-sphere rod-like particles、disordered static bed）；研究对象：棒状颗粒在静态球体床层中的渗透行为（具体为无摩擦、胶合球构成的棒状颗粒在重力作用下通过无序大球床层的渗透、捕获与通过现象）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 棒状颗粒在球体床层中存在“捕获”与“通过”两种截然不同的渗透状态，其转变由棒长与基于棒径及最小孔喉直径的几何捕获阈值共同决定；短棒渗透速度约为长棒的两倍，长棒更易因特定接触构型而被捕获。

papers.title: Generic long-range correlations in nonequilibrium mixtures
papers.abstract: We study correlation functions in generic non-equilibrium mixtures, including multi-temperature systems and non-reciprocal field theories. The corresponding linear theory is short-ranged, and nonlinearities are irrelevant in the renormalization-group sense. Nonetheless, we find that these nonlinearities generate long-ranged three-point correlations in the isotropic disordered phase. Our analytical predictions, which are based on a phenomenological theory, are confirmed by numerical simulations of Brownian colloids in contact with thermal baths at different temperatures. Dangerously irrelevant nonlinearities in non-equilibrium mixtures thus offer a new route to long-range correlations, supporting the hypothesis that such correlations are not the exception but the rule out of equilibrium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“基于唯象理论的分析预测”以及“通过布朗胶体数值模拟确认”。；研究对象：非平衡混合体系中的长程关联现象，具体包括多温度系统和不可逆场论中的无序相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非平衡混合体系中，即使线性理论是短程的且非线性项在重整化群意义下是“危险无关”的，这些非线性项仍能在各向同性无序相中产生长程的三点关联函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非平衡混合体系中，即使线性理论是短程的且非线性项在重整化群意义下是“危险无关”的，这些非线性项仍能在各向同性无序相中产生长程的三点关联函数。；创新点：揭示了非平衡混合体系中“危险无关非线性项”可作为产生长程关联的新机制，支持了“长程关联在非平衡体系中是常态而非例外”的假设。
papers.method_zh: 采用唯象理论进行解析分析，并结合布朗胶体在不同温度热浴中的数值模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Open Wilson chain numerical renormalization group approach to steady-state non-equilibrium quantum transport
papers.abstract: The numerical renormalization group (NRG) approach was developed to identify and quantify different equilibrium regimes of quantum impurity systems (QISs) with unprecedented accuracy by a tailored finite size representation. Out of equilibrium, the steady-state density operator is not of the Boltzmannian form but one that is determined by the imposed boundary conditions. We extend the NRG to the nonequilibrium setting by augmenting each Wilson site with a reservoir, whose coupling functions are calculated via a continuous fraction expansion in order to recover the continuum limit exactly. The nonequilibrium parameters such as a finite bias as well as a finite temperature gradient enters through the Bloch-Redfield tensor (BRT), whose zero eigenvector gives the steady-state density operator. We used the resulting open chain full density matrix (OC-FDM) approach with an effective single lead description to investigate the charge and spin transport through a quantum dot (QD) under finite bias and temperature gradient. The influence of lead asymmetry and an external magnetic field on the transport properties are also studied. For completeness, we have also investigated local properties of the QD, such as charge fluctuations and find excellent agreement with real-time quantum Monte Carlo (RT-QMC) data. The OC-FDM approach was able to explore Kondo energy scales as low as $T_K/D \approx 10^{-8}$ in the non-equilibrium regime, as well as show convergence with the established equilibrium benchmarks, such as a quantitative agreement with full density matrix numerical renormalization group (FDM-NRG) and Fermi-liquid scaling at small bias and temperature. Owing to the effective single lead description, a single OC-FDM data point takes orders of magnitude less time on a standard laptop, compared to other state-of-the-art numerical methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerical renormalization group (NRG)、steady-state density operator、Bloch-Redfield tensor、full density matrix。；研究对象：非平衡稳态下的量子杂质系统（QIS），具体为有限偏压和温度梯度下的量子点（QD）中的电荷与自旋输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将每个Wilson位点附加一个储库并利用连续分数展开精确恢复连续极限，成功将数值重整化群（NRG）扩展至非平衡稳态，实现了对极低近藤能标（\(T_K/D \approx 10^{-8}\)）的探索，并与平衡基准（如FDM-NRG和费米液体标度）定量吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将每个Wilson位点附加一个储库并利用连续分数展开精确恢复连续极限，成功将数值重整化群（NRG）扩展至非平衡稳态，实现了对极低近藤能标（\(T_K/D \approx 10^{-8}\)）的探索，并与平衡基准（如FDM-NRG和费米液体标度）定量吻合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 提出了开放威尔逊链全密度矩阵（OC-FDM）方法，结合有效单引线描述。核心步骤包括：为每个Wilson位点附加储库，通过连续分数展开计算耦合函数；利用Bloch-Redfield张量（BRT）的零本征矢量得到稳态密度算符。

papers.title: Lattice dynamics and the spectroscopic signatures of H-bond disorder in $δ$-AlOOH
papers.abstract: Raman and infrared anomalies associated with H-bond symmetrization in $δ$-AlOOH, including mode softening and linewidth broadening at 5-10 GPa, occur at significantly lower pressures than predicted by static harmonic theory. To resolve this discrepancy, we combine harmonic phonon calculations with strongly constrained and appropriately normed (SCAN)-based deep-potential molecular dynamics and phonon quasiparticle analysis at 300 K. This framework extracts temperature- and pressure-dependent frequencies and lifetimes from long-time trajectories, capturing the branch reorganization and rapid linewidth growth characteristic of the disordering regime. Incorporating quasiparticle renormalization and directional longitudinal-optical-transverse-optical (LO-TO) splitting further yields near-quantitative agreement with the ambient-pressure OH-stretching Raman multiplet. These results identify finite-temperature dynamical effects and the progressive loss of spectral coherence as the origin of the spectroscopic signatures of H-bond symmetrization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：harmonic phonon calculations、deep-potential molecular dynamics、phonon quasiparticle analysis）；研究对象：δ-AlOOH 中氢键无序化相关的晶格动力学及其光谱特征，特别是氢键对称化过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限温度动力学效应和光谱相干性的逐渐丧失是导致 δ-AlOOH 中氢键对称化光谱特征（如模式软化、线宽展宽）在远低于静态谐波理论预测压力下出现的原因。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限温度动力学效应和光谱相干性的逐渐丧失是导致 δ-AlOOH 中氢键对称化光谱特征（如模式软化、线宽展宽）在远低于静态谐波理论预测压力下出现的原因。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合谐波声子计算与基于强约束适当范数泛函（SCAN）的深度势分子动力学模拟，并在300K下进行声子准粒子分析，提取随温度和压力变化的频率与寿命，同时引入准粒子重整化和方向性LO-TO分裂。

papers.title: Tailoring the properties of YBa$_{2}$Cu$_{3}$O$_{7-δ}$ thin films by 30 keV He$^+$ irradiation: An enabling route to superconducting device nanopatterning
papers.abstract: Focused helium ion beam (He-FIB) irradiation with 30 keV ions is a key tool for nanoscale patterning and defect engineering in high transition temperature (Tc) cuprate superconducting devices, yet its usable fluence window is constrained by the competing requirements of reliable superconductivity suppression and minimal structural degradation. In this work, we provide a comprehensive dataset on the effects of large-area 30 keV He+ ion exposure on the electric transport and superconducting properties of epitaxial YBa2Cu3O7 (YBCO) thin films. X-ray diffraction shows a fluence-driven loss of crystalline order accompanied by an out-of-plane lattice expansion and an orthorhombic-to-tetragonal transition, culminating at predominant amorphization at the highest fluence of 1 x 10^16 cm^-2. Raman spectra exhibit increasing disorder while lacking signatures of oxygen depletion, indicating that irradiation mainly generates oxygen-related Frenkel defects rather than changing the carrier concentration. Consistently, with increasing fluence, the normal-state resistivity ρ_N(T) at temperature T above Tc increases strongly, while d ρ_N/d T remains nearly unchanged at moderate fluence. The suppression of Tc is accurately described by Abrikosov-Gor'kov pair breaking and reaches complete quenching of superconductivity at 4.5 x 10^15 cm^-2. The anisotropic upper critical fields decrease approximately exponentially with increasing fluence, the vortex activation energy is reduced, and the anisotropy drops, in contrast to oxygen-depleted YBCO. Hall-angle analysis confirms a nearly constant carrier density but a systematic increase in defect scattering and reduced mobility, consistent with a crossover toward the dirty limit at high fluence. These results establish quantitative fluence thresholds and a practical operational window for He-FIB nanopatterning of YBCO quantum circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了X射线衍射、拉曼光谱、电输运测量等具体实验手段，并提供了系统的实验数据。；研究对象：YBa₂Cu₃O₇（YBCO）高温超导薄膜，具体研究30 keV He⁺离子辐照对其电输运和超导性质的影响，以及该技术在超导器件纳米图案化中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 30 keV He⁺离子辐照通过产生氧相关的弗仑克尔缺陷而非改变载流子浓度，有效抑制超导电性，并在4.5×10¹⁵ cm⁻²的注量下完全淬灭超导；同时建立了可用于He-FIB纳米图案化的定量注量阈值和实用操作窗口。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：30 keV He⁺离子辐照通过产生氧相关的弗仑克尔缺陷而非改变载流子浓度，有效抑制超导电性，并在4.5×10¹⁵ cm⁻²的注量下完全淬灭超导；同时建立了可用于He-FIB纳米图案化的定量注量阈值和实用操作窗口。；创新点：提供了30 keV He⁺离子辐照YBCO薄膜的全面、定量数据集，明确了辐照诱导的缺陷类型（氧弗仑克尔缺陷而非氧缺失），并建立了与氧缺失YBCO不同的各向异性演化行为，为He-FIB纳米图案化YBCO量子电路提供了实用的注量窗口和物理依据。

papers.title: On the physical meaning of latent track boundaries in swift heavy ion irradiated polymers
papers.abstract: A large body of experimental studies of swift heavy ion latent tracks in dielectric materials has produced a wide range of estimates of track size. We investigate the physical meaning of these estimates by examining the different criteria of track boundary probed by various experimental techniques, including SAXS, XRD, chemical etching and conductometry. We show that different methods probe different physical aspects of ion induced modification, such as electron density redistribution, molecular ordering, chemical reactivity and charge separation, resulting in different determinations of effective track boundaries. Particular attention is paid to polymer films with electret-like properties, where post irradiation redistribution of weakly bound electrons may play an important role in the evolution of latent track structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experimental studies、experimental techniques、SAXS、XRD、chemical etching、conductometry）；研究对象：快重离子在聚合物中产生的潜径迹（latent tracks），特别是具有驻极体性质的聚合物薄膜中潜径迹的边界结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不同实验技术（如SAXS、XRD、化学刻蚀和电导测量）探测的是离子辐照诱导改性的不同物理方面（电子密度重分布、分子有序性、化学反应活性和电荷分离），因此会得到不同的有效径迹边界尺寸估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不同实验技术（如SAXS、XRD、化学刻蚀和电导测量）探测的是离子辐照诱导改性的不同物理方面（电子密度重分布、分子有序性、化学反应活性和电荷分离），因此会得到不同的有效径迹边界尺寸估计。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 综合分析了多种实验技术对潜径迹边界的探测结果，包括小角X射线散射（SAXS）、X射线衍射（XRD）、化学刻蚀和电导测量（conductometry），并特别关注了具有驻极体性质的聚合物薄膜中弱束缚电子的后辐照重分布效应。

papers.title: First-principles calculations of internal conversion processes in spin defects
papers.abstract: Optically active spin defects are foundational for quantum technologies, yet common approximations underestimate their internal conversion (IC) rates by orders of magnitude. We propose a broad, predictive framework to compute IC rates that incorporates multi-configurational effects via many-body wavefunctions in TDDFT, and includes all-phonon-mode contributions via analytical non-adiabatic couplings. Our approach resolves discrepancies with experiment, achieving quantitative agreement for the NV$^-$ center in diamond, and identifying a previously overlooked non-radiative channel in the divacancy triplet lifetime in SiC.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“First-principles calculations”、“TDDFT”、“analytical non-adiabatic couplings”。；研究对象：光学活性自旋缺陷中的内转换（IC）过程，具体材料包括金刚石中的NV⁻色心和碳化硅（SiC）中的双空位缺陷。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种新的计算框架，能够准确预测自旋缺陷的内转换速率，解决了以往理论低估IC速率数个数量级的问题，并发现了SiC双空位三重态中一个此前被忽视的非辐射通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种新的计算框架，能够准确预测自旋缺陷的内转换速率，解决了以往理论低估IC速率数个数量级的问题，并发现了SiC双空位三重态中一个此前被忽视的非辐射通道。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其创新在于：1）将多组态效应与全声子模式贡献结合，构建了普适性的IC速率计算框架；2）首次实现了与NV⁻中心实验的定量吻合，并揭示了SiC双空位中新的非辐射弛豫路径。
papers.method_zh: 基于含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）的多体波函数来包含多组态效应，并通过解析非绝热耦合计算所有声子模式的贡献。

papers.title: Bacterial adhesion to curved surfaces in fluid flow
papers.abstract: Minimising bacterial surface adhesion and subsequent biofilm formation in industrial and medical settings requires understanding how bacteria are transported and adhere to complex surface geometries in the presence of non-uniform flow. In this paper, we consider the transport of a dilute suspension of motile bacteria through a corrugated two-dimensional channel with perfectly adhesive walls. We asymptotically analyse the diffusive boundary layer that forms in high velocity flows using a curvilinear coordinate system based on the fluid streamfunction, presenting a similarity solution to the diffusivity-varying diffusion-type equation that arises. From this solution, we derive an analytical expression for the bacterial adhesion rate as a function of surface arclength and the spatially varying wall shear rate. Our model predicts that bacterial adhesion becomes localised on curved surfaces, with bacteria showing preferential adhesion to wall `peaks' at lower shear rates and preferential adhesion to wall `valleys' at higher shear rates. More broadly, our results highlight how spatially varying flows generated by complex geometries can lead to localised bacterial adhesion, with potential implications for both enhancing and minimising biofilm formation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：asymptotically analyse、similarity solution、analytical expression、model predicts。；研究对象：细菌在流体流动中对弯曲表面的粘附行为，具体为在非均匀流场中，运动细菌通过波纹状二维通道时的输运与粘附。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 细菌在弯曲表面上的粘附具有局域化特征：在低剪切速率下，细菌优先粘附于壁面“峰”处；在高剪切速率下，则优先粘附于壁面“谷”处。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：细菌在弯曲表面上的粘附具有局域化特征：在低剪切速率下，细菌优先粘附于壁面“峰”处；在高剪切速率下，则优先粘附于壁面“谷”处。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于流体流函数的曲线坐标系，对高速流动中形成的扩散边界层进行渐近分析，求解变扩散系数扩散型方程的相似解，并推导出细菌粘附率作为表面弧长和空间变化壁面剪切速率的解析表达式。

papers.title: Boltzmann-Like Occupation of Nonequilibrium Steady States on Dense Networks
papers.abstract: A central problem in statistical physics is to extend the Boltzmann distribution to nonequilibrium steady states (NESS). We prove that NESS on large dense networks have Boltzmann-like occupation despite extensive entropy production. We further show that the active-matter heuristic of "low rattling" is asymptotically exact. Intuitively, these NESS spend a greater fraction of their time in states they leave more slowly. This explanation extends to the broader class of "equiaccessible" steady states, which play a role in our analysis akin to that of equilibrium in linear response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：prove（证明）、heuristic（启发式方法）、analysis（分析）。；研究对象：非平衡稳态（nonequilibrium steady states, NESS）在稠密网络（dense networks）上的占据行为，以及与之相关的“低抖动”（low rattling）活性物质启发式方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在大型稠密网络上，尽管存在广泛的熵产生，非平衡稳态仍具有类似玻尔兹曼分布的占据行为；同时证明了活性物质中的“低抖动”启发式方法是渐近精确的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在大型稠密网络上，尽管存在广泛的熵产生，非平衡稳态仍具有类似玻尔兹曼分布的占据行为；同时证明了活性物质中的“低抖动”启发式方法是渐近精确的。；创新点：将玻尔兹曼分布的思想推广到非平衡稳态，并严格证明了在稠密网络条件下该近似的有效性；揭示了非平衡稳态占据行为的直观机制——系统在离开较慢的状态上花费更多时间，并建立了与“等可达稳态”这一更广泛类别的联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数学证明。具体框架包括：基于网络结构的统计力学分析，引入“等可达稳态”（equiaccessible steady states）概念，类比平衡态线性响应理论进行分析。

papers.title: Extending Covariant Fluctuation Theorems into Quantum Regime through Quasiprobability Approach
papers.abstract: The covariant formulation of stochastic thermodynamics requires treating the stochastic work as a 4-vector, posing significant challenges for quantum systems due to the non-commutativity. We introduce a new quasiprobability distribution for the work 4-vector, which combines the Wigner and Margenau-Hill quasiprobabilities. This extends the covariant fluctuation theorems from classical to quantum regime. We illustrate our findings with a scalar field driven by classical particles with a generalized version of trace formula. Our work establishes a quasiprobability approach to studying relativistic quantum thermodynamics in a covariant way.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“引入新的准概率分布”、“扩展协方差涨落定理”、“建立准概率方法”，属于理论推导与框架构建。；研究对象：相对论量子热力学中的协方差涨落定理，具体涉及由经典粒子驱动的标量场体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合Wigner和Margenau-Hill准概率分布，提出了一种新的功4-矢量的准概率分布，从而将协方差涨落定理从经典领域扩展到量子领域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合Wigner和Margenau-Hill准概率分布，提出了一种新的功4-矢量的准概率分布，从而将协方差涨落定理从经典领域扩展到量子领域。；创新点：首次通过准概率分布的方式，在量子体系中实现了对功4-矢量的协方差处理，从而克服了量子非对易性带来的挑战，将协方差涨落定理从经典推广到量子领域。
papers.method_zh: 采用准概率方法（quasiprobability approach），具体结合了Wigner准概率分布与Margenau-Hill准概率分布，并利用广义版本的迹公式（trace formula）进行理论推导与验证。

papers.title: Spin-orbit coupling by design in quantum state engineering of atomically defined quantum dots
papers.abstract: Tuning spin-orbit coupling is essential in controlling both spin and charge in confined semiconductor nanostructures, yet it is rarely a truly controllable parameter. Here, we show control over the spin-orbit Hamiltonian in quantum dots and the resulting quantum states by tailoring the confinement potential with atomic-scale precision. Using scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy, we pattern individual Cs ions into designer quantum dot structures on the surface of indium antimonide, in which electrons from a two-dimensional electron gas are confined with chosen in-plane electric-field gradients. We then quantify the atomic level structure, both spatially resolving the orbital character of the electronic states and their magnetic-field evolution. We demonstrate that the level structure, including the induced zero-field splitting, can be tailored by the designed geometry of the local electric fields. These effects can be described using a Hamiltonian that allows consistent treatment of the confinement-induced spin-orbit coupling beyond the conventional Bychkov-Rashba description. This Hamiltonian is derived from a multiband k.p model and takes the energy dependence of the relevant physical parameters into account. Such precise control of spin-orbit coupling in semiconductor quantum dots is relevant to quantum and spintronic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy、patterning individual Cs ions、spatially resolving orbital character）；研究对象：在锑化铟（InSb）表面通过原子级精度图案化铯（Cs）离子构建的量子点结构，以及其中二维电子气电子的自旋-轨道耦合与量子态调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过原子级精度设计量子点的限制势，可以调控自旋-轨道哈密顿量，包括诱导的零场分裂，且这种效应可通过局域电场的几何结构进行裁剪，超越了传统的Bychkov-Rashba描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过原子级精度设计量子点的限制势，可以调控自旋-轨道哈密顿量，包括诱导的零场分裂，且这种效应可通过局域电场的几何结构进行裁剪，超越了传统的Bychkov-Rashba描述。；创新点：实现了对半导体量子点中自旋-轨道耦合的原子级精确设计控制，并提出了一个超越传统Bychkov-Rashba模型的哈密顿量框架，该框架能一致地处理限制诱导的自旋-轨道耦合。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM）与扫描隧道谱（STS）技术，结合多带k·p模型推导的哈密顿量（考虑了相关物理参数的能量依赖性）。

papers.title: Generic nonlocal statistics of the stationary measure in conserved active systems
papers.abstract: The stationary measure of equilibrium systems with detailed balance follows a Boltzmann distribution, so that for short-ranged interactions the measure is local, meaning that distant spatial domains are statistically independent. In contrast, active systems break detailed balance, and can have nonlocal stationary measure even for fully local dynamics. Here, by expanding in nonlinearity about a Gaussian-model limit, we construct the measure perturbatively deep in the disordered phase for a class of models that includes Active Model A, Active Model B+, Model AB, the Nonreciprocal Cahn--Hilliard model, and the Toner--Tu model. In this regime, nonlocality is linked to a dynamical conservation law. Our results generically preclude construction of a Landau--Ginzburg expansion of the stationary measure (as opposed to the dynamical equations) for conserved active field theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“construct the measure perturbatively”（微扰构建测度）、“expand in nonlinearity”（非线性展开）等理论分析手段，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：守恒活性系统（conserved active systems）的稳态测度（stationary measure）的非局域统计性质。具体模型包括Active Model A、Active Model B+、Model AB、Nonreciprocal Cahn–Hilliard模型以及Toner–Tu模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无序相（disordered phase）中，即使动力学是完全局域的，活性系统的稳态测度也可以是非局域的，即远距离空间域在统计上不独立。这种非局域性与动力学守恒律（dynamical conservation law）相关联，并且该结果普遍排除了对守恒活性场论稳态测度进行Landau–Ginzburg展开的可能性（与动力学方程不同）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无序相（disordered phase）中，即使动力学是完全局域的，活性系统的稳态测度也可以是非局域的，即远距离空间域在统计上不独立。这种非局域性与动力学守恒律（dynamical conservation law）相关联，并且该结果普遍排除了对守恒活性场论稳态测度进行Landau–Ginzburg展开的可能性（与动力学方程不同）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 以高斯模型为极限，围绕非线性项进行微扰展开（perturbative expansion in nonlinearity about a Gaussian-model limit），在无序相深处构建稳态测度的解析表达式。

papers.title: On-chip superconducting GHz RF reflectometry of the capacitance response in bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: In dual-gated bilayer graphene, a perpendicular displacement field opens a band gap that modifies both the channel conductance and the electronic compressibility, motivating measurements that resolve resistive and capacitive responses on the same device. We integrate an hBN-encapsulated bilayer graphene heterostructure with an on-chip superconducting Nb lumped-element LC resonator and carry out RF reflectometry near 4.25 GHz. DC transport and finite-bias spectroscopy on the same device provide a transport reference. Top and bottom gates independently set the carrier density and displacement field. The DC and RF gate maps share the same gate-dependent features, with finite-bias measurements revealing a region of suppressed conductance whose bias extent grows with the displacement field, consistent with a field-induced gap. The gate-dependent resonance-frequency shift is converted to the effective capacitance seen by the resonator using an equivalent-circuit model. The capacitance shows a minimum near the conductance-suppressed region, consistent with reduced electronic compressibility in the gapped bilayer graphene, and exhibits an electron-hole asymmetry. The on-chip configuration probes the gate-dependent admittance of a dual-gated van der Waals heterostructure, providing capacitance-sensitive information that complements DC transport within a single device.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“集成”、“进行RF反射测量”、“DC输运和有限偏压谱学”等实验操作和测量手段。；研究对象：双栅极双层石墨烯（bilayer graphene）异质结。具体研究了在垂直位移场作用下，该体系打开的能带隙对沟道电导和电子压缩率（电容响应）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过片上超导射频反射计，成功测量了双层石墨烯在位移场诱导能隙区域的电容响应，发现该区域的电容最小，与能隙中电子压缩率降低的预期一致，并观察到电子-空穴不对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过片上超导射频反射计，成功测量了双层石墨烯在位移场诱导能隙区域的电容响应，发现该区域的电容最小，与能隙中电子压缩率降低的预期一致，并观察到电子-空穴不对称性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于：在同一器件上，利用片上超导谐振器在GHz频率下，实现了对双栅极范德华异质结电容响应的灵敏探测，从而将电容信息（反映电子压缩率）与传统的直流输运信息（反映电导）互补地结合起来。

papers.title: SmoQyElPhQMC.jl: An open-source Julia package for efficient and scalable quantum Monte Carlo simulations of electron-phonon coupled models
papers.abstract: We introduce version 1.0 of the SmoQyElPhQMC package, an open-source Julia code for performing scalable quantum Monte Carlo simulations of electron-phonon coupled model Hamiltonians. SmoQyElPhQMC is built upon the SmoQyDQMC codebase and implements improved versions of the algorithms presented in [B. Cohen-Stead \textit{et al}., Phys. Rev. E {\bf 105}, 065302 (2022)] to enable linear-scaling simulations of a broad class of uncorrelated $e$-ph models both in system size and inverse temperature. By extending the functionality of the flexible scripting interface introduced in SmoQyDQMC, the SmoQyElPhQMC package continues to allow users to adapt it to different workflows and interface with other software packages in the Julia ecosystem. The code for this package can be downloaded from our GitHub repository at https://github.com/SmoQySuite/SmoQyElPhQMC.jl or installed using the Julia package manager. The online documentation, including examples, can be obtained from our documentation page at https://smoqysuite.github.io/SmoQyElPhQMC.jl/stable/.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：open-source Julia package、quantum Monte Carlo simulations、algorithms。；研究对象：电子-声子耦合模型哈密顿量（electron-phonon coupled model Hamiltonians），具体为无关联电子-声子模型（uncorrelated e-ph models）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍软件包的功能与性能：实现了线性标度（linear-scaling）的量子蒙特卡洛模拟，可高效处理大系统尺寸和低温（大逆温度）下的电子-声子耦合模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍软件包的功能与性能：实现了线性标度（linear-scaling）的量子蒙特卡洛模拟，可高效处理大系统尺寸和低温（大逆温度）下的电子-声子耦合模型。；创新点：在SmoQyDQMC的灵活脚本接口基础上，扩展了针对电子-声子耦合模型的高效模拟能力，并实现了线性标度算法，同时保持与Julia生态系统中其他软件包的互操作性。
papers.method_zh: 基于SmoQyDQMC代码库，采用改进的量子蒙特卡洛算法（improved versions of the algorithms presented in [B. Cohen-Stead et al., Phys. Rev. E 105, 065302 (2022)]），实现系统尺寸和逆温度的双重线性标度模拟。

papers.title: Strain- and doping-tunable optical resonance in Kekulé-Y graphene
papers.abstract: We investigate the optical response of Kekulé-Y graphene under uniaxial strain and carrier doping. Using a low-energy effective Hamiltonian, we show that strain reshapes the low-energy electronic structure of the Kekulé-Y phase and induces Van Hove singularities at energies well below those of pristine graphene. Within the Kubo formalism, we calculate the optical conductivity and identify multiple anisotropic interband features, with a pronounced resonance arising from strain-induced Van Hove singularities. The pronounced resonance is strongly anisotropic and robust against moderate thermal broadening and disorder, providing a clear optical signature of Kekulé-Y ordering. We further derive analytical expressions for the low-energy optical conductivity and the Drude weight, providing a detailed characterization of the strain- and doping-dependent optical response. Our results establish strain engineering as an effective route for controlling valley-dependent optical properties in Kekulé-Y graphene, originating from the Kekulé-induced coupling of the Dirac valleys, and suggest feasible optical probes for the experimental identification of the Kekulé-Y phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：使用低能有效哈密顿量、Kubo公式计算光学电导率、推导解析表达式。；研究对象：Kekulé-Y 石墨烯在单轴应变和载流子掺杂下的光学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 应变在Kekulé-Y石墨烯中诱导出能量远低于原始石墨烯的范霍夫奇点，从而产生强各向异性的光学共振，该共振对热展宽和无序具有鲁棒性，可作为Kekulé-Y相的光学特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：应变在Kekulé-Y石墨烯中诱导出能量远低于原始石墨烯的范霍夫奇点，从而产生强各向异性的光学共振，该共振对热展宽和无序具有鲁棒性，可作为Kekulé-Y相的光学特征。；创新点：揭示了应变工程作为调控Kekulé-Y石墨烯谷依赖光学性质的有效途径，并提出了实验上识别Kekulé-Y相的可行光学探测手段。
papers.method_zh: 低能有效哈密顿量建模、Kubo公式计算光学电导率、解析推导低能光学电导率和Drude权重。

papers.title: Modifying Electrochemical Doping in Light-Emitting Electrochemical Cells with Gold Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Electrochemical doping offers dynamic control of the electronic properties of organic semiconductors, and it is the enabling feature of a range of technologies, including electrochemical transistors, energy-storage devices, light-emitting electrochemical cells (LECs), and bioelectronics. Electrochemical doping is commonly controlled by the selection of the constituents in the active material of the device or the applied voltage bias, but herein we report that the incorporation of Au nanoparticles (Au-NPs) at an electrode interface can constitute an alternative control parameter. The LEC features balanced p- and n-type electrochemical doping that forms a p-n junction doping structure in its active material, and we find that it is possible to reshape this doping profile by incorporating Au-NPs at an electrode interface. Specifically, we establish that the inclusion of neat non-capped Au-NPs at the anodic interface shifts the p-n junction (i.e., the emission zone) away from the anode. In contrast, the inclusion of Au-NPs capped with sodium citrate is found to reverse this behavior, so that the emission zone is instead moved towards the anode. We utilize this control parameter to shift the emission zone towards a position of constructive (destructive) interference, as manifested in a strong increase (decrease) of the LEC emission efficiency. Our findings establish an interfacial strategy for modulating the spatial profile of electrochemical doping and tuning device performance without altering the chemistry of the active material, relying instead on the surface modification of one electrode. This approach is important because it provides a versatile and minimally invasive route to optimize electrochemical devices while preserving the intrinsic properties and formulation of the active material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：incorporation of Au nanoparticles、LEC features、we establish、we utilize。；研究对象：基于有机半导体的发光电化学池（LEC），具体研究金纳米颗粒（Au-NPs）在电极界面处对电化学掺杂空间分布的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在LEC的阳极界面引入无配体金纳米颗粒可使p-n结（即发光区）远离阳极，而引入柠檬酸钠包覆的金纳米颗粒则使发光区移向阳极；通过调控发光区位置可显著增强或减弱器件发光效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在LEC的阳极界面引入无配体金纳米颗粒可使p-n结（即发光区）远离阳极，而引入柠檬酸钠包覆的金纳米颗粒则使发光区移向阳极；通过调控发光区位置可显著增强或减弱器件发光效率。；创新点：提出了一种不改变活性材料化学组成，仅通过电极界面修饰（引入金纳米颗粒）来调控电化学掺杂空间分布的新策略，为优化电化学器件性能提供了一种非侵入性的新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备了含金纳米颗粒的LEC器件，对比了无配体金纳米颗粒与柠檬酸钠包覆金纳米颗粒两种界面修饰方式，通过测量发光区位置变化和器件发光效率来表征电化学掺杂轮廓的调控效果。

papers.title: Local Coverage Governs Memorization in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Memorization in diffusion models is often treated as a global property of the model or dataset. In practice, however, a single diffusion model can simultaneously generate both memorized and novel samples. Which training samples are most likely to be memorized? In this work, we show that memorization is governed by \emph{local data coverage}. Leveraging the connection between diffusion models and kernel density estimation (KDE), we derive a theoretical criterion that predicts whether a point is memorized based on the density of training data in its neighborhood and the size of the training dataset. In the high-dimensional limit, this leads to a sharp, local transition: regions of low coverage are dominated by isolated training samples, which are memorized, while dense regions support interpolation and generalization. We validate these predictions empirically, showing that memorization increases with local sparsity and that diffusion models exhibit a coexistence of memorized and novel samples within the same model. Extending this framework to multi-class settings, we further show that classes with higher intra-class sparsity (and thus lower local coverage) are more strongly memorized. Our results provide a local view of memorization in diffusion models, explaining when and where memorization occurs in terms of data geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验验证）。判断依据：推导理论判据（theoretical criterion）、高维极限分析（high-dimensional limit）、并结合实证验证（validate empirically）。；研究对象：扩散模型（diffusion models）中的记忆化现象（memorization），具体研究训练样本在何种局部数据覆盖条件下会被模型记忆，而非生成新颖样本。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 记忆化由局部数据覆盖（local data coverage）决定：在训练数据稀疏的局部区域，孤立样本易被记忆；在数据密集区域，模型倾向于插值与泛化，生成新颖样本。同一模型可同时产生记忆化与新颖样本。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：记忆化由局部数据覆盖（local data coverage）决定：在训练数据稀疏的局部区域，孤立样本易被记忆；在数据密集区域，模型倾向于插值与泛化，生成新颖样本。同一模型可同时产生记忆化与新颖样本。；创新点：将记忆化从全局属性重新定义为局部几何属性，揭示了同一模型内记忆化与泛化共存的内在机制，并建立了基于数据几何的“何时何处发生记忆化”的定量解释。
papers.method_zh: 利用扩散模型与核密度估计（Kernel Density Estimation, KDE）之间的理论联系，推导出基于邻域训练数据密度与数据集大小的记忆化理论判据；在高维极限下得到尖锐的局部相变条件；并在多类设置中通过实证验证局部稀疏性与记忆化强度的关系。

papers.title: The Future of Computing for Materials Science Challenges
papers.abstract: Materials discovery increasingly relies on the coordinated use of theory, computation, experiment, data-driven methods, and emerging quantum technologies, yet the full potential of these tools is realised only when they operate within workflows that reflect the complexity of real systems. This perspective summarises current capabilities, limitations, and opportunities across these domains, drawing on contributions from academia, industry, and national laboratories to identify the scientific and structural requirements for more reliable and efficient discovery. Classical simulations provide broad coverage across design spaces, while experimental measurements reveal degradation, heterogeneity, and kinetic processes that determine performance under realistic conditions. Machine learning accelerates exploration when supported by well-curated datasets with clear provenance and uncertainty quantification, and quantum computing offers promising routes into correlated electronic behaviour when aligned with properties that influence engineering decisions. Collectively, these insights highlight the need for reproducible workflows, shared data standards, realistic benchmarks, and a research culture that prepares scientists to work across paradigms. By integrating these methodological and organisational elements, the community can move toward discovery processes that deliver robust predictions, support confident decision making, and shorten the path from conceptual design to deployable materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（观点/展望文章）。判断依据：关键词为“perspective”（观点）、“summarises current capabilities, limitations, and opportunities”（总结当前能力、局限与机遇）、“drawing on contributions from academia, industry, and national laboratories”（综合学术界、工业界和国家实验室的贡献）。；研究对象：材料科学中的计算与发现流程。具体涉及：经典模拟、实验测量、机器学习、量子计算等多种方法在材料发现中的应用与整合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 材料发现需要将理论、计算、实验、数据驱动方法和量子技术整合到反映真实系统复杂性的工作流中，才能实现更可靠和高效的发现。当前的关键需求包括可重复的工作流、共享数据标准、现实的基准测试以及跨范式的研究文化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：材料发现需要将理论、计算、实验、数据驱动方法和量子技术整合到反映真实系统复杂性的工作流中，才能实现更可靠和高效的发现。当前的关键需求包括可重复的工作流、共享数据标准、现实的基准测试以及跨范式的研究文化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的单一技术突破，其创新点在于从系统性和组织性层面，综合分析了不同方法论（经典、实验、机器学习、量子计算）在材料发现中的协同作用与瓶颈，并提出了实现更高效、更可靠发现流程所需的科学和结构性要求（如工作流标准化、数据溯源、不确定性量化等）。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的研究方法，而是对以下领域的现状进行了综述性分析：经典模拟（Classical simulations）、实验测量（experimental measurements）、机器学习（Machine learning）、量子计算（Quantum computing）。摘要未提及具体的计算框架（如DFT+U、DMRG）或实验技术（如ARPES、分子束外延）。

papers.title: Multistate Manipulation of Charge-Spin Conversion in Two-Dimensional Ferroelectric Bilayers
papers.abstract: Achieving nonvolatile and multistate manipulation of charge-spin conversion, including the Edelstein effect (EE) and spin Hall effect (SHE), is crucial for high-density spintronic memory. Here, we propose a mechanism to simultaneously control both EE and SHE in two-dimensional ferroelectric bilayers, where interlayer-parallel and interlayer-antiparallel polarization configurations can coexist. Symmetry analysis shows that in the interlayer-parallel states, reversal of the total polarization switches the sign of the EE, whereas changing to an interlayer-antiparallel configuration suppresses the EE to zero, enabling electrically switchable current-induced spin accumulation among three distinct states, which could be used for ternary logic operations. Meanwhile, the magnitude of the SHE can be tuned by switching between two different classes of polarization configurations, namely interlayer-parallel and interlayer-antiparallel configurations. Using first-principles calculations, we demonstrate this mechanism in bilayer metallic ferroelectric PtBi2, where both interlayer-parallel and interlayer-antiparallel polarization configurations are energetically stable. The EE coefficient in interlayer-parallel states, which can be reversed by polarization switching, arises from competing electron- and hole-pocket contributions near the Fermi surface. The intrinsic SHE coefficients originate from spin Berry curvature that can be reshaped by polarization configuration variation and Fermi-level tuning. Our results establish ferroelectric bilayers as an all-in-one platform for electrically programmable charge-spin conversion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章（关键词：symmetry analysis, first-principles calculations, spin Berry curvature）；研究对象：二维铁电双层材料中的电荷-自旋转换现象，包括Edelstein效应（EE）和自旋霍尔效应（SHE），具体材料为双层金属铁电体PtBi₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维铁电双层中，通过切换层间平行与反平行极化构型，可实现Edelstein效应的三态电控开关（正、负、零），同时自旋霍尔效应的强度可在层间平行与反平行构型之间调节，从而实现多态非易失性电荷-自旋转换操控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维铁电双层中，通过切换层间平行与反平行极化构型，可实现Edelstein效应的三态电控开关（正、负、零），同时自旋霍尔效应的强度可在层间平行与反平行构型之间调节，从而实现多态非易失性电荷-自旋转换操控。；创新点：提出在单一二维铁电双层材料中同时电控Edelstein效应和自旋霍尔效应，并利用层间平行与反平行极化构型的共存实现三态（而非传统两态）操控，为三元逻辑运算提供了物理基础。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（symmetry analysis）与第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体计算了EE系数和本征SHE系数（源于自旋贝里曲率）。

papers.title: Bond-operator analytical approach for the $t$-$J$ model
papers.abstract: We present a bond-operator theory (BOT) for analytical consideration of the $t$-$J$ model and its extensions with longer-rage hopping terms. This technique is based on previously suggested representation of electron operators via localized spins 1/2 and spinless Fermi-operators of mobile holons which requires no constraint between them. We introduce a representation of operators of spins, holons, and electrons in (extended) unit cell containing several lattice sites via a zoo of Bose- and Fermi-operators acting in the Hilbert space of all quantum states of the whole unit cell. BOT provides a regular expansion of physical quantities in powers of $1/n$ using conventional diagrammatic technique, where $n\ge1$ is the maximum number of introduced quasiparticles (bosons and fermions) which can occupy a unit cell. The suggested representation reproduces commutation algebra of all operators at any $n>0$ and allows to consider both magnetically ordered and disordered phases. Some elementary excitations described in the BOT by separate bosons or fermions appear in common approaches as bound states of conventional quasiparticles. In particular, there are two-hole bound states (Cooper pairs of two holes) which are described within the BOT by separate bosons. We discuss in detail properties of the $t$-$J$ model on the square lattice with no more than two holes (polarons). Although the expansion parameter $1/n$ is not small in the physically meaningful case of $n=1$, we obtain a good quantitative agreement with previous numerical findings at $n=1$ even in the first order in $1/n$ after taking into account a few simple diagrams. Self-consistent calculations in the first order in $1/n$ bring our results to a very good quantitative agreement with previous numerical findings of the ground state energy, staggered magnetization, and spectra of magnons, polarons, and lowest-energy two-hole bound states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：bond-operator theory、analytical consideration、diagrammatic technique、self-consistent calculations。；研究对象：$t$-$J$ 模型及其包含长程跳迁项的扩展模型，具体讨论了正方晶格上不超过两个空穴（极化子）的情形。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该文提出的键算符理论（BOT）在 $1/n$ 展开的一阶近似下，即使对于物理上有意义的 $n=1$ 情况（此时展开参数 $1/n$ 并不小），仍能通过考虑少数简单图得到与先前数值结果定量一致的结果；自洽计算进一步使基态能量、交错磁化强度以及磁振子、极化子和最低能双空穴束缚态的谱与数值结果高度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该文提出的键算符理论（BOT）在 $1/n$ 展开的一阶近似下，即使对于物理上有意义的 $n=1$ 情况（此时展开参数 $1/n$ 并不小），仍能通过考虑少数简单图得到与先前数值结果定量一致的结果；自洽计算进一步使基态能量、交错磁化强度以及磁振子、极化子和最低能双空穴束缚态的谱与数值结果高度吻合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于键算符理论（BOT），将电子算符表示为局域自旋1/2算符和无自旋费米子空穴算符（holons），并在包含多个格点的（扩展）原胞中引入玻色子和费米子算符的集合，利用常规的费曼图技术在 $1/n$ 展开下对物理量进行系统展开。

papers.title: Spherical metadensity functional learning for inhomogeneous classical fluids
papers.abstract: We develop classical density functional learning to address fluids with truncated pairwise interparticle interactions in three-dimensional spherical geometry. Simulation data for systems with randomized repulsive pair potentials provide the basis for supervised training of a neural metadensity functional, thereby making efficient use of results for radial distribution functions in the bulk fluid via the test particle route. Specifically, we develop spherical local learning in order to represent the one-body direct correlation functional in terms of a neural network, which captures spatial curvature effects as well as the metadensity functional dependence on the thermally scaled pair potential. The framework yields efficient access to inhomogeneous structuring and related physical phenomena that occur in fluids and general solvents when adsorbed against curved solutes and confined inside of spherical and planar cavities. Test particle setups facilitate accurate prediction of the bulk fluid pair structure and verification of thermodynamic test particle sum rules via functional line integration. Applying the metadensity functional for Henderson inversion allows one to infer accurately the pair potential from the bulk radial distribution function. We address implications of the geometrical setup for two-body quantities and obtain the two-body direct correlation functional from automatic differentiation. For the hard sphere fluid, we confirm metadensity functional predictions against results from a standard neural density functional with fixed pair potential as well as to an analytic functional as given by fundamental measure theory. Simulation results provide further reference and corroborate reliable results of the spherical neural metadensity functional across a broad range of applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：classical density functional learning、neural metadensity functional、supervised training、automatic differentiation。；研究对象：非均匀经典流体，具体为具有截断成对相互作用的流体在三维球对称几何中的结构，以及硬球流体等模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种球对称元密度泛函学习方法，能够高效预测非均匀流体的结构，并可从体相径向分布函数精确反推成对相互作用势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种球对称元密度泛函学习方法，能够高效预测非均匀流体的结构，并可从体相径向分布函数精确反推成对相互作用势。；创新点：将元密度泛函学习扩展到三维球对称几何，通过球对称局域学习表示一体直接关联泛函，从而捕捉空间曲率效应以及元密度泛函对热标度成对势的依赖关系。摘要未突出说明与已有神经网络密度泛函在架构或训练策略上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用经典密度泛函学习框架，基于随机排斥成对势的模拟数据，通过测试粒子路线利用体相径向分布函数进行监督训练；构建神经网络元密度泛函，并利用自动微分获取两体直接关联泛函。

papers.title: Modeling light-matter coupled systems with neural quantum states
papers.abstract: Recent advances in cold atom manipulation enable the study of many-body systems where short-range interactions between neighboring atoms coexist with long-range interactions mediated by photons. Such a combination of interactions makes a theoretical approach challenging beyond mean-field methods. In this work, we develop a neural quantum state based approach to study these systems numerically. We introduce a neural-network architecture capable of handling hybrid Hilbert spaces with large local bosonic dimensions in strongly interacting spin-photon systems. We benchmark this approach on a model of a two-dimensional lattice of Rydberg atoms coupled to a photon mode. The superradiant ground states found in the large spin-photon coupling regime allow us to demonstrate the efficiency of the method in the presence of high photon occupation. Furthermore, the ability to capture spin-spin and spin-photon correlations leads us to observe quantitative deviations in the ground state phase boundaries with respect to mean-field theory. The method extends to other systems with a similar hybrid Hilbert space structure, such as spin-phonon systems, and provides a scalable framework for investigating their ground state properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：neural quantum state based approach（基于神经量子态的方法）、numerically（数值地）、benchmark（基准测试）。；研究对象：光-物质耦合系统，具体为二维里德伯原子晶格与一个光子模式耦合的模型。该系统同时存在原子间的短程相互作用和光子介导的长程相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强自旋-光子耦合区域，该方法成功捕捉到了超辐射基态，并发现基态相边界与平均场理论存在定量偏差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强自旋-光子耦合区域，该方法成功捕捉到了超辐射基态，并发现基态相边界与平均场理论存在定量偏差。；创新点：提出了一种可扩展的、基于神经网络的数值框架，用于研究具有混合希尔伯特空间结构（如自旋-光子、自旋-声子系统）的强关联多体系统，超越了平均场方法的局限性。摘要未突出说明与具体变分蒙特卡洛方法（如VMC）或特定神经网络结构（如RBM、Transformer）的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于神经量子态（Neural Quantum State, NQS）的数值方法。具体引入了一种能够处理混合希尔伯特空间（自旋+光子）且支持大局域玻色子维度（高光子占据数）的神经网络架构。

papers.title: Mass-imbalanced two-dimensional Bose-Fermi mixtures with boson-fermion pairing
papers.abstract: We analyze a two-dimensional Bose-Fermi mixture at zero temperature in the presence of a tunable Bose-Fermi attraction. We adopt a diagrammatic T-matrix approach and study the behavior of several thermodynamic quantities for the two species as functions of density, mass ratio, and coupling strength. These include the chemical potentials, the boson momentum distribution function, the condensate density, and Tan's contact parameter. We analytically demonstrate that the present T-matrix formalism recovers the correct second-order perturbative expansion of the chemical potentials in the weak-coupling regime, and test it numerically. The near-universal behavior already found in prior work for the mass-balanced case is confirmed for different masses and becomes even more accurate when the boson mass is large. The mass imbalance emerges as an additional control parameter that qualitatively affects the bosonic momentum distribution. In particular, we found that it can be used to allow for the experimental observation of a peculiar peak in the boson momentum distribution at finite momentum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：diagrammatic T-matrix approach（图解T矩阵方法）、analytically demonstrate（解析证明）、numerically test（数值检验）。；研究对象：二维玻色-费米混合体系，在零温下存在可调玻色-费米吸引相互作用，且考虑质量不平衡（即玻色子与费米子质量不同）的情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 质量不平衡可作为额外调控参数，定性改变玻色子动量分布，特别是可在有限动量处产生一个独特的峰，有利于实验观测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：质量不平衡可作为额外调控参数，定性改变玻色子动量分布，特别是可在有限动量处产生一个独特的峰，有利于实验观测。；创新点：将先前质量平衡情况下的近普适行为推广到不同质量比，发现当玻色子质量较大时该普适行为更精确；揭示了质量不平衡作为新调控参数对玻色子动量分布定性影响，并指出其可用于实验观测有限动量处的特征峰。
papers.method_zh: 采用图解T矩阵方法（diagrammatic T-matrix approach），解析推导了弱耦合下化学势的二阶微扰展开，并进行数值验证；分析了化学势、玻色子动量分布函数、凝聚密度和Tan接触参数随密度、质量比和耦合强度的变化。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Bounds from Otto--Villani Functional Inequalities
papers.abstract: The dissipation in the relaxation of an ensemble of conservative stochastic systems towards the steady state is quantified by the free energy difference. Functional inequalities within the framework of [F. Otto and C. Villani, J. Funct. Anal. 173, 361 (2000)] are here revisited which connect the free energy dynamics and optimal transport, offering a geometric perspective on the instantaneous speed of relaxation in the presence of potential barriers. These are illustrated with numerical relaxation experiments on Landau-Ginzburg potentials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“functional inequalities”、“geometric perspective”等理论框架，并进行了数值实验（numerical relaxation experiments），但未涉及具体实验手段或大规模计算。；研究对象：保守随机系统（conservative stochastic systems）在势垒存在下的弛豫过程，具体以Landau-Ginzburg势为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Otto-Villani泛函不等式框架，建立了自由能动力学与最优输运之间的联系，从而从几何角度量化了系统在势垒存在下的瞬时弛豫速度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Otto-Villani泛函不等式框架，建立了自由能动力学与最优输运之间的联系，从而从几何角度量化了系统在势垒存在下的瞬时弛豫速度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Otto与Villani（2000年）提出的泛函不等式理论框架，结合自由能差与最优输运理论，并通过Landau-Ginzburg势的数值弛豫实验进行验证。

papers.title: Thinning-by-spinning: shear rheology of dense chiral fluids
papers.abstract: We investigate the linear and nonlinear rheology of dense chiral fluids composed of self-spinning particles under external shear. Using particle-based simulations of a two-dimensional Lennard-Jones model with transverse interactions, we show that chirality acts as an intrinsic source of fluctuations and shear. In the solid regime, spinning fluidizes the system, weakening hexatic order. In the liquid regime, the viscosity is quantitatively described by a Green-Kubo relation upon replacing the temperature by a chirality-dependent effective temperature. Beyond linear response, flow curves collapse when expressed in terms of the ratio between imposed shear and spinning rates, revealing a thinning-by-spinning mechanism. At large forcing, this correspondence breaks down and a pronounced handedness asymmetry emerges: when transverse interactions oppose the imposed shear, stresses relax through the formation of string-like flow channels. Our results identify chirality as a generic mechanism for fluidization and provide a unified framework for understanding the rheology of dense chiral suspensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：particle-based simulations、two-dimensional Lennard-Jones model）；研究对象：由自旋粒子组成的致密手性流体在外加剪切作用下的流变学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 手性可作为内在的波动与剪切源，导致系统在固态区发生流化、在液态区粘度由手性依赖的有效温度通过Green-Kubo关系描述；在非线性响应中，流变曲线可通过外加剪切与自旋速率之比进行标度，揭示出“自旋致稀”机制，并在大驱动力下出现手性不对称的应力弛豫通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：手性可作为内在的波动与剪切源，导致系统在固态区发生流化、在液态区粘度由手性依赖的有效温度通过Green-Kubo关系描述；在非线性响应中，流变曲线可通过外加剪切与自旋速率之比进行标度，揭示出“自旋致稀”机制，并在大驱动力下出现手性不对称的应力弛豫通道。；创新点：首次将手性识别为一种通用的流化机制，并建立了致密手性悬浮液流变学的统一框架；发现了“自旋致稀”现象及手性不对称导致的串状流动通道。
papers.method_zh: 基于二维Lennard-Jones模型并引入横向相互作用的粒子模拟，分析线性与非线性流变学，使用Green-Kubo关系计算粘度，并引入有效温度概念。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Framework for $q$-Affinity
papers.abstract: We develop a thermodynamic framework for non-equilibrium affinities based on generalized entropies. In particular, we extend the classical concept of De Donder by introducing $q$-affinities associated with Rényi and Tsallis entropies. This in turn allows us to generalize thermodynamic driving forces to systems with long-range interactions and/or strong correlations. For Rényi entropy, we build on a thermodynamic interpretation due to Baez, where the entropy is expressed through finite differences of the Helmholtz free energy at two temperatures. This leads to a generalized thermodynamic potential whose derivative with respect to a reaction coordinate defines the Rényi $q$-affinity. The resulting expression admits a representation in terms of exponential work averages, establishing a connection to Jarzynski-type fluctuation relations. For Tsallis entropy, we consider Markov jump processes using a master-equation-based approach. We derive a $q$-deformed entropy balance law and obtain an explicit expression for the Tsallis entropy production rate, proving its non-negativity and thus recovering a generalized second-law structure. This allows to identify a local stochastic $q$-affinity with the generalized thermodynamic force entering the entropy production rate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamic framework、generalized entropies、master-equation-based approach。；研究对象：非平衡热力学中的亲和力（affinity）概念，特别是针对具有长程相互作用和/或强关联的系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于Rényi熵和Tsallis熵，将经典De Donder亲和力推广为q-亲和力，从而将热力学驱动力推广到非广延系统；对于Tsallis熵，推导了q-形变熵平衡律和熵产生率，证明了其非负性，恢复了广义第二定律结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于Rényi熵和Tsallis熵，将经典De Donder亲和力推广为q-亲和力，从而将热力学驱动力推广到非广延系统；对于Tsallis熵，推导了q-形变熵平衡律和熵产生率，证明了其非负性，恢复了广义第二定律结构。；创新点：将经典De Donder亲和力概念推广到非广延统计力学框架，建立了q-亲和力与Jarzynski型涨落关系以及广义第二定律的联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于广义熵（Rényi熵和Tsallis熵）的热力学形式；对于Rényi熵，采用Baez的热力学诠释，通过两个温度下亥姆霍兹自由能的有限差分表达熵；对于Tsallis熵，采用主方程方法处理马尔可夫跳跃过程。

papers.title: Pronounced in-plane anomalous Hall effect with vanishing out-of-plane response in Cr1.2Te2
papers.abstract: We report an unconventional anomalous Hall regime in the van der Waals ferromagnet Cr1.2Te2, in which the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) is present for in-plane magnetization but absent for out-of-plane magnetization. In this purely in-plane regime, the anomalous Hall signal exhibits a threefold angular dependence during both in-plane and out-of-plane rotations of the magnetization, which cannot be accounted for by the conventional dipolar contribution but instead requires an octupolar contribution. Although the octupolar term qualitatively captures the observed behavior, the experimentally extracted octupole differs quantitatively from first-principles calculations based solely on the intrinsic Berry-curvature mechanism, indicating an essential role for extrinsic scattering processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：report, experimentally extracted, first-principles calculations 作为辅助对比）；研究对象：范德华铁磁体 Cr1.2Te2 中的反常霍尔效应（AHE）及其与磁化方向的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Cr1.2Te2 中观测到一种非常规的反常霍尔效应：当磁化方向在面内时存在明显的反常霍尔信号，而当磁化方向垂直于面时该信号消失。该面内反常霍尔效应具有三倍角依赖关系，不能用传统的偶极贡献解释，而需要引入八极贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Cr1.2Te2 中观测到一种非常规的反常霍尔效应：当磁化方向在面内时存在明显的反常霍尔信号，而当磁化方向垂直于面时该信号消失。该面内反常霍尔效应具有三倍角依赖关系，不能用传统的偶极贡献解释，而需要引入八极贡献。；创新点：发现了在单一材料中仅存在面内反常霍尔效应而面外响应为零的奇特输运现象，并指出其物理起源需要超越本征贝里曲率机制，考虑外在散射过程（如斜散射或侧跳）的贡献。摘要未突出说明该材料的具体生长或表征方法。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了不同磁化方向下的反常霍尔效应信号，包括面内和面外旋转过程中的角度依赖关系。实验数据与基于本征贝里曲率机制的第一性原理计算结果进行了定量对比。

papers.title: $p$-wave magnet and hedgehog-type Berry curvature in helimagnetic MnAu$_2$
papers.abstract: Recently discovered altermagnetism in collinear compensated magnets shows even-parity spin texture in momentum space. Beyond the collinear spin ordering, unique odd-parity spin textures emerge in noncollinear compensated magnets. The noncollinear candidates, however, remain unexplored toward a room-temperature metallic altermagnet. Here, we demonstrate that MnAu2 exhibits metallic p-wave magnetism and large spin splitting induced by helical spin ordering. By adapting the band-unfolding scheme based on the translation operators combined with spin rotations, first-principles calculations reveal an unconventional Fermi surface around the $\tilde{M}$-point composed of a single electron pocket with $p$-wave spin texture. Moreover, the spin twist in the helimagnet triggers topologically non-trivial hedgehog Berry curvature, which links to the nonlinear Hall effect and spin Hall effect. Considering the experimental T$_C$ = 335 to 370 K, MnAu$_2$ could establish itself as an ideal candidate for a room-temperature metallic $p$-wave magnet, promising for versatile spintronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（基于第一性原理计算和能带展开方法，结合理论分析）；研究对象：螺旋磁有序金属MnAu₂中的p波磁性与hedgehog型贝里曲率
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MnAu₂在室温附近（实验居里温度335–370 K）表现出由螺旋自旋序诱导的金属性p波磁性，并在费米面附近产生具有p波自旋纹理的单电子口袋，同时螺旋自旋扭转触发拓扑非平庸的hedgehog型贝里曲率，关联非线性霍尔效应和自旋霍尔效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MnAu₂在室温附近（实验居里温度335–370 K）表现出由螺旋自旋序诱导的金属性p波磁性，并在费米面附近产生具有p波自旋纹理的单电子口袋，同时螺旋自旋扭转触发拓扑非平庸的hedgehog型贝里曲率，关联非线性霍尔效应和自旋霍尔效应。；创新点：首次在非共线补偿磁体中（超越共线交替磁体）发现由螺旋自旋序驱动的奇宇称p波自旋纹理，并揭示其与hedgehog型贝里曲率的关联，且该材料具有室温工作潜力。
papers.method_zh: 基于平移算符与自旋旋转结合的能带展开方法（band-unfolding scheme），结合第一性原理计算（DFT）分析电子结构、费米面自旋纹理及贝里曲率拓扑性质。

papers.title: Spin mixing induced dynamics of spinor solitons in $F=1$ Bose Einstein condensates
papers.abstract: We explore soliton interactions in a homogeneous spinor $F=1$ Bose Einstein Condensate (BEC) in the presence of a magnetic field, focusing on dark bright dark and bright dark bright configurations. We investigate how these interactions depend on the phase differences among bright solitons and their influence during the dynamics. Our findings align with prior non spinor results, i.e., repulsion among in phase bright solitons and attraction among out of phase pairs in self repulsive atomic BECs. The potential bright soliton attraction, added to the short range repulsion of dark dark soliton interactions, can lead to bound states. However, we find that these bound states break in the presence of spinor interactions due to the particle exchange dynamics between the hyperfine states of the components. Additonally, we develop an effective classical model to describe the soliton dynamics, using a Lagrangian approach. The accuracy of the model is tested by comparing it against numerical simulations. Our results suggest that the proposed model captures the essential features of soliton behavior in the presence of spin interactions, and provides congruent soliton trajectories and interspecies particle exchange dynamics in most of the cases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：explore、investigate、develop an effective classical model、Lagrangian approach、numerical simulations）；研究对象：均匀自旋为1的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（F=1 BEC）中的孤子相互作用，具体关注暗-亮-暗（dark-bright-dark）和亮-暗-亮（bright-dark-bright）两种孤子构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋为1的BEC中，亮孤子间的相位依赖相互作用（同相排斥、反相吸引）与无自旋情况一致，但自旋相互作用导致的超精细态间粒子交换动力学会使原本可能形成的束缚态破裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋为1的BEC中，亮孤子间的相位依赖相互作用（同相排斥、反相吸引）与无自旋情况一致，但自旋相互作用导致的超精细态间粒子交换动力学会使原本可能形成的束缚态破裂。；创新点：首次在自旋为1的BEC中系统研究了自旋混合（spin mixing）对孤子束缚态稳定性的影响，揭示了粒子交换动力学如何破坏由亮孤子吸引与暗孤子短程排斥共同形成的束缚态。
papers.method_zh: 采用拉格朗日方法建立有效经典模型描述孤子动力学，并通过与数值模拟结果对比验证模型准确性。

papers.title: Vapor-to-glass preparation of biaxially aligned organic semiconductors
papers.abstract: Physical vapor deposition (PVD) provides a route to prepare highly stable and anisotropic organic glasses that are utilized in multi-layer structures such as organic light-emitting devices. While previous work has demonstrated that anisotropic glasses with uniaxial symmetry can be prepared by PVD, here, we prepare biaxially aligned glasses in which molecular orientation has a preferred in-plane direction. With the collective effect of the surface equilibration mechanism and template growth on an aligned substrate, macroscopic biaxial alignment is achieved in depositions as much as 180 K below the clearing point $T_{LC-iso}$ (and 50 K below the glass transition temperature $T_g$ ) with single-component disk-like (phenanthroperylene ester) and rod-like (itraconazole) mesogens. The preparation of biaxially aligned organic semiconductors adds a new dimension of structural control for vapor-deposited glasses and may enable polarized emission and in-plane control of charge mobility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：physical vapor deposition (PVD)、preparation、depositions、template growth。；研究对象：双轴取向的有机半导体玻璃，具体材料为单组分的盘状（phenanthroperylene ester）和棒状（itraconazole）介晶分子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过物理气相沉积（PVD）技术，在远低于清亮点（T_LC-iso）和玻璃化转变温度（T_g）的条件下，成功制备了具有宏观双轴取向的有机半导体玻璃，实现了分子取向在面内方向上的择优排列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过物理气相沉积（PVD）技术，在远低于清亮点（T_LC-iso）和玻璃化转变温度（T_g）的条件下，成功制备了具有宏观双轴取向的有机半导体玻璃，实现了分子取向在面内方向上的择优排列。；创新点：此前研究仅能制备具有单轴对称性的各向异性有机玻璃，本工作首次实现了双轴取向玻璃的制备，为气相沉积玻璃的结构控制增加了新的维度，有望实现偏振发射和面内载流子迁移率的调控。
papers.method_zh: 物理气相沉积（PVD）方法，结合表面平衡机制与在取向基底上的模板生长效应。

papers.title: Ferromagnetic Order of Reduced Magnetic Moments in a Frustrated Sawtooth Chain of the Magnetic Semiconductor ZnYb$_2$S$_4$
papers.abstract: In a sawtooth spin chain, competing nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor interactions suppress long-range order, yielding novel quantum states such as a spin-dimer singlet, 1/2 magnetization plateau, and spin contraction. Here, we investigate the magnetic properties of the orthorhombic semiconductor ZnYb$_2$S$_4$, in which Yb$^{3+}$ ions with an effective spin-1/2 form a sawtooth chain along the $b$-axis. The specific heat exhibits a sharp peak at ${T}_{\rm m}$ $=$ 1.4 K, at which the magnetic entropy $S_{\rm m}$ reaches only 27% of $R$ln2. This reduced $S_{\rm m}$ at $T_{\rm m}$ indicates the entropy release of the ground state doublet of Yb$^{3+}$ even for $T$ $>$ $T_{\rm m}$. The isothermal magnetization $M(B)$ at 0.28 K exhibits hysteresis for $\left|B\right| \leq 0.2$ T and increases monotonically for $B > 0.2$ T. The spontaneous magnetization is only 0.1 ${\it μ}_{\rm B}$$/$Yb, an order of magnitude smaller than that expected for the ground state doublet of Yb$^{3+}$. Moreover, in powder neutron diffraction measurements, no superlattice reflections due to antiferromagnetic order are observed for $T$ $<$ $T_{\rm m}$. Therefore, in the ground state, the Yb moments are ferromagnetically aligned, but their amplitude is reduced by magnetic frustration in the sawtooth Yb chain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“specific heat”（比热）、“isothermal magnetization”（等温磁化）、“powder neutron diffraction”（粉末中子衍射）等实验测量手段。；研究对象：正交晶系磁性半导体 ZnYb₂S₄，其中 Yb³⁺ 离子（有效自旋 1/2）沿 b 轴形成锯齿形链（sawtooth chain），研究其磁有序与磁挫败效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在基态下，Yb 磁矩呈现铁磁排列，但由于锯齿形链中的磁挫败，磁矩幅度被显著抑制，自发磁化强度仅为 0.1 μB/Yb，比 Yb³⁺ 基态双重态预期值小一个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在基态下，Yb 磁矩呈现铁磁排列，但由于锯齿形链中的磁挫败，磁矩幅度被显著抑制，自发磁化强度仅为 0.1 μB/Yb，比 Yb³⁺ 基态双重态预期值小一个数量级。；创新点：首次在锯齿形自旋链体系中观察到磁矩幅度被显著抑制的铁磁有序，揭示了磁挫败导致的自旋收缩效应，而非常见的自旋二聚体或 1/2 磁化平台态。
papers.method_zh: 比热测量（确定相变温度 Tm=1.4 K 及磁熵释放）、等温磁化测量（0.28 K 下观测磁滞回线与自发磁化）、粉末中子衍射（探测反铁磁超晶格反射）。

papers.title: Stochastic Thermodynamics on Time-Evolving Curved Spaces
papers.abstract: We construct stochastic thermodynamics of overdamped Langevin systems on nonrelaticvistic curved spaces with time-dependent metrics. The time dependence of the metric contributes to the energy balance by performing work on the kinetic energy, which is instantaneously dissipated as heat in the overdamped regime. This contribution makes our framework thermodynamically consistent so that entropy production satisfies the second law of thermodynamics. As a special case, when the metric evolves according to backward Ricci flow, the entropy balance exhibits a structure similar to Perelman's entropy functional. Our framework provides a way to quantify thermodynamic costs in dynamics on time-evolving spaces such as diffusion on membranes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct（构建）、framework（框架）、thermodynamically consistent（热力学一致）。；研究对象：时变弯曲空间上的过阻尼朗之万系统，具体涉及膜上扩散等动力学过程的热力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时变度规对动能做功，该功在过阻尼条件下瞬时耗散为热，从而保证熵产生满足热力学第二定律；当度规按反向Ricci流演化时，熵平衡结构类似于Perelman熵泛函。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：时变度规对动能做功，该功在过阻尼条件下瞬时耗散为热，从而保证熵产生满足热力学第二定律；当度规按反向Ricci流演化时，熵平衡结构类似于Perelman熵泛函。；创新点：首次将随机热力学推广到具有时变度规的弯曲空间，并揭示了与Ricci流和Perelman熵泛函之间的形式联系。
papers.method_zh: 基于非相对论性弯曲空间上的过阻尼朗之万动力学，构建随机热力学理论框架，分析时变度规对能量平衡和熵产生的影响。

papers.title: The Structure-tuning Magnetism in the Co(NbxTa1-x)2O6 Series
papers.abstract: Low dimensional quantum materials have been extensively studied within the physics community, among which Co2+ is one of the most popular magnetic ions to be embedded into the structural motif. CoNb2O6 and CoTa2O6 both have adopted an effective spin-1/2 state, with the former attracting enduring interest while the latter being rarely investigated. This difference can be attributed to their distinct crystal structures, not only in crystal systems, but more important, how the CoO6 octahedra are connected. We successfully merge these two compounds together and map out the doping limits. We find out Ta and Nb dopants modify the properties of the parent compounds in subtle but different ways and construct a magnetic phase diagram of the Co(NbxTa1-x)2O6 (0 < x < 1) series. In addition, our results suggest that Ta-doping may pave a way to strengthen the lower-dimensional quantum phenomena in CoNb2O6 before its crystal structure starts to melt down.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“mapping out the doping limits”“construct a magnetic phase diagram”等实验表征手段。；研究对象：Co(NbₓTa₁₋ₓ)₂O₆系列化合物，具体为CoNb₂O₆与CoTa₂O₆的固溶体，研究其晶体结构对磁性的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过掺杂Ta和Nb，可以以微妙但不同的方式调控母体化合物的性质，并构建了该系列化合物的磁相图；Ta掺杂可能在晶体结构开始崩塌前增强CoNb₂O₆中的低维量子现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过掺杂Ta和Nb，可以以微妙但不同的方式调控母体化合物的性质，并构建了该系列化合物的磁相图；Ta掺杂可能在晶体结构开始崩塌前增强CoNb₂O₆中的低维量子现象。；创新点：成功将CoNb₂O₆和CoTa₂O₆两种化合物融合为连续固溶体，并首次绘制了该系列的磁相图；揭示了Ta掺杂可能作为增强低维量子现象的新途径。
papers.method_zh: 通过合成Co(NbₓTa₁₋ₓ)₂O₆系列样品，系统研究掺杂浓度对晶体结构和磁性的影响，具体实验手段摘要未明确说明（如未提及XRD、磁化率测量等具体技术）。

papers.title: Fermi gas of polar molecules in the Pauli-blocked regime
papers.abstract: Quantum gases of polar molecules have recently emerged as a powerful platform for exploring exotic many-body dynamics and correlated quantum behavior. To achieve the full potential of this platform, the production of deeply degenerate quantum gases of molecules in arbitrary confinement geometries is necessary. Here, we successfully evaporate fermionic KRb molecules in both 3D and quasi-2D geometries to well below their Fermi temperatures utilizing dipolar collisions. As we evaporate deeper into degeneracy in both geometries, we enter the Pauli-blocked regime with polar molecules, which we independently confirm for the first time by measuring the Pauli suppression of elastic collisions. Moreover, the Pauli suppression of collisions contributes to the limitation of our final molecular temperature to about 25% of the Fermi temperature in both geometries, particularly limiting quasi-2D evaporation where the Pauli blockade drastically reduces an otherwise large elastic to inelastic scattering ratio. This work demonstrates the production of degenerate Fermi gases of polar molecules both in a 3D harmonic trap and in mono- and bi-layer 2D configurations. Further, our work explores the fundamental limits on evaporation of molecular Fermi gases set by the Pauli-exclusion principle, which could be overcome in the future by introducing distinguishable scattering partners.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：evaporate（蒸发）、measure（测量）、demonstrates（展示）。；研究对象：费米子极性分子（KRb分子）在泡利阻塞（Pauli-blocked）机制下的量子气体，包括三维（3D）和准二维（quasi-2D）几何约束中的简并费米气体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过偶极碰撞将KRb分子蒸发至远低于费米温度，首次独立测量到极性分子在泡利阻塞区域中弹性碰撞的泡利抑制效应，并发现该效应限制了最终分子温度约为费米温度的25%，尤其在准二维蒸发中显著降低了弹性与非弹性散射比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过偶极碰撞将KRb分子蒸发至远低于费米温度，首次独立测量到极性分子在泡利阻塞区域中弹性碰撞的泡利抑制效应，并发现该效应限制了最终分子温度约为费米温度的25%，尤其在准二维蒸发中显著降低了弹性与非弹性散射比。；创新点：首次在极性分子体系中实验证实泡利阻塞对弹性碰撞的抑制，并系统研究了泡利不相容原理对分子费米气体蒸发冷却的基本限制。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用蒸发冷却技术，利用偶极碰撞在三维谐振势阱和单层/双层二维构型中冷却费米子KRb分子；通过测量弹性碰撞的泡利抑制来独立确认进入泡利阻塞区域。

papers.title: Diffusion-driven autocatalytic dynamics on a sphere
papers.abstract: We study the collective dynamics of independent particles that diffuse outside a spherical surface, on which they are replicated with a prescribed catalytic rate. In spatial dimensions three and higher, the transient nature of diffusion creates the competition between autocatalytic and escape events, thus leading to a rich phase diagram between subcritical (extinction), critical (steady-state), and supercritical (growth) regimes at long times. The rotational symmetry of the domain and an explicit form of the single-particle diffusion propagator allow us to obtain the statistics of the population size (i.e., the number of particles). In this way, we analyze the mean population size, its variance and higher-order moments, as well as the full distribution. In particular, we obtain a fully explicit form of the distribution at long times and describe a slow, power-law approach to this steady-state limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study、theoretical analysis、obtain the statistics、distribution。；研究对象：在球面上扩散并受催化复制（autocatalytic replication）的独立粒子集体动力学系统，具体研究粒子数（种群大小）的统计行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三维及以上空间维度中，扩散的瞬态特性导致自催化与逃逸事件竞争，在长时间下呈现亚临界（灭绝）、临界（稳态）和超临界（增长）的丰富相图；并得到了长时间下种群大小分布的显式形式及其幂律趋近行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三维及以上空间维度中，扩散的瞬态特性导致自催化与逃逸事件竞争，在长时间下呈现亚临界（灭绝）、临界（稳态）和超临界（增长）的丰富相图；并得到了长时间下种群大小分布的显式形式及其幂律趋近行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用球对称性及单粒子扩散传播子的显式形式，解析推导种群大小的均值、方差、高阶矩及完整分布，并分析长时间极限下的稳态分布与趋近过程。

papers.title: Probing Structure and Ionic Transport in Molten Lithium Carbonate
papers.abstract: Li$_2$CO$_3$ (LC) is a cornerstone material for clean energy technologies, including high-temperature molten carbonate fuel cells, electrochemical carbon capture, and lithium-based batteries. However, capturing the complex, many-body interactions governing the structure and transport in LC in its molten state has remained a challenge, constrained by the computational cost of \textit{ab initio} methods and the accuracy limitations of classical force fields. To address this gap, we deploy equivariant graph-based machine learned interatomic potentials, specifically, the multi atomic cluster expansion (MACE) and neural equivariant interatomic potential (NequIP) architectures that are trained on melt-quench \textit{ab initio} molecular dynamics data. Our benchmarking demonstrates that MACE provides superior transferability and precision in predicting energies and forces compared to NequIP. Subsequently, we use the optimized MACE model to perform large-scale molecular dynamics simulations to probe the properties of molten LC. Besides describing the structural features, such as the dominant presence of C-O pair correlations under molten conditions, our MACE model reproduces experimentally-measured static structure factors and shear viscosity values. Further, our simulations indicate that Li transport in LC is fundamentally dominated by concerted motion, as evidenced by Haven's ratios being significantly below unity (0.20-0.40). Notably, we identify a temperature-driven transition from anisotropic (and highly concerted) Li transport, supported by persistent oxygen-centered Voronoi cages at 1000~K, to isotropic (and less concerted) diffusion at 1400~K. Thus, we provide fundamental insights into the structural and transport properties of molten LC and also demonstrate a robust and scalable framework for the accelerated design of molten salt electrolytes and ionic liquids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learned interatomic potentials、molecular dynamics simulations、ab initio molecular dynamics data。；研究对象：熔融碳酸锂（molten Li₂CO₃）的结构与离子输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 熔融Li₂CO₃中锂离子输运主要由协同运动主导（Haven比显著低于1，为0.20-0.40），且存在从1000 K时各向异性（高度协同）到1400 K时各向同性（协同性降低）的温度驱动转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：熔融Li₂CO₃中锂离子输运主要由协同运动主导（Haven比显著低于1，为0.20-0.40），且存在从1000 K时各向异性（高度协同）到1400 K时各向同性（协同性降低）的温度驱动转变。；创新点：首次将等变图神经网络机器学习势（MACE和NequIP）应用于熔融碳酸锂，克服了从头算方法计算成本高和经典力场精度不足的局限，并揭示了锂离子输运中温度驱动的协同运动机制转变。
papers.method_zh: 使用等变图神经网络机器学习原子间势（MACE和NequIP架构），基于熔融-淬火从头算分子动力学数据训练，并利用优化后的MACE模型进行大规模分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Interface-engineered oxidation-resistant wafer-level Tantalum-Tantalum thermocompression bonding for 3D integration of superconducting interconnects
papers.abstract: Wafer-level 3D integration of superconducting interconnects requires low-thermal budget bonding processes compatible with superconducting materials. Rapid native oxide formation on tantalum (Ta) surfaces limits low-temperature, low-pressure direct Ta-Ta thermocompression bonding. In this study, we develop an oxidation-resistant bonding process using an ultrathin Au passivation layer to suppress oxide formation during bonding. The engineered interface enables blanket Ta-Ta wafer bonding at 300 $^\circ$C under 4.93 bar, significantly reducing the bonding thermal budget and generation of $α$-Ta across the interface, which potentially improves coherence time as reported in literature. Structural and interfacial analyses confirm oxide suppression and continuous metallic bonding, having a bond strength of 169 MPa. This work demonstrates a low-temperature, low-pressure Ta-Ta thermocompression bonding strategy for scalable 3D superconducting interconnect integration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“develop an oxidation-resistant bonding process”、“Structural and interfacial analyses confirm”等实验过程与表征手段。；研究对象：钽-钽（Ta-Ta）热压键合工艺，用于超导互连的三维集成，具体涉及通过超薄金（Au）钝化层抑制钽表面氧化以实现低温低压键合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入超薄Au钝化层，成功实现了在300°C、4.93 bar条件下的晶圆级Ta-Ta热压键合，有效抑制了界面氧化并获得了169 MPa的键合强度，为超导互连的三维集成提供了一种低热预算的键合策略。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入超薄Au钝化层，成功实现了在300°C、4.93 bar条件下的晶圆级Ta-Ta热压键合，有效抑制了界面氧化并获得了169 MPa的键合强度，为超导互连的三维集成提供了一种低热预算的键合策略。；创新点：利用超薄Au钝化层实现抗氧化Ta-Ta热压键合，显著降低了键合温度与压力（300°C、4.93 bar），并抑制了α-Ta相在界面的生成，从而有望提升超导器件的相干时间。
papers.method_zh: 采用超薄Au钝化层进行界面工程，在300°C、4.93 bar条件下进行晶圆级Ta-Ta热压键合，并通过结构分析与界面表征（如键合强度测试、界面形貌与成分分析）验证氧化抑制效果与金属键合连续性。

papers.title: Altermagnetism and bond-nematicity in the spin-$1/2$ square lattice $J_1-J_2-δ$ model
papers.abstract: We study appearance of bond-nematicity in insulating altermagnetic materials induced by increased frustration and quantum-fluctuations driven melting of the altermagnetic order. Using novel machine learning approach that combines symmetry enhanced neural network architectures and variational Monte Carlo we consider the spin-$1/2$ square lattice $J_1-J_2-δ$ model known to have altermagnetic ordering in the regime of small geometric frustration and a gapless spin liquid phase in the regime of strong frustration and small exchange interaction modulation parameter $δ$. In the regime where exchange modulation is relatively large, resulting in the significant splitting of the magnon modes with different chiralities in the altermagnetic regime, we find that melting of the altermagnetic order by increased frustration leads to an intriguing phase that hosts coexisting symmetry protected topological valence bond solid and bond-nematic orders. The phase is characterized by condensation of magnon pairs that results in bond-nematicity, breaking of U(1) spin rotation and $\mathbb{Z}_2$ spin inversion symmetries and chiral splitting of the triplon-like energy levels in the excitation spectrum. Whilst numerous recent studies address non-trivial impact of altermagnetic moments on various properties in altermagnetic materials, like electronic band structure and superconductivity, influence of strong quantum fluctuations and phases that can result from melting of the altermagnetic order are much less explored. Our study therefore presents an important step in identifying exotic phases of matter that can emerge in vicinity of the altermagnetic order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：机器学习方法、变分蒙特卡洛、对称增强神经网络架构。；研究对象：自旋-1/2 正方晶格 \( J_1-J_2-\delta \) 模型中的交变磁性与键向列相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交换调制参数 \(\delta\) 较大、交变磁序因几何阻挫增强而熔化时，系统进入一个共存有对称性保护拓扑价键固体和键向列序的新奇相，该相由磁振子对凝聚驱动，并伴随 U(1) 自旋旋转对称性和 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 自旋反转对称性的破缺。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交换调制参数 \(\delta\) 较大、交变磁序因几何阻挫增强而熔化时，系统进入一个共存有对称性保护拓扑价键固体和键向列序的新奇相，该相由磁振子对凝聚驱动，并伴随 U(1) 自旋旋转对称性和 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 自旋反转对称性的破缺。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用结合对称增强神经网络架构与变分蒙特卡洛的新型机器学习方法，对 \( J_1-J_2-\delta \) 模型进行数值研究。

papers.title: Field-selective criticality in 2D melting revealed by multi-field Lee-Yang zeros
papers.abstract: How a two-dimensional solid melts remains unsettled after 60 years of study, as theory, model systems, simulations, and atomic-resolution experiments continue to suggest conflicting scenarios. The same transition can appear continuous or abrupt depending on how it is observed, where this ambiguity is especially acute in confined water. Here we study bilayer water under nanoconfinement and ask not only where its phase boundaries lie, but how the system responds to the two fields that drive them: temperature and lateral pressure. Using Lee-Yang zeros together with enhanced sampling, we find that some phase boundaries are field-selective: the two responses can differ either in continuity itself, or in how strongly they are rounded in finite systems. This distinction changes the two-step melting picture. The solid--hexatic transition is field-selective first-order, with the density channel remaining unusually rounded, whereas the hexatic--liquid transition becomes a conventional first-order transition once larger cells reveal a hidden bimodal enthalpy distribution. This framework organizes the apparent disagreement among confined-water simulations, hard-disk models and AgI experiments by identifying which thermodynamic channel each probe sees.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用了Lee-Yang zeros理论框架与增强采样（enhanced sampling）计算方法。；研究对象：纳米限域下的双层水（bilayer water under nanoconfinement）的二维熔化相变，具体涉及固-六角相（solid-hexatic）与六角相-液相（hexatic-liquid）的相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维熔化中的某些相边界具有“场选择性”（field-selective）：系统对温度与侧向压力这两个驱动场的响应在连续性上可以不同，或在有限尺寸系统中被圆化的程度不同。这一发现改变了传统的两步熔化图像，并解释了受限水模拟、硬圆盘模型与AgI实验之间看似矛盾的结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维熔化中的某些相边界具有“场选择性”（field-selective）：系统对温度与侧向压力这两个驱动场的响应在连续性上可以不同，或在有限尺寸系统中被圆化的程度不同。这一发现改变了传统的两步熔化图像，并解释了受限水模拟、硬圆盘模型与AgI实验之间看似矛盾的结果。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Lee-Yang零点分析（multi-field Lee-Yang zeros）结合增强采样（enhanced sampling）技术，通过分析不同热力学通道（如密度通道、焓通道）的响应来区分相变的连续性与阶数。

papers.title: Topology-defined computation in knitted textiles
