papers.abstract: Mechanical computation, in which logic functions are realized through deformation rather than electronics, has been demonstrated in systems such as origami, kirigami, and mechanical metamaterials. In these systems, logic states and functions are typically determined by geometry and material properties, making it sensitive to deformation and imperfections. Here we introduce a mechanical computing architecture in which logic is defined by topology rather than geometry. The circuit is realized as a knitted textile formed from a single continuous yarn, where information is encoded in the topology of stitches and processed through controlled unraveling. By discretizing the textile into a lattice of interacting cells, we construct topological propagation rules that implement universal logic operations, including NOT, AND, and OR gates, as well as a half-adder. Experiments demonstrate that the logical output is robust against geometric deformation, while mechanical factors affect only if the computation can be executed. These results establish topology-defined computation as a model for information processing in textiles and other reconfigurable physical systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：Experiments demonstrate、knitted textile、controlled unraveling）；研究对象：基于编织纺织品的机械计算系统，具体为通过纱线拓扑结构（针法）实现逻辑运算的物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种由拓扑而非几何定义逻辑状态的机械计算架构，在编织纺织品中实现了NOT、AND、OR门及半加器，且逻辑输出对几何变形具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种由拓扑而非几何定义逻辑状态的机械计算架构，在编织纺织品中实现了NOT、AND、OR门及半加器，且逻辑输出对几何变形具有鲁棒性。；创新点：首次将机械计算的逻辑定义从几何/材料依赖转变为拓扑依赖，使逻辑状态对变形不敏感，并展示了在可重构物理系统（如纺织品）中实现信息处理的新范式。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用单根连续纱线编织成纺织品，通过控制纱线解编织过程实现信息处理；理论上将纺织品离散化为相互作用的晶格单元，构建拓扑传播规则以执行通用逻辑运算。

papers.title: General Theory for Ferroelectric Control of Spin Splitting in Collinear Antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Electrical control of magnetism is crucial for next-generation spintronics. While recent advances have demonstrated ferroelectric switching in two-dimensional magnets, a general design strategy spanning different dimensionalities remains elusive. Here, we develop a group-theoretical framework for achieving ferroelectric control of spin splitting in collinear antiferromagnets, including altermagnets and compensated ferrimagnets. By systematically classifying switching operators through symmetry analysis, we identify a universal pathway for the simultaneous reversal of electric polarization and nonrelativistic spin splitting.We validate this approach in three representative systems: quasi-one-dimensional $(6,14)$ Zigzag graphene nanoribbons, two-dimensional~\ch{Nb3I8}, and three-dimensional altermagnetic~\ch{MnSe2}. Our work establishes a versatile design paradigm for magnetoelectric devices and expands the functional landscape of low-power spintronic materials beyond the low-dimensional limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“group-theoretical framework”、“symmetry analysis”、“develop a... framework”。；研究对象：共线反铁磁体（包括交变磁体和补偿亚铁磁体）中自旋分裂的铁电控制，具体验证体系为准一维(6,14)锯齿形石墨烯纳米带、二维Nb₃I₈和三维交变磁体MnSe₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过对称性分析系统分类开关算符，识别出同时翻转电极化和非相对论性自旋分裂的普适路径，建立了跨越不同维度的铁电控制自旋分裂的通用设计策略。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过对称性分析系统分类开关算符，识别出同时翻转电极化和非相对论性自旋分裂的普适路径，建立了跨越不同维度的铁电控制自旋分裂的通用设计策略。；创新点：提出了一个跨越不同维度（从低维到三维）的通用设计范式，突破了以往仅局限于低维磁性材料中铁电开关的研究局限，为磁电器件提供了普适性设计策略。
papers.method_zh: 群论框架（对称性分析），通过分类开关算符推导普适路径，并在三个代表性体系（一维、二维、三维）中进行理论验证。

papers.title: Symmetry of the critical current function in superconducting nanodevices
papers.abstract: We study a variety of nano-scale superconducting devices containing more than one weak link. Even in devices with multiple weak links the IB symmetry is usually obeyed, which means that if we reverse both the bias current direction and the magnetic field direction at the same time, the superconducting response, namely the critical current, remains unchanged. We also provide a detailed analysis of the situations in which such symmetry is violated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：study, symmetry analysis, provide analysis）；研究对象：含多个弱连接的纳米尺度超导器件，以及其临界电流函数的对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在含多个弱连接的纳米超导器件中，通常仍满足IB对称性（即同时反转偏置电流方向和磁场方向时，临界电流保持不变），并详细分析了该对称性被破坏的情形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在含多个弱连接的纳米超导器件中，通常仍满足IB对称性（即同时反转偏置电流方向和磁场方向时，临界电流保持不变），并详细分析了该对称性被破坏的情形。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（基于IB对称性的理论推导与条件讨论），摘要未明确说明具体计算或实验手段。

papers.title: XRDiff: Crystal Structure Prediction from Powder X-Ray Diffraction Data Using Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Determining the crystal structure of a material from its powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) pattern is a central challenge in materials science. PXRD is an accessible and widely used characterization technique, yet recovering the atomic structure from diffraction data requires solving an underdetermined inverse problem due to the loss of phase information. Generative modeling can provide a prior over atomic structure and learn the mapping from PXRD patterns to crystal structures via simulated structure-spectrum pairs. We present XRDiff, a diffusion model that recovers crystal structures from PXRD given either the stoichiometry or, in a more challenging setting, the elemental constituents and total number of atoms in the unit cell. We evaluate on datasets where each stoichiometry has multiple polymorphs and all polymorphs of a given composition are held out together, ensuring that high performance reflects genuine use of the diffraction signal. XRDiff achieves strong structure recovery rates on simulated benchmarks, indicating that the model learns a spectrum-to-structure mapping precise enough to differentiate between polymorphs. To address generalization to experimental data, we compare a full-spectrum encoding against an encoding based on peak descriptors. The peak-based encoding generalizes substantially better, outperforming even a model trained on full spectra with augmentations fitted to the experimental noise distribution. These results demonstrate that representations robust to the noise and artifacts present in real-world PXRD offer a practical and scalable path toward closing the simulation-to-experiment gap, enabling zero-shot crystal structure solution from experimental PXRD with full or partial chemical composition input.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：generative modeling、diffusion model、simulated structure-spectrum pairs、simulated benchmarks）；研究对象：从粉末X射线衍射（PXRD）数据中恢复晶体结构，具体涉及具有多种多晶型（polymorphs）的化合物体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: XRDiff扩散模型能够从PXRD图谱中高精度恢复晶体结构，区分不同多晶型；基于峰描述符（peak descriptors）的编码方式相比全谱编码在实验数据上具有显著更好的泛化能力，有望弥合模拟与实验之间的差距。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：XRDiff扩散模型能够从PXRD图谱中高精度恢复晶体结构，区分不同多晶型；基于峰描述符（peak descriptors）的编码方式相比全谱编码在实验数据上具有显著更好的泛化能力，有望弥合模拟与实验之间的差距。；创新点：首次将扩散模型应用于从PXRD数据直接预测晶体结构，并系统研究了不同图谱表示方式对实验数据泛化能力的影响，发现基于峰描述符的编码能零样本（zero-shot）解决实验PXRD的结构解析问题。
papers.method_zh: 使用扩散模型（diffusion model）进行生成式建模，通过模拟结构-谱图配对数据训练模型，学习从PXRD图谱到晶体结构的映射。对比了全谱编码（full-spectrum encoding）与基于峰描述符的编码（peak-based encoding）两种表示方式，并测试了针对实验噪声分布的数据增强。

papers.title: Mean-field theory of myopic self-avoiding fractional Brownian motion
papers.abstract: Myopic self-avoiding fractional Brownian motion (FBM) is a stochastic process in which an ensemble of particles is driven by fractional Gaussian noise while being repelled by the gradient of the time-integrated ensemble density [J. House, R. Bakhshizada, S. Janušonis, R. Metzler, and T. Vojta, Phys. Rev. E 112, 034119 (2025)]. Depending on the anomalous diffusion exponent $α$ characterizing the noise, the process features two dynamical regimes: an interaction-dominated regime ($α< α_c=4/(d+2)$) where the mean-density interaction governs long-time dynamics, and a noise-dominated regime ($α> α_c$) where FBM correlations prevail. In the interaction-dominated regime, the mean-squared displacement grows as $\langle r^2(t) \rangle \sim t^{4/(d+2)}$ regardless of $α$, while for $α> α_c$ the standard FBM scaling $\langle r^2(t) \rangle \sim t^α$ is recovered. Here, we develop an analytical mean-field theory of myopic self-avoiding FBM, based on a Fokker-Planck approach to the interaction-dominated regime. This allows us to derive closed-form polynomial solutions for the probability density. To compare with computer simulations, we develop an efficient radial binning algorithm that significantly reduces the computational complexity, making large-scale three-dimensional simulations feasible. Extensive simulations in one, two, and three dimensions confirm the analytical predictions. We also discuss the application of the process to the self-organization of serotonergic axons (fibers) in vertebrate brains, where FBM paths with self-avoidance provide a natural framework for understanding spatial heterogeneities of fiber densities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：关键词“analytical mean-field theory”、“Fokker-Planck approach”、“computer simulations”、“extensive simulations”。；研究对象：近视自避分数布朗运动（myopic self-avoiding fractional Brownian motion, FBM）这一随机过程，及其在脊椎动物脑中血清素能轴突（纤维）自组织现象中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相互作用主导的动力学区域（α < α_c = 4/(d+2)），无论异常扩散指数α如何，均方位移均按〈r²(t)〉∼ t^{4/(d+2)} 增长；而在噪声主导区域（α > α_c），则恢复标准FBM标度〈r²(t)〉∼ t^α。基于Fokker-Planck方法推导出了概率密度的闭合多项式解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相互作用主导的动力学区域（α < α_c = 4/(d+2)），无论异常扩散指数α如何，均方位移均按〈r²(t)〉∼ t^{4/(d+2)} 增长；而在噪声主导区域（α > α_c），则恢复标准FBM标度〈r²(t)〉∼ t^α。基于Fokker-Planck方法推导出了概率密度的闭合多项式解。；创新点：首次为近视自避分数布朗运动建立了解析平均场理论，并推导出概率密度的闭合多项式解；同时开发了高效径向分箱算法，使大规模三维模拟成为可能。摘要未突出说明与已有平均场理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于Fokker-Planck方程的解析平均场理论，推导相互作用主导区域的概率密度闭合解；开发了高效的径向分箱算法（radial binning algorithm）以降低计算复杂度，并在1、2、3维空间中进行大规模计算机模拟验证。

papers.title: Oxygen deficiency and valency reconstruction in multiferroic V-doped HfO$_2$
papers.abstract: The interplay of oxygen deficiency and vanadium multiple valency in the candidate multiferroic V-doped $Pca2_1$ hafnia HfO$_2$ is studied by first-principles calculations. Low-lying V majority gap states accept electrons from oxygen-vacancy donors, reducing their formation energy, and converting nominal V$^{4+}$ centers into V$^{3+}$. The resulting local magnetization and screening changes are reflected in the calculated V core-level shifts, which are consistent with the experimentally observed XPS signatures. The calculated V$^{3+}$/V$^{4+}$ population ratio determined by oxygen vacancies only matches experiment in reducing conditions, suggesting that additional electron reservoirs may contribute under ALD growth conditions. A similar scenario also seems to apply to the recently observed multiferroicity in Cr-doped hafnia, where oxygen deficiency is intrinsic to the growth technique.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：多铁性钒（V）掺杂的二氧化铪（HfO₂），具体为具有 \(Pca2_1\) 相结构的候选多铁材料，以及其中氧缺陷与钒多价态的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氧空位向钒离子提供电子，将名义上的 V⁴⁺ 中心转化为 V³⁺，从而降低氧空位的形成能；计算得到的 V³⁺/V⁴⁺ 比例仅在还原条件下与实验 XPS 信号一致，暗示原子层沉积（ALD）生长条件下可能存在额外的电子库。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氧空位向钒离子提供电子，将名义上的 V⁴⁺ 中心转化为 V³⁺，从而降低氧空位的形成能；计算得到的 V³⁺/V⁴⁺ 比例仅在还原条件下与实验 XPS 信号一致，暗示原子层沉积（ALD）生长条件下可能存在额外的电子库。；创新点：揭示了氧缺陷与钒多价态之间的电荷转移机制，并指出该机制可能同样适用于近期发现的铬掺杂氧化铪中的多铁性，其中氧缺陷是生长工艺固有的。摘要未突出说明与纯 HfO₂ 或其他掺杂体系相比的具体计算细节差异。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体包括计算缺陷形成能、局域磁化强度、屏蔽效应以及 V 的芯能级位移（core-level shifts），并与实验 XPS 谱图进行对比。

papers.title: Machine Learning Accelerated SSNEB for Efficient Minimum Energy Pathway Calculations
papers.abstract: Metastable states and their minimum energy pathways (MEPs) are central to understanding transformations and phase stability in complex materials, yet mapping transition pathways between competing states remains computationally demanding and experimentally challenging. Here, we introduce a hybrid solid-state nudged elastic band (SSNEB) framework that integrates two pretrained machine learning models, EquiformerV2 (eqV2) and the equivariant Smooth Energy Network (eSEN), with DFT for energy, force, and stress evaluations. Applied to three solid-state systems, CsPbI$_3$, GaN, and TiO$_2$, our framework achieves up to a 7-fold speedup while converging to the same pathways predicted by first-principles calculations. Moreover, the hybrid SSNEB framework enables systematic benchmarking of existing ML models, providing both efficiency and reliability for predicting MEPs across various materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（混合类型）。关键词：machine learning、DFT、SSNEB、first-principles calculations。；研究对象：固态材料中的亚稳态及其最小能量路径（MEPs），具体体系为CsPbI₃、GaN和TiO₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将两个预训练的机器学习模型（EquiformerV2和eSEN）与DFT结合，构建的混合SSNEB框架在计算MEPs时最高可实现7倍加速，且收敛结果与第一性原理计算预测的路径一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将两个预训练的机器学习模型（EquiformerV2和eSEN）与DFT结合，构建的混合SSNEB框架在计算MEPs时最高可实现7倍加速，且收敛结果与第一性原理计算预测的路径一致。；创新点：提出一种将机器学习模型与DFT混合的SSNEB框架，在保持第一性原理精度前提下显著加速MEP计算，并可用于系统性地基准测试现有机器学习模型在MEP预测中的表现。
papers.method_zh: 混合固态微动弹性带（SSNEB）框架，集成两个预训练机器学习模型（EquiformerV2和eSEN）与DFT，用于能量、力和应力的评估。

papers.title: Direct/adaptive-mixture phase-gradient learning for neural-network quantum states with complex phase structure
papers.abstract: Neural-network quantum states (NQS) are a leading variational tool for quantum many-body physics, yet their optimization is fragile whenever the ground state carries a non-trivial sign or complex phase structure, a situation generic to gauge fields, broken time-reversal symmetry, and fermionic statistics. We trace this fragility to the stochastic estimator of the phase gradient rather than to network expressiveness. The phase sector of the Monte Carlo energy gradient is a noisy score-function estimator; differentiating the local energy instead yields a direct estimator that is unbiased for the same phase force, has far lower variance, and requires only a separated amplitude--phase ansatz. Demonstrated on a 100-site flux ladder, a small network trained this way reaches $0.89\%$ median error, where tuned standard baselines plateau at $1.8\%$ and wider or deeper standard-gradient networks degrade from $8.4\%$ to $24.6\%$. The advantage carries over to chiral XXX chains: the direct estimator again converges to a markedly lower error than the standard one, across $α$ and size; it grows with flux and vanishes in zero-flux controls. An adaptive-mixture of the two estimators is provably never worse in variance than the better endpoint at the optimal mixing coefficient, with seed-resolved diagnostics tracing much of the gain to eliminating failed runs. Estimator design thus emerges as a first-class lever for complex-valued neural quantum states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：neural-network quantum states (NQS)、variational tool、Monte Carlo energy gradient、estimator design。；研究对象：量子多体系统，特别是具有非平凡符号或复相位结构的基态，例如规范场、时间反演对称性破缺系统、费米子统计系统。具体演示体系为100位点通量梯子模型和手性XXX自旋链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 神经网络量子态在优化具有复相位结构的基态时，其脆弱性源于相位梯度的随机估计器（score-function estimator）的高方差，而非网络表达能力不足。通过使用直接估计器（direct estimator）替代标准估计器，可显著降低方差并提高优化精度，在通量梯子模型上将中位误差从1.8%降至0.89%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：神经网络量子态在优化具有复相位结构的基态时，其脆弱性源于相位梯度的随机估计器（score-function estimator）的高方差，而非网络表达能力不足。通过使用直接估计器（direct estimator）替代标准估计器，可显著降低方差并提高优化精度，在通量梯子模型上将中位误差从1.8%降至0.89%。；创新点：首次明确指出神经网络量子态优化在复相位系统中的脆弱性根源在于相位梯度的随机估计器而非网络表达能力，并提出了方差更低的直接估计器及自适应混合策略，将估计器设计提升为处理复值神经量子态的关键杠杆。
papers.method_zh: 采用分离振幅-相位的神经网络量子态变分方法，对比了两种相位梯度估计器：标准得分函数估计器（score-function estimator）和直接估计器（direct estimator）。后者通过微分局域能量得到，具有无偏、低方差特性。还提出了两种估计器的自适应混合方案，并进行了种子分辨的诊断分析。

papers.title: Molecular Beam Epitaxy of Mn2In2Se5 van der Waals Layers Using Mn Intercalation
papers.abstract: The weak van der Waals (vdW) force in layered chalcogenide materials has enabled the growth of ternary chalcogenide layers using unconventional approaches. Here, we report the molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) growth of Mn2In2Se5, a spin glass material with high level of magnetic frustration, through the heterointegration of MnSe on In2Se3. Directly depositing α-MnSe on the vdW In2Se3 layers results in Mn intercalation, transforming the In2Se3 layer into Mn2In2Se5. Large growth windows, including substrate temperatures from 250-450 °C and Se:Mn flux ratio of 1.1-3.1, have been identified for the intercalation process. With an optimized MnSe deposition time, smooth, single-crystalline, and (0001)-oriented Mn2In2Se5 layers with a root-mean-square (RMS) roughness of 1.5 nm can be synthesized. Further extending the MnSe deposition time results in the growth of uniform rock-salt structured α-MnSe (111) layers with a thickness of up to 8 nm and a narrow full-width-at-half-maximum (FWHM) of 0.35° in MnSe (222) XRD rocking curves. This report presents a unique approach for the growths of uniform and single-crystalline Mn2In2Se5 vdW layers using MBE, and potentially opens a pathway for synthesis of ternary vdW chalcogenides by intercalation of new atomic species in binary vdW chalcogenides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) growth”、“depositing”、“synthesized”、“XRD rocking curves”。；研究对象：三元层状硫族化合物 Mn₂In₂Se₅ 的范德华层，以及通过 Mn 插层实现其分子束外延生长。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在 In₂Se₃ 范德华层上异质集成 MnSe，利用 Mn 插层作用成功实现了单晶、均匀的 Mn₂In₂Se₅ 范德华层的分子束外延生长，并确定了较宽的生长窗口。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在 In₂Se₃ 范德华层上异质集成 MnSe，利用 Mn 插层作用成功实现了单晶、均匀的 Mn₂In₂Se₅ 范德华层的分子束外延生长，并确定了较宽的生长窗口。；创新点：提出了一种通过将新原子物种插层到二元范德华硫族化合物中，从而合成三元范德华硫族化合物的独特生长方法。摘要未突出说明与以往生长方法的具体性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长技术，具体为在 In₂Se₃ 层上沉积 α-MnSe 以实现 Mn 插层。表征手段包括 X 射线衍射（XRD）摇摆曲线和均方根（RMS）粗糙度测量。

papers.title: Multi-modal machine learning analysis of GaSe molecular beam epitaxy growth conditions
papers.abstract: Autonomous synthesis platforms integrating machine learning with in situ diagnostics have the potential to revolutionize thin-film growth by enabling real-time process optimization and reducing the need for manual tuning. However, their application to molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) remains underdeveloped. Here, we present a machine learning-guided framework for MBE growth of GaSe films, leveraging reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED) as an in situ diagnostic alongside ex situ characterization via X-ray diffraction and atomic force microscopy. Unsupervised learning on RHEED patterns reveals a well-defined boundary between high- and low-quality samples, capturing physically meaningful features. Mutual information analysis shows a strong correlation between RHEED embeddings and rocking curve full-width at half-maximum (fwhm), while the correlation with AFM root-mean-square (RMS) roughness is weak. Among key growth conditions, growth rate most strongly influences fwhm, whereas the Se/Ga flux ratio primarily affects RMS roughness and the RHEED embeddings. Supervised learning models trained to predict fwhm and RMS roughness demonstrate moderate accuracy, with significant improvement achieved by incorporating RHEED embeddings. Furthermore, anomaly detection via residual analysis in supervised learning aligns well with unsupervised classification from RHEED, reinforcing the reliability of the predictive models. This study establishes a data-driven framework for machine learning-assisted MBE, paving the way for real-time process control and accelerated optimization of thin-film synthesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 机器学习分析）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到分子束外延（MBE）生长实验、反射高能电子衍射（RHEED）原位诊断、X射线衍射（XRD）和原子力显微镜（AFM）非原位表征，同时结合了无监督学习、互信息分析、监督学习等机器学习方法。；研究对象：GaSe薄膜的分子束外延（MBE）生长条件优化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过无监督学习对RHEED图案进行分析，可以清晰区分高质量与低质量样品；生长速率对X射线摇摆曲线半高宽（fwhm）影响最大，而Se/Ga通量比主要影响AFM均方根粗糙度和RHEED嵌入特征；将RHEED嵌入特征纳入监督学习模型可显著提升对薄膜质量的预测精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过无监督学习对RHEED图案进行分析，可以清晰区分高质量与低质量样品；生长速率对X射线摇摆曲线半高宽（fwhm）影响最大，而Se/Ga通量比主要影响AFM均方根粗糙度和RHEED嵌入特征；将RHEED嵌入特征纳入监督学习模型可显著提升对薄膜质量的预测精度。；创新点：将机器学习与RHEED原位诊断相结合，构建了针对MBE生长的数据驱动优化框架，并揭示了不同生长条件（生长速率、Se/Ga通量比）对薄膜不同质量指标（结晶质量、表面粗糙度）的差异化影响。摘要未突出说明与已有MBE机器学习研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长GaSe薄膜；原位诊断：反射高能电子衍射（RHEED）；非原位表征：X射线衍射（XRD，测量摇摆曲线半高宽fwhm）、原子力显微镜（AFM，测量均方根粗糙度）；机器学习方法：无监督学习（对RHEED图案进行聚类）、互信息分析、监督学习（预测fwhm和RMS粗糙度）、残差分析用于异常检测。

papers.title: Towards Atom-by-Atom Fabrication: Mechanosynthetic donation and abstraction
papers.abstract: Enabled by inverted-mode scanning tunneling microscopy (IM-STM) and the use of functionalized molecular tools, we demonstrate positionally-controlled mechanosynthetic addition (donation) of carbon and subtraction (abstraction) of silicon atoms on a model build site: atomically clean and crystalline Si(100). The resulting structures represent the first demonstrations of an emerging ability to manipulate radical chemistry with positional control of specific atoms and moieties in 3D. Furthermore, by comparing the behavior of molecular tools designed for atomic donation versus abstraction, we highlight general principles governing molecular tool design for selective and reliable mechanosynthetic functionality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：inverted-mode scanning tunneling microscopy (IM-STM)、demonstrate、positionally-controlled mechanosynthetic addition/subtraction。；研究对象：原子级清洁的晶体 Si(100) 表面上的碳原子捐赠（addition）和硅原子抽取（abstraction）的机械合成过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用倒置模式扫描隧道显微镜（IM-STM）和功能化分子工具，首次实现了在三维空间中对特定原子和基团进行位置可控的自由基化学操作，展示了碳原子的机械合成捐赠和硅原子的机械合成抽取。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用倒置模式扫描隧道显微镜（IM-STM）和功能化分子工具，首次实现了在三维空间中对特定原子和基团进行位置可控的自由基化学操作，展示了碳原子的机械合成捐赠和硅原子的机械合成抽取。；创新点：首次在三维空间中以位置可控的方式演示了机械合成中的原子捐赠（碳）与抽取（硅），并揭示了实现选择性、可靠机械合成功能所需的分子工具设计的一般原则。
papers.method_zh: 倒置模式扫描隧道显微镜（IM-STM），并结合功能化分子工具进行原子级操作。

papers.title: Dynamical multiferroicity in framework materials
papers.abstract: Dynamical multiferroicity, which describes the magnetic fields generated by circularly polarized phonons in materials, is an established mechanism for optical control of magnetism. Here we perform ab initio calculations of dynamical multiferroicity in inorganic and organic framework materials, with the goal of identifying materials which enable the generation of large magnetic fields by light. We find the metal--organic framework material Zn(NH$_4$)(formate)$_3$ to have modes with magnetic moments almost twice that of SrTiO$_3$; these modes involve circular motions of NH$_4^+$ hydrogen ions with high gyromagnetic ratios. The complex structure and flexibility of framework materials can allow such angular momentum localization, and also increase the maximum light-induced magnetization permitted by the Lindemann melting criterion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“ab initio calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：无机和有机框架材料中的动态多铁性现象，具体包括金属有机框架材料 Zn(NH₄)(formate)₃ 以及 SrTiO₃ 作为对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在金属有机框架材料 Zn(NH₄)(formate)₃ 中，由圆偏振光激发的声子模式产生的磁矩几乎是 SrTiO₃ 的两倍；框架材料的复杂结构和柔性有助于实现角动量局域化，并提高林德曼熔化准则所允许的最大光致磁化强度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在金属有机框架材料 Zn(NH₄)(formate)₃ 中，由圆偏振光激发的声子模式产生的磁矩几乎是 SrTiO₃ 的两倍；框架材料的复杂结构和柔性有助于实现角动量局域化，并提高林德曼熔化准则所允许的最大光致磁化强度。；创新点：首次将动态多铁性的研究从传统无机材料（如 SrTiO₃）拓展到无机和有机框架材料，并发现金属有机框架材料因高旋磁比的 NH₄⁺ 离子圆运动而具有更大的声子磁矩。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（ab initio calculations），具体用于计算动态多铁性效应中圆偏振声子产生的磁场大小。

papers.title: DFTB coupled with NEGF study of the structural, electronic and transport properties of goldene 2D material
papers.abstract: We report the structural, electronic, and transport properties of the goldene 2D material using the density functional tight-binding (DFTB) method. Electronic transport calculations were conducted in conjunction with the non-equilibrium Green's functions (NEGF) technique. Our study reveals that the Au 2D material is dynamically and thermally stable, and it possesses good elastic properties. On the other hand, goldene has a linear relationship between current and voltage at low potentials, indicating its metallic character. The calculated current-potential curve correlates well with transmission functions and the electronic density of states around the Fermi level. We also investigated the electronic structure and magnetic properties of silicon (Si)-doped Au 2D material. Our results show that the Si atom can induce a local magnetic state in the goldene monolayer. The resulting magnetic moment is 0.63 $μ_B$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional tight-binding (DFTB) method、non-equilibrium Green's functions (NEGF) technique。；研究对象：二维金烯（goldene）材料，以及硅（Si）掺杂的金烯单层。具体物理现象包括结构稳定性、电子性质、输运性质及磁性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金烯二维材料具有动态和热稳定性，且表现出良好的弹性性质；在低偏压下电流与电压呈线性关系，显示金属性。硅掺杂可在金烯单层中诱导出局域磁态，磁矩为0.63 μ_B。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金烯二维材料具有动态和热稳定性，且表现出良好的弹性性质；在低偏压下电流与电压呈线性关系，显示金属性。硅掺杂可在金烯单层中诱导出局域磁态，磁矩为0.63 μ_B。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函紧束缚（DFTB）方法进行结构和电子性质计算，结合非平衡格林函数（NEGF）技术进行电子输运计算。

papers.title: Closed-loop discovery of out-of-distribution processing protocols by evolutionary search and uncertainty-aware learning
papers.abstract: Many materials and chemical systems exhibit history-dependent responses, where functional outcomes are governed not only by final-state variables but by the time-dependent sequence of fields, temperatures, or chemical potentials applied during operation. Discovering new processing protocols is therefore a high-dimensional search problem in which the control variable is an entire waveform or sample history, and conventional strategies either remain confined to conservative interpolative families or become prohibitively measurement intensive. Here, a closed-loop workflow is introduced that couples evolutionary search over a compact waveform representation with uncertainty-aware deep kernel learning to generate, rank, and experimentally validate candidate protocols. Applied to ferroelectric thin films, with the scanning-probe tip-bias waveform as the protocol and the nonlinear electromechanical response as the reward, the workflow discovers waveform families that enhance nonlinearity by de-aging the film. Spatially resolved before/after measurements show that the best-performing waveforms selectively activate pre-existing, weakly pinned domain-wall segments, whereas the worst drive long-range irreversible switching. This framework reframes protocol tuning as out-of-distribution discovery, generalizable to synthesis and annealing trajectories, battery formation protocols, and other high-dimensional control problems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中提及“闭环工作流”、“进化搜索”、“不确定性感知的深度核学习”等计算方法，以及“应用于铁电薄膜”、“扫描探针尖端偏压波形”、“空间分辨测量”等实验验证手段。；研究对象：铁电薄膜材料，具体研究其非线性机电响应与施加的扫描探针尖端偏压波形（处理协议）之间的历史依赖关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过闭环搜索工作流，发现了一类能够通过“去老化”效应增强铁电薄膜非线性响应的波形族。性能最佳的波形选择性地激活了预先存在的、弱钉扎的畴壁片段，而最差的波形则驱动了长程不可逆的开关过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过闭环搜索工作流，发现了一类能够通过“去老化”效应增强铁电薄膜非线性响应的波形族。性能最佳的波形选择性地激活了预先存在的、弱钉扎的畴壁片段，而最差的波形则驱动了长程不可逆的开关过程。；创新点：将处理协议的优化重新定义为“分布外发现”问题，而非传统的保守插值搜索。该框架具有通用性，可推广至合成、退火轨迹、电池形成协议等高维控制问题。
papers.method_zh: 采用闭环工作流，将紧凑波形表示上的进化搜索与不确定性感知的深度核学习相结合，用于生成、排序和实验验证候选处理协议。实验上，以扫描探针尖端偏压波形作为协议，以非线性机电响应作为奖励函数，并在空间分辨的测量中对比处理前后的结果。

papers.title: Machine-learned dynamics of surface polarons at reduced oxide surfaces
papers.abstract: Reducible oxides exhibit a rich interplay of electronic, structural, and chemical properties that underpins applications in catalysis, photovoltaics, batteries, and energy storage. This interplay is strongly shaped by excess electrons, often introduced by oxygen vacancies, that localize as small polarons and influence charge transport and surface chemistry. At surfaces, these polarons play a central role in charge localization, mobility, and reactivity, yet their finite-temperature dynamics remain difficult to access from first principles. Ab initio molecular dynamics is typically limited to picosecond time scales, precluding statistically meaningful sampling of polaron hopping dynamics. To overcome this limitation, we extend machine-learning-assisted polaron dynamics [V. Birschitzky et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 134, 216301 (2025)] to redox-active oxide surfaces, using oxygen-deficient rutile TiO2(110) as a paradigmatic case. By accessing several nanoseconds of dynamics over a range of temperatures, we show that small-polaron mobility at the reduced rutile TiO2(110) surface is suppressed by several orders of magnitude relative to the corresponding bulk material, providing a microscopic interpretation of the lower electron mobilities observed in porous rutile TiO2 compared with single-crystal samples. This suppressed mobility arises from the loss of favorable hopping pathways: surface polaron motion is largely confined to planar inter-row trajectories within the second topmost layers, with only rare interlayer hopping events. Oxygen vacancies further reshape the polaron free-energy landscape by acting as attractive centers for excess electrons, biasing the polaron distribution toward nearby Ti sites and promoting occasional charge transfer to the outermost surface layer. These results establish a transferable machine-learning strategy for investigating polaron dynamics in reducible oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning-assisted polaron dynamics、ab initio molecular dynamics、first principles。；研究对象：还原性氧化物表面（以缺氧金红石TiO₂(110)为模型体系）上的小极化子动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 还原性金红石TiO₂(110)表面的小极化子迁移率比体相材料低数个数量级，这是由于表面极化子运动主要被限制在次表层内的平面行间轨迹，层间跳跃事件极为罕见；氧空位作为吸引中心进一步重塑了极化子自由能景观。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：还原性金红石TiO₂(110)表面的小极化子迁移率比体相材料低数个数量级，这是由于表面极化子运动主要被限制在次表层内的平面行间轨迹，层间跳跃事件极为罕见；氧空位作为吸引中心进一步重塑了极化子自由能景观。；创新点：将机器学习辅助极化子动力学方法从体相材料拓展至氧化还原活性氧化物表面，首次实现了对表面极化子有限温度下纳秒尺度动力学过程的统计采样，揭示了表面与体相极化子迁移率的巨大差异及其微观机制。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习辅助的极化子动力学方法（扩展自V. Birschitzky et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 134, 216301 (2025)），结合第一性原理分子动力学（AIMD）的短时模拟与机器学习势函数驱动的纳秒级长时动力学模拟。

papers.title: Combining Frozen Trajectory Excitation and TACAW for in silico Time-Resolved Vibrational Electron Energy Loss/Gain Spectroscopy
papers.abstract: Seeing that ultrafast (picosecond timescale) vibrational electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) should soon be experimentally realizable, we present in silico approach capable of providing insight from the computational physics perspective. We present a framework that combines frozen trajectory excitation (FTE) with time auto-correlation of auxiliary wavefunctions (TACAW) to study the time-dependent spectral response of non-equilibrium lattice dynamics in a way comparable directly to experiment - (scanning) transmission electron microscope EELS, (S)TEM-EELS. In this approach, a selected phonon excitation is first introduced into an equilibrium molecular dynamics trajectory using FTE, after which the atomic positions during subsequent relaxations are treated with short-time TACAW analysis performed at different pump-probe delays. This yields momentum- and energy-resolved electron-scattering signals bearing a phonon imprint during the relaxation process, going beyond time-dependent diffuse-scattering intensities alone. We demonstrate the approach for fcc-Ni and 3C-SiC and discuss the observed phonon mode coupling and spectral redistribution during phonon relaxation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：in silico approach、computational physics perspective、framework、demonstrate the approach。；研究对象：非平衡晶格动力学的时间分辨振动电子能量损失/增益谱（vibrational EELS/EEGS），具体材料为fcc-Ni和3C-SiC。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合冻结轨迹激发（FTE）与辅助波函数时间自相关（TACAW）的方法，能够计算不同泵浦-探测延迟下非平衡晶格弛豫过程中的动量分辨和能量分辨电子散射信号，揭示声子模式耦合及光谱重分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合冻结轨迹激发（FTE）与辅助波函数时间自相关（TACAW）的方法，能够计算不同泵浦-探测延迟下非平衡晶格弛豫过程中的动量分辨和能量分辨电子散射信号，揭示声子模式耦合及光谱重分布。；创新点：该方法能够获得弛豫过程中携带声子印记的动量-能量分辨电子散射信号，超越了仅依赖时间分辨漫散射强度的分析，并首次将FTE与TACAW结合用于模拟时间分辨振动EELS/EEGS。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种计算框架：先利用FTE在平衡分子动力学轨迹中引入特定声子激发，然后对后续弛豫过程中的原子位置进行短时TACAW分析，模拟与（扫描）透射电子显微镜EELS实验直接可比的时间分辨振动谱。

papers.title: A Collective-Spin Derivation of the Uniform Magnon Hamiltonian in Cavity Magnonics
papers.abstract: We present a direct collective-spin derivation of the effective uniform-mode Hamiltonian used in cavity magnonics. Starting from a nearest-neighbor Heisenberg ferromagnet coupled to long-wavelength magnetic fields, we show that the relevant dynamics can be restricted to the fully symmetric spin sector, where the exchange interaction contributes only a constant energy shift and the ferromagnet behaves as a macrospin of length $Ns$. Applying the Holstein--Primakoff transformation directly to this total spin yields the usual uniform magnon mode and its leading nonlinear corrections without first introducing site-resolved bosonic operators. This collective formulation makes explicit the interpretation of the ferromagnet as a synthetic large-spin atom and provides a compact route to the effective Hamiltonians used in driven and Floquet cavity magnonics. As a physical consequence, the leading nonlinear correction produces an occupation-dependent reduction of the effective magnon--photon coupling, providing a simple signature of finite-spin saturation under strong uniform-mode driving.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“collective-spin derivation”、“theoretical framework”、“effective Hamiltonian”。；研究对象：腔磁学（cavity magnonics）中的均匀磁振子（uniform magnon mode）及其有效哈密顿量，具体体系为近邻海森堡铁磁体耦合长波长磁场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过集体自旋推导，证明铁磁体在均匀模式下的动力学可等效为一个长度为 \( Ns \) 的宏观自旋（macrospin），且交换相互作用仅贡献常数能量偏移；同时发现，非线性修正会导致有效磁振子-光子耦合强度随占据数增加而降低，这是有限自旋饱和效应的简单标志。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过集体自旋推导，证明铁磁体在均匀模式下的动力学可等效为一个长度为 \( Ns \) 的宏观自旋（macrospin），且交换相互作用仅贡献常数能量偏移；同时发现，非线性修正会导致有效磁振子-光子耦合强度随占据数增加而降低，这是有限自旋饱和效应的简单标志。；创新点：提出了一种无需引入位点分辨玻色子算符的集体自旋推导方法，直接得到均匀磁振子哈密顿量及其非线性修正，明确揭示了铁磁体作为合成大自旋原子的物理图像，并为驱动和Floquet腔磁学中的有效哈密顿量提供了简洁推导路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：从近邻海森堡铁磁体模型出发，结合长波长磁场耦合，将动力学限制在全对称自旋子空间；直接对总自旋应用Holstein–Primakoff变换，得到均匀磁振子模式及其非线性修正，无需引入局域玻色子算符。

papers.title: Observation of intertwined charge density wave order and superconductivity in Janus monolayer
papers.abstract: Low-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) provide an ideal platform for studying the emergence of charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity. The discovery of emergent CDW order in 1T $\mathrm{ZrTe_2}$ monolayer raises an important question: does this instability persist when one $\mathrm{Te}$ chalcogen layer is substituted by $\mathrm{Se}$? In the present work, we investigate the CDW (2$\times$2$\times$1) and superconducting instability in 1T $\mathrm{ZrSeTe}$ Janus monolayer using first-principles calculations. The phonon spectrum exhibits a pronounced anomaly at the $\mathrm{M}$ point of the irreducible Brillouin zone, arising from enhanced electron-phonon interaction together with electronic instabilities originating from both interband and intraband scattering. The resulting lattice distortion reconstructs the electronic structure, opening a small indirect band gap, driving the system from a semi-metallic to a semiconducting state. The energy gain associated with the distortion is significantly smaller than that of $\mathrm{ZrTe_2}$ monolayer, indicating that the replacement of one $\mathrm{Te}$ chalcogen layer with $\mathrm{Se}$ weakens the CDW instability. We have further investigated the effects of electronic correlation and biaxial strain, both acts as effective tuning parameters for the instabilities concerened. In the high temperature undistorted phase, $\mathrm{ZrSeTe}$ exhibits phonon mediated two-gap superconductivity. It originates primarily from the robust coupling between the soft phonon mode at $\mathrm{M}$ point and the electronic bands predominantly derived from $\mathrm{Zr}$ $\mathit{d}$ and $\mathrm{Te}$ $\mathit{p}$ orbitals crossing the Fermi level. Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) further modifies the electronic states and reduces the superconducting transition temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）、phonon spectrum（声子谱）、electron-phonon interaction（电子-声子相互作用）。；研究对象：1T相 ZrSeTe Janus单层材料中的电荷密度波（CDW）序与超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在1T ZrSeTe Janus单层中，Te层被Se取代会削弱CDW不稳定性，但该材料在高温无畸变相中仍表现出由软声子模介导的双能隙超导电性，且自旋-轨道耦合会降低超导转变温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在1T ZrSeTe Janus单层中，Te层被Se取代会削弱CDW不稳定性，但该材料在高温无畸变相中仍表现出由软声子模介导的双能隙超导电性，且自旋-轨道耦合会降低超导转变温度。；创新点：首次在理论上预测了Janus结构ZrSeTe单层中CDW序与超导电性的共存，并揭示了用Se替换一层Te对CDW不稳定性的调控作用，以及该体系中超导的微观机制（M点软声子模与Zr d轨道、Te p轨道的耦合）。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体包括声子谱计算、电子结构分析、电子-声子耦合计算，以及电子关联效应（electronic correlation）和双轴应变（biaxial strain）的调控研究。

papers.title: Enhancement of spin current in Fe$_{85}$Co$_{15}$/Ni$_{80}$Fe$_{20}$ bilayers via interlayer ferromagnetic coupling
papers.abstract: We present a detailed study on how the strength of the interlayer magnetic coupling on Fe$_{85}$Co$_{15}$/Ni$_{80}$Fe$_{20}$ bilayers modifies the spin wave behavior of this system. A series of Fe$_{85}$Co$_{15}$/Ni$_{80}$Fe$_{20}$ bilayers deposited on MgO[100] substrates were grown by magnetron sputtering. Magnetic characterization of the samples was performed using a vibrating sample magnetometer and magneto-optical Kerr effect. The in-plane hysteresis loops reveal a cubic magnetic anisotropy of magnetocrystalline origin, with easy and hard axis along the [100] and [110] Fe-Co crystallographic directions, respectively. Ferromagnetic resonance measurements were performed to analyze the in-plane angular dependence of the resonance field, and also the resonance field at several frequencies was determined along the hard axis. By using a bilayer model in the frame of the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert magnetization equation of motion, the magnetization precession components were calculated, as well as the dependence of precession area on the Fe-Co layer thickness and the ferromagnetic interlayer coupling. We observe a maximum in the area of the ellipsoid generated by the magnetization precession of the permalloy layer at a certain exchange constant, showing that this effect could be used to maximize the injected spin currents, which could be tuned by changing the interlayer exchange constant in bilayer systems, the saturation magnetization of the materials, or the excitation frequency.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：deposited by magnetron sputtering、magnetic characterization、ferromagnetic resonance measurements）；研究对象：Fe₈₅Co₁₅/Ni₈₀Fe₂₀双层膜体系，以及层间铁磁耦合对自旋波行为和自旋电流的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节Fe-Co层厚度和层间铁磁交换耦合常数，可以最大化坡莫合金（Ni₈₀Fe₂₀）层的磁化进动椭球面积，从而增强注入的自旋电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节Fe-Co层厚度和层间铁磁交换耦合常数，可以最大化坡莫合金（Ni₈₀Fe₂₀）层的磁化进动椭球面积，从而增强注入的自旋电流。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用磁控溅射在MgO[100]衬底上生长Fe₈₅Co₁₅/Ni₈₀Fe₂₀双层膜；使用振动样品磁强计和磁光克尔效应进行磁性表征；通过铁磁共振测量分析共振场的面内角度依赖性和沿难轴方向的频率依赖性；基于Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程的双层膜模型计算磁化进动分量及进动面积。

papers.title: Digital programming of spin correlations in a fermionic lattice quantum simulator
papers.abstract: Analog quantum simulation provides a highly controlled platform to study diverse quantum many-body phenomena. However, current methods for state initialisation are limited to thermal ensembles or uncorrelated product states. Here we present a hybrid approach that complements analog preparation with a digital quantum-gate protocol. This approach enables the engineering of target states with specific, long-range spin-correlations from the same initial resource state. By applying collisional gates to adiabatically prepared and filtered four-fermion singlet chains, we program diverse spin-correlation patterns, including that of a Heisenberg chain. We measure the spin correlations using a sequence of quantum gates followed by singlet-pair measurements. Our method paves the way to the targeted preparation of strongly correlated states of matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：analog quantum simulation、digital quantum-gate protocol、collisional gates、singlet-pair measurements）；研究对象：费米子晶格量子模拟器中的自旋关联态工程，具体为通过混合模拟-数字量子门协议在四费米子单态链中编程自旋关联模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将模拟绝热制备与数字量子门协议相结合，可从同一初始资源态出发，编程生成具有特定长程自旋关联的目标态（包括海森堡链的自旋关联模式）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将模拟绝热制备与数字量子门协议相结合，可从同一初始资源态出发，编程生成具有特定长程自旋关联的目标态（包括海森堡链的自旋关联模式）。；创新点：突破了传统模拟量子模拟中初始态局限于热系综或无关联乘积态的限制，首次实现了从同一资源态通过数字门协议灵活编程多种长程自旋关联模式。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合量子模拟方法：先通过绝热制备和过滤获得四费米子单态链作为初始资源态，再应用碰撞门（collisional gates）进行数字量子门操作，最后通过量子门序列结合单态对测量来检测自旋关联。

papers.title: Electrostatic Charge Model for Dual-Layer Oxide Thin-Film Transistors
papers.abstract: A simple electrostatic two-equation model for dual-layer thin-film transistor (TFT) operation is developed. The model distributes electrostatic charge between the top and bottom semiconductor layers, and the resulting transfer and mobility curves accurately simulate experimental dual-layer a-IGZO/a-IZO TFT operation. The model further provides an analytic expression that maps charge confinement in the high-mobility a-IZO bottom semiconductor layer with the a-IGZO top-layer thickness and the conduction-band offset. By considering both a-IGZO/a-IZO layer charge partition and competing thickness-dependent oxygen vacancy trap density effects, the model suggests an optimal a-IGZO layer thickness of 9 to 12 nm. Importantly, this general electrostatic model extends to most dual-layer TFT systems and calculates how the top semiconductor layer TFT turn-on voltage changes sharply with the conduction band offset and layer thickness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论模型文章。判断依据关键词：electrostatic two-equation model、analytic expression、general electrostatic model。；研究对象：双有源层氧化物薄膜晶体管（dual-layer oxide thin-film transistors），具体材料体系为a-IGZO（顶层）/a-IZO（底层）双有源层TFT。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该静电模型通过分配顶层与底层半导体层之间的电荷，准确模拟了双有源层TFT的转移特性和迁移率曲线；并指出当a-IGZO顶层厚度为9至12 nm时器件性能最优，该最优值由电荷分配与氧空位陷阱密度竞争效应共同决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该静电模型通过分配顶层与底层半导体层之间的电荷，准确模拟了双有源层TFT的转移特性和迁移率曲线；并指出当a-IGZO顶层厚度为9至12 nm时器件性能最优，该最优值由电荷分配与氧空位陷阱密度竞争效应共同决定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于静电学的双方程解析模型（two-equation model），通过电荷分配机制描述双有源层TFT的工作特性，并引入导带偏移（conduction-band offset）和氧空位陷阱密度等参数进行理论分析。

papers.title: Controlling Defects and Probing Dynamics in Active Nematics with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Topological defects govern much of the flow behavior and orientational order in active nematics, making their control relevant for active matter physics, smart materials, and microfluidics. Applied activity patterns can induce self-propulsion of active nematic defects, but general-purpose methods for exploiting this effect to control defects remain largely unexplored. Here we use deep reinforcement learning (RL) to perform minimum-time position control of +1/2 defects in hybrid lattice Boltzmann simulations of active nematodynamics. Spatiotemporally patterned activity, implemented as a control field in the active stress, steers defects through microchannel geometries and reveals finite-time reachable regions of defect position space. Reachability is shaped by director anisotropy, homeotropic wall anchoring, and the allowed activity patterns: local patterns steer defects in free domains but fail in junctions, whereas global patterns open otherwise inaccessible channels. In constrained geometries, the original defect may be unable to reach some goals intact, but controlled pair creation enlarges the effective reachable set by transferring control to a newly created +1/2 defect. The trained RL controllers outperform static and rule-based baselines, and controllers trained only on simple junctions can be combined without fine-tuning into a meta-controller that successfully steers defects through a larger test maze. Free energy visualizations show that guided defects write persistent, history-dependent distortions into the director field that can later be partially erased by -1/2 defects. Thus, RL-based control uncovers how confinement, anchoring, actuation geometry, and defect creation determine reachable motion in active nematics, providing a framework for other control tasks in soft and active matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：deep reinforcement learning, hybrid lattice Boltzmann simulations, active nematodynamics）；研究对象：活性向列相（active nematics）中拓扑缺陷（+1/2缺陷）的动力学与控制，具体涉及微通道几何结构中的缺陷位置操控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过深度强化学习训练的控制策略，能够实现活性向列相中+1/2缺陷的最短时间位置控制，并揭示出受限几何、锚定条件、驱动模式以及缺陷产生对缺陷可达运动空间的共同影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过深度强化学习训练的控制策略，能够实现活性向列相中+1/2缺陷的最短时间位置控制，并揭示出受限几何、锚定条件、驱动模式以及缺陷产生对缺陷可达运动空间的共同影响。；创新点：首次将深度强化学习应用于活性向列相缺陷的实时控制，系统研究了不同活动模式（局部 vs. 全局）对缺陷可达区域的影响，并展示了通过受控缺陷对产生来扩展有效可达集的能力，以及训练好的控制器可组合成元控制器以完成更复杂迷宫导航任务。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合格子玻尔兹曼方法（hybrid lattice Boltzmann simulations）模拟活性向列动力学，并结合深度强化学习（deep reinforcement learning, RL）设计时空变化的活性应力控制场，以驱动缺陷运动。

papers.title: Scalar dissipation anomaly and scalar-gradient scaling in turbulence: A joint velocity-scalar multifractal view
papers.abstract: We revisit the problem of scalar dissipation anomaly and scaling of scalar gradients in passive scalar turbulence using theory and data from well-resolved direct numerical simulations (DNS) on grid sizes of up to $8192^3$, spanning Taylor-scale Reynolds numbers $Re_λ=140-1000$ and Schmidt numbers $Sc = 1-512$. The theory is based on a joint multifractal description of longitudinal velocity increments and scalar increments, constrained by Yaglom's law and extended to gradients via a fluctuating Batchelor cutoff scale. The DNS data show that the normalized mean scalar dissipation approaches a single asymptotic value as both $Re_λ$ and $Sc$ increase, although larger $Sc$ requires larger $\re$ to reach this state. In the multifractal framework, this corresponds to an effective scalar Hölder exponent tending to zero, associated with sharp cliff-like scalar fronts, and saturation of inertial-range scaling scalar structure-function exponents. The joint velocity-scalar fractal dimension of the dissipative structures is inferred to approach $7/3$, indicating a non-space-filling support. The framework further predicts that for fixed $Re_λ$, higher-order central moments of scalar gradients are independent of $Sc$. This prediction is confirmed by DNS data and by the collapse of standardized probability distributions of scalar-gradient across Schmidt numbers. These results suggest that the $Sc$-scaling of scalar gradients is dictated solely by scalar dissipation anomaly. In contrast, their $Re_λ$-dependence reflects strong intermittency, which can be directly related to mixed velocity-scalar structure function exponents.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论分析 + 计算验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“using theory and data from well-resolved direct numerical simulations (DNS)”，即基于理论框架并利用直接数值模拟数据进行验证。；研究对象：被动标量湍流中的标量耗散异常（scalar dissipation anomaly）以及标量梯度标度行为。具体物理现象包括：标量耗散率的有限性、标量梯度的高阶矩标度、以及速度-标量联合多分形结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 归一化平均标量耗散率在雷诺数和施密特数增大时趋于单一渐近值，对应有效标量Hölder指数趋于零；标量梯度的高阶中心矩在固定雷诺数下与施密特数无关，表明标量梯度的施密特数标度完全由标量耗散异常决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：归一化平均标量耗散率在雷诺数和施密特数增大时趋于单一渐近值，对应有效标量Hölder指数趋于零；标量梯度的高阶中心矩在固定雷诺数下与施密特数无关，表明标量梯度的施密特数标度完全由标量耗散异常决定。；创新点：提出了速度-标量联合多分形框架，将标量耗散异常与标量梯度标度统一解释，并预测了标量梯度高阶矩对施密特数的独立性，该预测被DNS数据及概率分布塌缩所证实。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于纵向速度增量与标量增量的联合多分形描述（joint multifractal description），受Yaglom定律约束，并通过涨落Batchelor截断尺度推广至梯度。计算手段：高分辨率直接数值模拟（DNS），网格尺寸最高达8192³，泰勒尺度雷诺数Re_λ=140-1000，施密特数Sc=1-512。

papers.title: Prospective Coding and Path Integration Emerge as Equilibrium Solutions of Self-Organizing Neural Networks with Firing-Rate Adaptation
papers.abstract: Continuous Attractor Neural Networks (CANNs) traditionally rely on pre-wired recurrent connectivity to model spatial representations, path integration, and anticipatory dynamics. However, the biological mechanisms through which this structured connectivity emerges via learning remain relatively unexplored. This work presents a theoretical framework revealing how continuous attractor connectivity and its computational properties self-organize through Hebbian plasticity, firing-rate adaptation, and global inhibition. We show that translationally invariant inputs naturally drive the emergence of stable, Gaussian-profiled feedforward weights. Crucially, anticipatory dynamics arise spontaneously within these feedforward architectures, shifting the activity bump forward without requiring recurrent excitatory collaterals. This predictive shift can be linearly amplified across multilayer networks, consistent with anticipatory activity observed in the superficial layers of the entorhinal cortex. Furthermore, introducing recurrent interactions allows the network to learn connections capable of self-sustaining a moving bump of activity. Finally, by modulating the network with an external, time-varying baseline current that encodes speed, the system adjusts its intrinsic velocity to function as a precise unidirectional path integrator. Ultimately, this study suggests that prospective coding and path integration are not manually engineered features, but rather naturally co-emergent properties of a single self-organizing competitive network.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：theoretical framework、self-organizing、learning、modeling。；研究对象：连续吸引子神经网络（CANN）中空间表征、路径积分和预期动力学的自组织涌现机制，特别是通过赫布可塑性、发放率适应和全局抑制等生物机制实现的结构学习。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平移不变输入通过赫布可塑性自然驱动高斯型前馈权重的涌现，且无需递归兴奋性侧支即可自发产生预期性活动凸起；通过引入递归相互作用和编码速度的外部调制电流，网络可自组织为精确的单向路径积分器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平移不变输入通过赫布可塑性自然驱动高斯型前馈权重的涌现，且无需递归兴奋性侧支即可自发产生预期性活动凸起；通过引入递归相互作用和编码速度的外部调制电流，网络可自组织为精确的单向路径积分器。；创新点：揭示了预期编码和路径积分并非人工设计的特征，而是自组织竞争网络在赫布可塑性、发放率适应和全局抑制共同作用下自然共生的平衡解，无需预先布线的递归连接即可实现预期动力学。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟。具体包括：基于赫布可塑性的自组织学习规则、发放率适应机制、全局抑制网络结构、多层前馈网络线性放大分析，以及通过时变基线电流调制网络速度的路径积分实现。

papers.title: Spin disorder competing with positional symmetry breaking governs the metal-insulator behavior in oxide paramagnets
papers.abstract: Numerous transition-metal oxides have low-temperature antiferromagnetic (AFM) states and high-temperature paramagnetic (PM) phases, where the AFM state is usually insulating while the PM phase can be either insulating or metallic. Without involving strong correlation, we use symmetry-broken density-functional theory (DFT) to obtain the PM phases of insulating NaFeO3 vs the recently discovered metallic NaOsO3. We develop the understanding of insulating and metallic behaviors in paramagnetic oxides by analyzing the interactions between magnetic and positional symmetry breaking: The insulating gap is governed by the competition between the spin disorder that induces a distribution of different magnitudes of local magnetic moments and the polymorphous distribution of off-center atomic displacements. NaFeO3, on the other hand, has large positional displacement with small spin-disorder-induced moments distribution, leading to insulating PM phase, whereas NaOsO3 has a pronounced spin-disorder-induced moments distribution that forces the PM phase to become metallic. Our work identifies this symmetry-breaking competition as a general framework to bridge seemingly disparate metal-insulator behaviors in transition-metal oxides paramagnets without invoking strong correlation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用对称性破缺的密度泛函理论（DFT）进行计算分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：过渡金属氧化物顺磁相中的金属-绝缘体行为，具体对比了绝缘体NaFeO₃和金属NaOsO₃。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 顺磁氧化物的绝缘或金属行为由磁无序与位置对称性破缺之间的竞争决定：NaFeO₃因较大的原子位移和较小的自旋无序诱导磁矩分布而表现为绝缘体，而NaOsO₃因显著的自旋无序诱导磁矩分布而迫使顺磁相变为金属。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：顺磁氧化物的绝缘或金属行为由磁无序与位置对称性破缺之间的竞争决定：NaFeO₃因较大的原子位移和较小的自旋无序诱导磁矩分布而表现为绝缘体，而NaOsO₃因显著的自旋无序诱导磁矩分布而迫使顺磁相变为金属。；创新点：提出了一个不依赖强关联效应的通用框架，通过磁无序与位置对称性破缺的竞争来解释过渡金属氧化物顺磁相中看似迥异的金属-绝缘体行为。
papers.method_zh: 对称性破缺的密度泛函理论（DFT），用于模拟顺磁相，分析磁矩分布与原子位移的相互作用。

papers.title: Wave turbulence theory of odd fluids and solids: kinetic equations and solutions
papers.abstract: The theory of wave turbulence describes the properties of physical systems composed of a set of weak-amplitude random waves interacting nonlinearly. Here, we study odd wave turbulence, which arises in chiral media subjected to non-reciprocal stresses, notably odd viscosity and odd elasticity. In both cases, we consider simple models for which we can derive and solve analytically the kinetic equations describing the long-term statistical behavior of spectral quantities such as energy or wave action. For odd viscosity, we consider a three-dimensional model that exhibits wave turbulence involving three-wave interactions, which gives rise to a direct energy cascade characterized by an anisotropic Kolmogorov-Zakharov (KZ) spectrum. For odd elasticity, we consider a quasi-one-dimensional overdamped model that exhibits much slower dynamics involving six-wave interactions. In that case, the KZ spectrum corresponding to a forward cascade of a conserved quantity we call odd energy, is nonlocal and therefore does not constitute a physical solution. However, the other KZ solution, which describes an inverse cascade of wave action, is only marginally non-local and is therefore valid up to a logarithmic correction. These two analytical theories provide a rigorous interpretation of direct numerical simulations, where the KZ spectrum is observed both in the case of odd viscosity (forward cascade) and of odd elasticity (inverse cascade).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：wave turbulence theory、kinetic equations、analytically solve、direct numerical simulations。；研究对象：奇异物态（odd fluids and solids）中的波湍流现象，具体包括由奇粘滞性（odd viscosity）和奇弹性（odd elasticity）驱动的非互易应力介质中的弱非线性随机波系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在奇粘滞性三维模型中，三波相互作用导致各向异性的Kolmogorov-Zakharov（KZ）直接能级串谱；在奇弹性准一维过阻尼模型中，六波相互作用产生的KZ谱（对应“奇能量”正向级串）是非局域的、非物理解，而波作用量逆级串的KZ谱仅存在对数修正，是有效物理解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在奇粘滞性三维模型中，三波相互作用导致各向异性的Kolmogorov-Zakharov（KZ）直接能级串谱；在奇弹性准一维过阻尼模型中，六波相互作用产生的KZ谱（对应“奇能量”正向级串）是非局域的、非物理解，而波作用量逆级串的KZ谱仅存在对数修正，是有效物理解。；创新点：首次将波湍流理论系统应用于奇粘滞性和奇弹性体系，解析推导了各向异性KZ谱，并揭示了奇弹性体系中正向级串KZ谱的非局域失效与逆级串KZ谱的近似有效性。
papers.method_zh: 采用波湍流理论框架，推导并解析求解描述谱量（如能量、波作用量）长期统计行为的动力学方程；结合直接数值模拟验证KZ谱的存在性。

papers.title: Trap-Quenched Matter-Wave Optics for Dual Species Lensing
papers.abstract: Dual-species atom interferometry in space promises precise tests of the Universality of Free Fall (UFF), with a sensitivity that grows quadratically with the extended interrogation time accessible in weightlessness. These tests demand exquisite control over the expansion energies of both condensed sources as well as over their differential center-of-mass dynamics. We propose a trap-quenched collimation technique featuring in-trap excitations of collective modes compatible with state-of-the-art atom-chip setups. Using NASA's Cold Atom Laboratory aboard the International Space Station, we demonstrate it on a single-species $^{87}$Rb condensate. By controlling the center-of-mass release dynamics we observe free expansion times up to 700 ms and measure a two-dimensional expansion energy of $k_B \cdot 78\pm 9 \;\mathrm{pK}$ in the imaging plane. A detailed model of the magnetically-induced dynamics indicates that this corresponds to a two-dimensional expansion energy of about $k_B \cdot 15^{+12}_{-5}\; \mathrm{pK}$ along two of the condensate's eigenaxes. Finally, we theoretically study this trap-quenched collimation scheme for a $^{41}$K-$^{87}$Rb mixture, predicting a simultaneous collimation that meets the expansion energy requirements for a state-of-the-art UFF test at the $10^{-15}$ accuracy level.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有理论研究）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate it on a single-species $^{87}$Rb condensate”以及“theoretically study this trap-quenched collimation scheme”。；研究对象：双物种原子干涉仪中的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC），具体为$^{87}$Rb单物种以及$^{41}$K-$^{87}$Rb混合体系，研究其膨胀动力学与准直技术。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种“阱淬灭准直技术”，通过激发阱内集体模式实现对凝聚体膨胀能量的精确控制，在单物种$^{87}$Rb中观测到长达700 ms的自由膨胀时间，并测得二维膨胀能量低至$k_B \cdot 78\pm 9 \;\mathrm{pK}$；理论预测该方案可用于$^{41}$K-$^{87}$Rb混合物，实现满足$10^{-15}$精度级自由落体普适性检验要求的同步准直。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种“阱淬灭准直技术”，通过激发阱内集体模式实现对凝聚体膨胀能量的精确控制，在单物种$^{87}$Rb中观测到长达700 ms的自由膨胀时间，并测得二维膨胀能量低至$k_B \cdot 78\pm 9 \;\mathrm{pK}$；理论预测该方案可用于$^{41}$K-$^{87}$Rb混合物，实现满足$10^{-15}$精度级自由落体普适性检验要求的同步准直。；创新点：提出一种与现有原子芯片装置兼容的阱内集体模式激发准直方案，并首次在微重力环境下实现超低膨胀能的长时间自由膨胀，同时理论预言该方案可扩展至双物种体系以满足高精度等效原理检验需求。
papers.method_zh: 实验上利用国际空间站上的NASA冷原子实验室（CAL），采用原子芯片装置激发阱内集体模式，通过控制质心释放动力学实现准直；理论上建立磁感应动力学模型，并扩展至双物种混合体系进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Dissipation-induced superradiance in matter coupled to a self-interacting cavity
papers.abstract: Light-matter interactions are often modeled via the Dicke model, namely, by two-level systems coupled to a cavity mode. Alas, the threshold for superradiance is often experimentally inaccessible or hindered by light's diamagnetic term. Here, within the Dicke setting, we consider self-interacting light in a cavity, modeled by a photonic Kerr nonlinearity. We show that negative Kerr nonlinearity gives rise to a low-threshold superradiant phase with spin inversion. While unstable in a closed system, cavity dissipation stabilizes this lit phase, opening avenues for lasing and bath-engineered phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：modeled、show、consider（理论建模与分析）。；研究对象：光与物质相互作用体系，具体为Dicke模型框架下耦合到自相互作用腔（含光子Kerr非线性）的二能级系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 负Kerr非线性可在低阈值下诱导出自旋反转的超辐射相；虽然该相在封闭系统中不稳定，但腔耗散可稳定该发光相，为激光和浴工程相开辟新途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：负Kerr非线性可在低阈值下诱导出自旋反转的超辐射相；虽然该相在封闭系统中不稳定，但腔耗散可稳定该发光相，为激光和浴工程相开辟新途径。；创新点：揭示了负Kerr非线性与腔耗散协同作用可产生低阈值超辐射相，克服了传统Dicke模型中超辐射阈值过高或抗磁项阻碍的问题。
papers.method_zh: 基于Dicke模型的理论分析，引入光子Kerr非线性项，并考虑腔耗散（开放系统）的影响。

papers.title: Detecting Historical Turning Points in Italian Media: A Complex Systems Approach to a Diachronic News Corpus
papers.abstract: The increasing availability of large-scale textual corpora has opened new possibilities for data-driven, quantitative approaches to historical analysis using Natural Language Processing (NLP). However, diachronic corpora with historical relevance from the pre-digital era remain scarce and often incomplete. We present a quantitative approach to historical analysis based on the reconstruction and exploration of a diachronic corpus of around 600,000 articles from the Italian newspaper "La Repubblica", covering all the articles published from the 1st of January 1985 to the 31st of December 2000 - a period of major political, social, and geopolitical change in Italy and globally. Using NLP techniques, we analyze the text at both lexical and semantic levels; we then apply tools from complex systems and statistical physics to trace shifts in media discourse over time. This allows us to detect key transition periods, such as the transition from the First Republic to the Second Republic in Italy, or major international conflicts like the Gulf War or the Kosovo War, without relying on prior labeling. The results show how combining computational linguistics with ideas from complex systems can offer new quantitative insight into historical changes, opening up new paths for studying the dynamics of media and society through large-scale textual data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据分析文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“定量方法”、“自然语言处理（NLP）技术”、“复杂系统与统计物理工具”进行数据分析，未涉及实验或纯理论推导。；研究对象：论文研究的对象是意大利报纸《La Repubblica》在1985年1月1日至2000年12月31日期间出版的大约60万篇文章所构成的历时性新闻语料库。该语料库反映了意大利及全球在政治、社会、地缘政治方面的重大变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合自然语言处理与复杂系统方法，可以在无需预先标注的情况下，从大规模新闻文本中定量检测出关键历史转折期，例如意大利从“第一共和国”向“第二共和国”的过渡，以及海湾战争、科索沃战争等重大国际冲突。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合自然语言处理与复杂系统方法，可以在无需预先标注的情况下，从大规模新闻文本中定量检测出关键历史转折期，例如意大利从“第一共和国”向“第二共和国”的过渡，以及海湾战争、科索沃战争等重大国际冲突。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统历史分析方法相比的具体创新点，但隐含的创新在于：将计算语言学与复杂系统思想相结合，为历史变迁提供了一种全新的、数据驱动的定量分析视角，并成功应用于一个此前较少被数字化研究的、具有历史意义的历时性新闻语料库。
papers.method_zh: 具体使用了自然语言处理（NLP）技术对文本进行词汇和语义层面的分析；随后应用了复杂系统与统计物理学中的工具来追踪媒体话语随时间的变化轨迹。

papers.title: Wealth Inequality and Planetary Boundaries in a Stylized Agent-Based Model
papers.abstract: At the intersection of rising wealth inequality and intensifying environmental pressures, we investigate a reverse causal relationship that has received comparatively little attention: wealth inequality may not only be a consequence of environmental crises, but also act as a structural obstacle to the ecological transition itself. We develop a stylized agent-based model in which heterogeneous agents, whose initial wealth follows a Pareto distribution, allocate their income between either a Brown or a Green sector through a utility function. The function is designed to capture the trade-off between short-term returns and exposure to long-term systemic risks. A central ingredient is that wealthier agents perceive themselves as less vulnerable to environmental shocks, thereby reducing the amount of resources available for the transition. We show that, beyond inequality thresholds compatible with those observed in most developed countries, the economy remains locked in a Brown regime, even when a substantial share of agents is sensitive to externalities. We then assess a set of stylized fiscal policies (basic income, carbon taxation, Green incentives, and a combined scheme) and find that their effectiveness depends strongly on the inequality regime and on the regressivity embedded in the fiscal mechanism, revealing multidimensional trade-offs between transition speed, cumulative environmental destruction, growth, and fiscal pressure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：agent-based model（基于主体的模型）、stylized model（简化模型）、utility function（效用函数）。；研究对象：财富不平等与生态转型之间的反向因果关系，具体研究财富不平等如何成为阻碍经济向绿色（Green）部门转型的结构性障碍。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当财富不平等程度超过与大多数发达国家相当的门槛时，即使大部分主体对外部性敏感，经济仍会锁定在“棕色（Brown）模式”中；不同财政政策（如基本收入、碳税、绿色激励等）的有效性强烈依赖于不平等程度及财政机制中的累退性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当财富不平等程度超过与大多数发达国家相当的门槛时，即使大部分主体对外部性敏感，经济仍会锁定在“棕色（Brown）模式”中；不同财政政策（如基本收入、碳税、绿色激励等）的有效性强烈依赖于不平等程度及财政机制中的累退性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个简化的基于主体的模型（agent-based model），其中异质性主体的初始财富服从帕累托分布，通过效用函数在“棕色”与“绿色”部门之间分配收入，该效用函数捕捉了短期回报与长期系统性风险之间的权衡。

papers.title: Real-time pseudo entropy and modular-Hamiltonian correlations
papers.abstract: Pseudo entropy is a complex-valued generalization of entanglement entropy defined from a reduced transition matrix. We study the pseudo entropy associated with a real-time transition matrix between an initial pure state and its unitary time evolution. For a subsystem $A$, we show that the short-time behavior of real-time pseudo entropy is governed by the correlation between the physical Hamiltonian $H$ and the modular Hamiltonian $K_A=-\logρ_A$ of the initial reduced state, $ S_A(t,0)=S_A(0)-it \langle K_A(H-\langle H\rangle)\rangle + \mathcal{O}(t^2)$. For Hermitian dynamics, the initial imaginary response is controlled by the symmetrized covariance of $H$ and $K_A$ with an overall minus sign, while the initial real response is governed by their commutator. Thus the imaginary part of real-time pseudo entropy is not merely a branch artifact: it is a time-oriented modular response generated by the correlation between microscopic time evolution and subsystem coarse graining. We clarify the relation of this result to the known first law of pseudo entropy, derive an all-order expression in a Schmidt-diagonal model, recover thermal pseudo entropy as a special case, illustrate the covariance/commutator decomposition in a two-qubit model, and confirm the covariance response in transverse-field Ising-chain quenches, including a finite-size study of a modular susceptibility near the Ising critical region. We discuss how this amplitude-level oriented response can be related to ordinary entropy production, and also give a concrete $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric toy-model illustration of the non-Hermitian extension.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论推导（如“show that”“derive”“illustrate”），无实验或计算模拟关键词。；研究对象：实时伪熵（real-time pseudo entropy）及其与模哈密顿量（modular Hamiltonian）之间的关联，具体研究初始纯态经幺正时间演化后的子系统伪熵行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实时伪熵的短时行为由物理哈密顿量 \(H\) 与初始约化态的模哈密顿量 \(K_A\) 之间的关联决定：虚部响应由 \(H\) 与 \(K_A\) 的对称化协方差控制，实部响应由它们的对易子控制。虚部并非分支切割的人为产物，而是由微观时间演化与子系统粗粒化之间的关联产生的时间定向模响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实时伪熵的短时行为由物理哈密顿量 \(H\) 与初始约化态的模哈密顿量 \(K_A\) 之间的关联决定：虚部响应由 \(H\) 与 \(K_A\) 的对称化协方差控制，实部响应由它们的对易子控制。虚部并非分支切割的人为产物，而是由微观时间演化与子系统粗粒化之间的关联产生的时间定向模响应。；创新点：揭示了实时伪熵虚部的物理意义——它是由物理哈密顿量与模哈密顿量之间的关联所产生的时间定向模响应，而非仅由解析延拓引入的人为分支结构。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于约化转移矩阵（reduced transition matrix）定义伪熵，利用短时展开分析实时伪熵的线性项；在Schmidt对角模型中推导全阶表达式；通过两量子比特模型和横场伊辛链淬火（包括有限尺寸模磁化率研究）进行示例验证；并给出非厄米推广的 \(\mathcal{PT}\) 对称玩具模型示例。

papers.title: Dynamically frozen long-distance entanglement via non-Hermitian PT-symmetric systems
papers.abstract: In distributed quantum networks, interacting spin systems can mediate the generation of highly entangled links between distant nodes. We investigate the role of effective parity-time (PT)-symmetric non-Hermitian spin-1/2 bulks weakly coupled to two quantum links, obtained due to the environmental interactions affecting both the bulk and the links. Focusing on effective non-Hermitian nearest-neighbor (NN) Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) models, we analyze how non-Hermiticity influences the dynamical formation of long-distance entanglement (LDE). For a paradigmatic model consisting of a quantum XX bulk subjected to imaginary staggered magnetic fields, we analytically determine the exceptional points arising from the resulting bulk-mediated interactions between the links. Combining analytical and numerical methods, we demonstrate that an initially fully separable state can dynamically evolve into highly entangled link states near these exceptional points in the broken regime. Further, after optimizing over time and system parameters, near-unit time-averaged entanglement between the links emerges under weak imaginary magnetic fields and bulk-link couplings, which cannot be attained in the corresponding Hermitian systems. Moreover, the non-Hermitian dynamics exhibit a freezing of high entanglement in the vicinity of exceptional points, a feature absent in Hermitian counterparts. We also identify regimes of long-range interaction strengths that yield a higher time-averaged entanglement than the corresponding NN models. Furthermore, we establish that LDE persists in the stationary regime, highlighting the promise of engineered non-Hermitian dynamics for realizing robust and frozen entangled links in quantum networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、analytically determine、analytical and numerical methods、demonstrate。；研究对象：非厄米PT对称自旋-1/2体（bulk）与两个量子链路（quantum links）弱耦合构成的分布式量子网络，具体采用有效非厄米最近邻Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型，以及受虚交错磁场作用的量子XX体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非厄米PT对称系统中，初始完全可分离态可在破缺区间的例外点附近动态演化为高度纠缠的链路态；通过优化时间和系统参数，可在弱虚磁场和体-链路耦合下实现近单位时间平均纠缠，且纠缠在例外点附近出现“冻结”现象，这些特性在对应厄米系统中无法实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非厄米PT对称系统中，初始完全可分离态可在破缺区间的例外点附近动态演化为高度纠缠的链路态；通过优化时间和系统参数，可在弱虚磁场和体-链路耦合下实现近单位时间平均纠缠，且纠缠在例外点附近出现“冻结”现象，这些特性在对应厄米系统中无法实现。；创新点：首次揭示非厄米PT对称性在分布式量子网络中可诱导动态冻结的长距离纠缠，并证明该纠缠在例外点附近具有“冻结”特性，且稳态下仍可保持，为工程化鲁棒纠缠链路提供了新机制。

papers.title: Universal Construction of Generalized Lyapunov Functions for Nonlinear Dynamical Systems Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract: A scalar potential landscape is one of the most useful ways to understand the stability and transition of a dynamical system. For non-gradient dynamics, however, the construction of a global Lyapunov-type scalar for nonlinear flows with recurrent structures remains a major obstacle. We introduce the generalized Lyapunov function, a scalar function that is non-increasing along deterministic trajectories, as a unifying notion of nonequilibrium potential. Ordinary Lyapunov functions, Freidlin--Wentzell quasi-potentials, and Ao-type potentials are recovered as special representatives. We then propose a data-free physics-informed neural-network framework in which the Lyapunov inequality and a weak divergence-scale compatibility condition are directly embedded into the loss function. The method is tested on linear systems, the Hopf normal form, the van der Pol oscillator, and a three-dimensional Hopf-link flow with two linked limit cycles. The learned landscapes agree with available analytical benchmarks and reveal the invariant sets as low-potential or constant-potential structures, providing a practical route to potential-landscape construction for nonlinear non-gradient systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：physics-informed neural networks（物理信息神经网络）、data-free（无数据）、loss function（损失函数）。；研究对象：非线性动力系统的广义李雅普诺夫函数（标量势能景观）的构造方法，适用于非梯度动力学系统，包括线性系统、Hopf 范式、van der Pol 振荡器以及具有两个链接极限环的三维 Hopf-link 流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种广义李雅普诺夫函数，作为非平衡势的统一概念，并利用无数据的物理信息神经网络框架，通过嵌入李雅普诺夫不等式和弱散度-尺度相容性条件，成功构建了非线性非梯度系统的势能景观，揭示了不变集为低势或等势结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种广义李雅普诺夫函数，作为非平衡势的统一概念，并利用无数据的物理信息神经网络框架，通过嵌入李雅普诺夫不等式和弱散度-尺度相容性条件，成功构建了非线性非梯度系统的势能景观，揭示了不变集为低势或等势结构。；创新点：提出广义李雅普诺夫函数作为统一非平衡势概念，并首次利用无数据的物理信息神经网络直接嵌入动力学约束（而非依赖数据）来构造该函数，克服了传统方法在非梯度系统中构造全局李雅普诺夫型标量函数的障碍。
papers.method_zh: 采用无数据的物理信息神经网络（PINNs）框架，将李雅普诺夫不等式和弱散度-尺度相容性条件直接嵌入损失函数，通过训练神经网络来学习广义李雅普诺夫函数。

papers.title: Quantum Entanglement of Bethe States
papers.abstract: We investigate the quantum entanglement of Bethe states across a family of integrable spin chains, including the XXX$_{\frac{1}{2}}$ model, its higher-spin generalizations (XXX$_s$), and the non-compact $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ chain. For on-shell eigenstates, we perform a comprehensive scan of the bipartite entanglement entropy across the entire spectrum of finite chains with periodic boundary conditions, and identify the Bethe solutions that minimize and maximize the entanglement. These extremal solutions follow systematic, spin-dependent patterns in the Bethe quantum numbers. In the XXX$_{\frac{1}{2}}$ spin chain, for the antiferromagnetic chain, the state with minimal entropy always coincides with the lowest-energy state (the ground state) within a given fixed-magnon sector. For the higher-spin XXX$_s$ model, however, the lowest-entropy state is not always identical to the ground state, and can even be the state of highest energy. By contrast, the Bethe roots that maximize entropy exhibit considerably more intricate structure. Our analysis further reveals how special Bethe root configurations, such as singular and strange solutions, affect entanglement, and it uncovers characteristic entanglement features in the non-compact $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ chain that are absent from compact spin chains. For off-shell Bethe states, we develop an optimization algorithm that extremizes the entanglement entropy over rapidity distributions, enabling us to explore the maximum entanglement achievable by a Bethe state without imposing the Bethe ansatz equations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、analysis、develop an optimization algorithm，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：可积自旋链中的Bethe态（Bethe states）的量子纠缠，具体包括XXX₁/₂模型、高自旋推广XXXₛ模型以及非紧致SL(2,ℝ)链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在XXX₁/₂反铁磁链中，给定磁振子数扇区内最小纠缠态总是基态；但在高自旋XXXₛ模型中，最小纠缠态不一定对应基态，甚至可能是最高能态。最大纠缠态的Bethe根结构则更为复杂。此外，非紧致SL(2,ℝ)链展现出紧致自旋链所没有的特征纠缠行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在XXX₁/₂反铁磁链中，给定磁振子数扇区内最小纠缠态总是基态；但在高自旋XXXₛ模型中，最小纠缠态不一定对应基态，甚至可能是最高能态。最大纠缠态的Bethe根结构则更为复杂。此外，非紧致SL(2,ℝ)链展现出紧致自旋链所没有的特征纠缠行为。；创新点：首次系统扫描了可积自旋链全谱中Bethe态的纠缠极值，揭示了自旋依赖的极值模式；发现了奇异解和奇怪解等特殊Bethe根构型对纠缠的影响；并首次在非紧致SL(2,ℝ)链中发现了不同于紧致链的纠缠特征。

papers.title: Extreme-Scale Atomistic Simulation of Real-Temperature Magnetic Skyrmion Dynamics by Coupled Spin-Lattice Modeling
papers.abstract: Real-temperature topological magnetic dynamics in functional materials is governed by coupled lattice and spin evolution, yet remains inaccessible to predictive simulation at device-relevant scales. As a flagship example, thermally driven helix-to-skyrmion transformation in FeGe requires atomistic resolution, explicit lattice motion, and micrometer-scale domains to resolve device-scale topological texture formation. We combine a spin-constrained density-functional-theory-trained neuro-evolution potential with a structure-preserving spin-lattice integrator within one machine-learned framework. Architecture-specific optimizations, kernel fusion, SVE2 vectorization, and NUMA-aware data layout deliver a seven orders-of-magnitude speedup over prior spin-aware methods. Deployed on LineShine exascale supercomputer, the full application scales to 12.45 million CPU cores with 89.7% weak-scaling efficiency, enabling simulations of 1.34 trillion atoms and an equal number of spins while reaching 48.5 PFLOPS in double precision. The simulations directly resolve real-temperature skyrmion nucleation and reorganization at previously inaccessible scales, establishing a new regime for predictive simulation of coupled spin-lattice topological magnetic dynamics.

papers.title: All about quantum error correction: distillation, mitigation, self-correction and beyond
papers.abstract: In this work, it is shown that many quantum error-manipulating techniques, such as distillation, error mitigation, and dynamical decoupling, are special cases of the most general framework for quantum error correction. This unifying perspective is achieved by extending quantum error correction to include state-adaptive and channel-adaptive settings, as well as multi-stage coding scenarios. Based on this insight, a model of self-correcting quantum memory is also proposed. This work clarifies the relationship among these techniques and illustrates, through explicit constructions, how the unified perspective can guide the design of reliable quantum information systems.

papers.title: An integrated ultrahigh vacuum cluster tool for diamond surface science and single nitrogen-vacancy center measurements
papers.abstract: We present a custom-designed ultrahigh vacuum (UHV) cluster tool developed for studying shallow nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond, enabling in situ diamond surface preparation, characterization, and single NV center dynamics measurements within a single connected platform. The system combines a surface science chamber for controlled surface modification and analysis with a cryogenic confocal microscope chamber dedicated to NV spin and optical measurements. This integrated approach enables a direct correlation between diamond surface chemistry and the resulting NV spin and charge properties. The instrument provides a versatile platform for systematic studies of surface-induced decoherence mechanisms and charge dynamics for shallow NV centers, and establishes a pathway toward reproducible surface engineering for quantum sensing applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了一套定制设计的超高真空（UHV）集群工具，并涉及原位表面制备、表征和单NV中心动力学测量，属于实验装置设计与测量工作。；研究对象：金刚石中的浅层氮-空位（NV）中心，具体研究其表面化学与自旋、电荷性质之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，但指出该集成平台能够直接关联金刚石表面化学与NV中心的自旋和电荷性质，为研究表面诱导退相干机制和电荷动力学提供了系统途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，但指出该集成平台能够直接关联金刚石表面化学与NV中心的自旋和电荷性质，为研究表面诱导退相干机制和电荷动力学提供了系统途径。；创新点：该工作的主要新意在于将金刚石表面制备、表征与单NV中心测量集成在同一超高真空平台中，实现了原位、直接关联表面化学与NV量子性质，从而为可重复的表面工程和量子传感应用建立了系统化路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：超高真空（UHV）集群工具，包含表面科学腔室（用于可控表面修饰与分析）和低温共聚焦显微镜腔室（用于NV自旋与光学测量）。具体技术涉及原位表面制备、表征以及单NV中心动力学测量。

papers.title: Mean First Passage Time for Persistent Random Walks in Annular Search Domains
papers.abstract: We study the mean first-passage time of a random walker to a small absorbing target at the center of a two-dimensional annulus with a specularly reflecting outer boundary. The problem is motivated by natural killer cell migration toward a target cancer cell, where the goal is to quantify how long it takes immune cells to reach the target and how search efficiency depends on directional persistence and chemotactic bias. Cell motion is modeled as a velocity-jump process. We first consider a correlated random walk with a von Mises turning kernel, with a concentration parameter controlling directional persistence. We then extend the model to a biased correlated random walk using a phase-shifted turning kernel that represents preferential motion, for example following a concentration gradient. Our analysis combines closed-form benchmarks for simple and biased random walks, Fourier-mode reductions of the transport equations for the correlated and biased correlated models, and a fast-turning perturbation expansion that gives an analytical correction to the diffusion-limit mean first-passage time for the random walker. Our analytical results are supported by numerical methods that include a semi-Lagrangian solver in radial and angular coordinates, a stationary discretisation designed to handle biased transport, and an event-driven Monte Carlo simulator for cross-validation. Together, our results provide a framework relating persistent and biased immune-cell motion to target-search times in confined two-dimensional domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含计算模拟）。判断依据：关键词包括“closed-form benchmarks”、“Fourier-mode reductions”、“perturbation expansion”、“numerical methods”、“Monte Carlo simulator”。；研究对象：二维环形搜索域中具有持续性和趋化性偏置的随机游走（Persistent Random Walks）的平均首次通过时间（Mean First Passage Time, MFPT）。具体物理现象为自然杀伤细胞（NK细胞）向目标癌细胞迁移的搜索效率问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过解析与数值结合的方法，建立了持续性和偏置性免疫细胞运动与二维受限域中目标搜索时间之间的定量关系框架。研究发现，方向持续性和趋化偏置显著影响平均首次通过时间，且快速转向扰动展开给出了扩散极限下的解析修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过解析与数值结合的方法，建立了持续性和偏置性免疫细胞运动与二维受限域中目标搜索时间之间的定量关系框架。研究发现，方向持续性和趋化偏置显著影响平均首次通过时间，且快速转向扰动展开给出了扩散极限下的解析修正。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于：将平均首次通过时间理论从简单扩散模型推广到具有方向持续性和趋化偏置的复杂随机游走模型，并针对环形搜索域（具有镜面反射外边界）给出了系统的解析-数值混合求解框架。
papers.method_zh: 1. 理论建模：将细胞运动建模为速度跳跃过程（velocity-jump process），使用von Mises转向核（描述方向持续性）和相移转向核（描述趋化偏置）。2. 解析方法：对简单随机游走和偏置随机游走给出闭式基准解；对相关和偏置相关模型进行傅里叶模式约化；采用快速转向扰动展开给出扩散极限下的解析修正。3. 数值方法：使用径向和角坐标的半拉格朗日求解器、处理偏置输运的稳态离散化方法，以及事件驱动蒙特卡洛模拟器进行交叉验证。

papers.title: Local correlations in long-range dual-unitary kicked Hamiltonian chains
papers.abstract: Many-body Floquet models with exact space--time symmetry, such as the kicked Ising spin chain (KIC), provide natural examples of systems with dual-unitary dynamics. The requirement of exact space--time symmetry is, however, highly restrictive, as it permits only nearest-neighbor interactions. Based on a pair of Hadamard matrices, we construct a wide family of dual-unitary kicked spin chains with long-range interactions. We show that local two-point correlations in such models propagate along the light-cone edges \( |n| = r|t| \), where \(r\) is the interaction range, and can be derived analytically for operators with local support. This approach is illustrated using the example of a kicked Ising spin chain with next-to-next-neighbor interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct、analytically、derived。；研究对象：具有长程相互作用的双幺正 kicked 自旋链（dual-unitary kicked spin chains），特别是 kicked Ising 自旋链（KIC）的推广体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有长程相互作用的双幺正 kicked 自旋链中，局域两点关联函数沿光锥边界 \(|n| = r|t|\) 传播（其中 \(r\) 为相互作用范围），且对于局域支持的算符可以解析求解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有长程相互作用的双幺正 kicked 自旋链中，局域两点关联函数沿光锥边界 \(|n| = r|t|\) 传播（其中 \(r\) 为相互作用范围），且对于局域支持的算符可以解析求解。；创新点：突破了此前双幺正动力学模型仅允许最近邻相互作用的限制，首次构造并解析求解了具有长程相互作用的双幺正 kicked 自旋链。
papers.method_zh: 基于一对 Hadamard 矩阵构造具有长程相互作用的双幺正 kicked 自旋链族，并通过解析推导分析局域两点关联函数的传播行为。具体示例为具有次近邻相互作用的 kicked Ising 自旋链。

papers.title: Universal Crossovers of Stabilizer Entropy Beyond Criticality
papers.abstract: Stabilizer Rényi entropy has emerged as a probe of nonstabilizerness in quantum many-body systems, but its scaling structure beyond critical points remains poorly understood compared with entanglement entropy. Recent field-theory approaches indicate that stabilizer entropy contains universal critical data and boundary-sensitive terms, raising the question of how these structures extend into massive and crossover regimes. We address this problem for a broad class of finite-range spin chains at Rényi index one-half. We derive exact finite-size formulas for both full periodic chains and finite intervals of the infinite chain, making the universal crossover from critical to noncritical behavior analytically accessible. In periodic geometry, the entropy obeys a volume law away from criticality and exhibits a universal finite-size crossover controlled by the competition between system size and correlation length. We also show that the large-scale SRE density develops a cusp across the field-tuned critical line, while the XX endpoint is governed by a distinct scaling regime associated with the saturation point. In the subsystem geometry, the interval entropy separates bulk critical behavior from boundary contributions generated by the way the finite region cuts the infinite chain. The crossover from critical to massive behavior is then encoded in boundary constants and universal functions controlled by the correlation length. Through exact stabilizer-entropy correspondences, the scaling theory extends to internal XY reductions, Finite-range spin chains, and Cluster--Ising representatives. Our results provide an exact lattice benchmark for the emerging QFT description of stabilizer entropy beyond isolated conformal points.
