papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：注意力机制中复制子电路的涌现是一个一级相变（first-order phase transition），而线性注意力则先经历二级相变（second-order phase transition）再平滑演化为结构化模式（crossover）。该相变由训练数据量驱动，可通过低维序参量空间精确描述。；创新点：首次从第一性原理（first-principles）理论角度解释了注意力机制中复制子电路突然涌现的相变本质，并严格区分了softmax注意力与线性注意力在相变阶数上的根本差异。
papers.method_zh: 贝叶斯理论推导注意力矩阵的后验分布，将其约化到低维序参量空间；结合贝叶斯采样和Adam优化器进行数值验证；对比softmax注意力与线性注意力的相变行为。

papers.title: Searching for cosmic vortices
papers.abstract: Our study focuses on the strong tidal disruption of a cold helium white dwarf passing a black hole. We model the white dwarf as a Bose-Fermi droplet and use quantum hydrodynamic equations to simulate the binary system's evolution. As the white dwarf passes through periastron, it loses a significant amount of mass. This mass falls onto the black hole and forms an accretion disc. Quantized vortices appear in the accretion disc, manifesting as strong electromagnetic radiation signals that exhibit characteristic flickering patterns changing on a timescale of a few seconds. Meanwhile, the white dwarf moves away from the black hole. As the white dwarf moves through space, vortices run along its surface. This elongates its geometry, causing it to rotate and emit gravitational waves.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：模拟、量子流体动力学方程、理论建模）；研究对象：冷氦白矮星被黑洞强潮汐瓦解的过程，以及形成的吸积盘和白矮星表面涡旋现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 白矮星被黑洞潮汐瓦解后，吸积盘中出现量子化涡旋，产生具有特征闪烁模式的强电磁辐射信号；同时白矮星表面涡旋使其几何拉长、旋转并发射引力波。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：白矮星被黑洞潮汐瓦解后，吸积盘中出现量子化涡旋，产生具有特征闪烁模式的强电磁辐射信号；同时白矮星表面涡旋使其几何拉长、旋转并发射引力波。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 将白矮星建模为玻色-费米液滴，使用量子流体动力学方程模拟双星系统的演化。

papers.title: Tensor-Network Algorithm for Many-Body Trace Norms
papers.abstract: Trace norms are fundamental to quantum information theory, yet in many-body systems their evaluation remains a major computational bottleneck, as it generally requires diagonalizing exponentially large operators. Here, we overcome this bottleneck by introducing a controlled tensor-network algorithm for estimating the trace norm of matrix product operators without full diagonalization. The key idea is to combine Zolotarev's rational approximation to the sign function with a variational formulation solved using a density-matrix-renormalization-group-like algorithm. The resulting approximation is systematically improvable, with its accuracy controlled by the rational approximation parameters and the spectral weight near zero. Beyond the reach of exact diagonalization, we demonstrate controlled trace-norm calculations for entanglement negativity, quantum fidelity and quantum Fisher information, achieving substantially improved accuracy over polynomial-based Lanczos approaches. Our results establish trace-norm-based quantities as practical tensor-network observables, opening a route toward tensor-network studies of quantum information in mixed states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：tensor-network algorithm、variational formulation、density-matrix-renormalization-group-like algorithm。；研究对象：多体量子系统中迹范数（trace norms）的计算，具体应用于纠缠负性（entanglement negativity）、量子保真度（quantum fidelity）和量子Fisher信息（quantum Fisher information）等量子信息量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种可控的张量网络算法，能够在无需完全对角化指数级大算符的情况下，高效且系统地估算矩阵乘积算符的迹范数，其精度可通过有理逼近参数和零附近谱权重进行控制，并显著优于基于多项式的Lanczos方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种可控的张量网络算法，能够在无需完全对角化指数级大算符的情况下，高效且系统地估算矩阵乘积算符的迹范数，其精度可通过有理逼近参数和零附近谱权重进行控制，并显著优于基于多项式的Lanczos方法。；创新点：首次将迹范数相关的量子信息量（如纠缠负性、量子Fisher信息）转化为可控的张量网络可观测量，突破了传统方法需要完全对角化指数级大算符的计算瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 结合Zolotarev有理逼近符号函数（Zolotarev's rational approximation to the sign function）与变分公式，采用类似密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）的算法进行求解。

papers.title: Breakdown of the classical rupture theory and earthquake propagation in the "forbidden" super-Rayleigh range
papers.abstract: Earthquakes propagating faster than the shear wave-speed are commonly thought to undergo a super-shear transition upon which they discontinuously jump from the sub-Rayleigh regime to the super-shear one. The super-Rayleigh regime, i.e., the range of propagation speeds between the Rayleigh and shear wave-speeds, is regarded as "forbidden" by the two-dimensional classical rupture theory. Here, we revisit the assumptions underlying the classical theory and develop a rupture theory that takes into account the dependence of the fault strength (frictional resistance) on the slip rate. The theory quantitatively agrees with numerical simulations nearly up to the Rayleigh wave-speed. Yet, very close to the latter, two-dimensional rupture solutions change their character due to frictional rate nonlinearity and rupture continuously propagates through the "forbidden" super-Rayleigh range into the super-shear regime, without a sharp super-shear transition. These results demonstrate that frictional rate dependence, generically observed in experiments, can have profound implications for fast earthquake propagation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词“develop a rupture theory”、“quantitatively agrees with numerical simulations”。；研究对象：地震破裂传播中的“超瑞利范围”（介于瑞利波速与剪切波速之间的传播速度区间），以及该区间内破裂动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典二维破裂理论认为超瑞利范围是“禁止”的，但考虑断层强度（摩擦阻力）对滑移速率的依赖性后，破裂可以连续地穿过该“禁止”范围进入超剪切 regime，而不发生不连续的跃迁。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典二维破裂理论认为超瑞利范围是“禁止”的，但考虑断层强度（摩擦阻力）对滑移速率的依赖性后，破裂可以连续地穿过该“禁止”范围进入超剪切 regime，而不发生不连续的跃迁。；创新点：揭示了摩擦速率的非线性依赖性（实验中普遍观测到）对快速地震传播具有深远影响，推翻了经典理论中关于超瑞利范围不可穿越的结论。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一种考虑断层摩擦阻力对滑移速率依赖性的破裂理论，并通过数值模拟进行定量验证。

papers.title: Range-Aware Bayesian Optimization for Discovering Diverse Designs within Target Property Windows
papers.abstract: In many materials and product design problems, desirable candidates exhibit properties that fall within an acceptable range rather than achieve a single optimum. Recovering multiple, distinct solutions that satisfy such specifications is also practically valuable, as some candidates may be preferred for reasons of cost, processability, or robustness that are difficult to encode directly in an objective function. Here, we develop a range-aware Bayesian optimization (BO) framework in which the acquisition function directly scores the posterior probability that a candidate satisfies a target range. The framework naturally extends to parallel pursuit of multiple distinct specifications over a shared candidate space. Across benchmark tasks, range-aware acquisition consistently recovers larger and more diverse sets of valid designs than standard BO baselines and recent goal-seeking methods. Its utility is further demonstrated in two practically motivated design case studies involving optimizing reaction conditions for polymer synthesis and sequence-defined oligomer discovery for prescribed optical absorption bands, supported by quantum chemical calculations. These results suggest that range-aware BO can provide a practical and sample-efficient foundation for specification-driven design, particularly when design flexibility and solution diversity are important considerations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Bayesian optimization（贝叶斯优化）、acquisition function（采集函数）、quantum chemical calculations（量子化学计算）。；研究对象：材料与产品设计中的候选物（candidates），具体案例包括聚合物合成的反应条件优化以及序列定义低聚物的光学吸收带设计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种“范围感知”贝叶斯优化框架，其采集函数直接评估候选物满足目标属性范围的后验概率，能够比标准贝叶斯优化基线和近期目标追求方法更有效地恢复更大、更多样化的有效设计集合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种“范围感知”贝叶斯优化框架，其采集函数直接评估候选物满足目标属性范围的后验概率，能够比标准贝叶斯优化基线和近期目标追求方法更有效地恢复更大、更多样化的有效设计集合。；创新点：将贝叶斯优化的目标从寻找单一最优值扩展为寻找满足目标属性范围（而非单一极值）的多个不同设计，并直接利用后验概率进行评分，同时支持并行搜索多个不同规格。
papers.method_zh: 采用贝叶斯优化框架，开发了范围感知的采集函数（range-aware acquisition function），用于并行搜索共享候选空间中的多个不同规格目标。在基准任务和两个实际设计案例（聚合物合成反应条件优化、基于量子化学计算的序列定义低聚物光学吸收带发现）中进行了验证。

papers.title: Diffusive Relaxation of Participation Entropy in U(1)-symmetric Dynamics
papers.abstract: Participation entropy (PE) quantifies the spread of a many-body wavefunction across configuration space. While PE relaxes rapidly in generic chaotic systems, we show that $\mathrm{U}(1)$ conservation laws slow it down by imprinting with the slow hydrodynamic modes. Using a cluster expansion around equilibrium, we show that, after local density inhomogeneities decay, the leading PE deficit is dominated by squared connected density correlations. The long time relaxation is therefore controlled by diffusive correlation spreading, giving $ΔS(t)\sim t^{-1/2}$ in the hydrodynamic regime and crossing over to $\sim \exp[-O(t/L^2)]$ when $t\geq L^2$. We confirm this entropy correlation relation using exact computation and infinite system tensor network simulations in various quantum $\mathrm{U}(1)$ conserving circuits. Our results establish PE as a sensitive probe of hydrodynamic memory and suggest that slow relaxation is a generic consequence of conservation laws.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：关键词“cluster expansion”“show that”“confirm using exact computation and infinite system tensor network simulations”。；研究对象：U(1)对称性量子动力学中参与熵（Participation Entropy）的弛豫行为，具体为U(1)守恒量子电路中的多体波函数在构型空间中的扩散弛豫。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: U(1)守恒律通过将参与熵与慢速流体动力学模式耦合，显著减缓其弛豫过程：在流体动力学区域，参与熵的亏损ΔS(t)随时间呈t^{-1/2}衰减，当时间t≥L²时交叉到指数衰减形式~exp[-O(t/L²)]。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：U(1)守恒律通过将参与熵与慢速流体动力学模式耦合，显著减缓其弛豫过程：在流体动力学区域，参与熵的亏损ΔS(t)随时间呈t^{-1/2}衰减，当时间t≥L²时交叉到指数衰减形式~exp[-O(t/L²)]。；创新点：首次揭示参与熵的弛豫受守恒律导致的流体动力学记忆效应控制，建立了参与熵与平方连通密度关联函数之间的定量关系，表明慢弛豫是守恒律的普遍结果。
papers.method_zh: 采用围绕平衡态的团簇展开（cluster expansion）理论分析，结合精确数值计算和无限系统张量网络模拟（infinite system tensor network simulations），在多种U(1)守恒量子电路中验证熵-关联关系。

papers.title: A Cryogenic Uniaxial Strain Cell for Quantum Devices
papers.abstract: Mechanical strain is a powerful resource for tuning quantum systems, but existing piezoelectric strain cells are generally optimized for fragile, high-aspect-ratio single crystals rather than the thick, square-profile chips typical of semiconductor quantum devices. Furthermore, adapting these cells for qubits requires accommodating dense RF and DC wiring while maintaining strict electrical isolation from high-voltage piezo actuators. Here, we present a piezoelectric uniaxial strain cell designed to homogeneously strain thick, square-profile substrates. We introduce a highly symmetric dual-chip loading configuration that effectively suppresses flexural deformation and shear stress. The cell integrates a high-density RF/DC interposer to support standard wire bonding and encloses the actuators in a grounded Faraday cage to prevent unwanted Stark shifts in the device layer. Finite element simulations confirm that combining stiff actuators with this symmetric mounting drastically improves strain homogeneity. Finally, we validate the apparatus experimentally by applying uniaxial strain to a 200 $μ$m thick silicon die. Surface strain measurements demonstrate an applied strain of 215 $με$ for 200 V applied piezo bias.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：present、validate、experimentally、surface strain measurements。；研究对象：用于量子器件的低温单轴应变装置，具体针对厚方形硅芯片（200 μm厚硅片）的均匀应变调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 设计并验证了一种压电单轴应变单元，能够对厚方形基底施加均匀应变，在200 V压电偏压下实现215 με的表面应变，同时抑制弯曲变形和剪切应力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：设计并验证了一种压电单轴应变单元，能够对厚方形基底施加均匀应变，在200 V压电偏压下实现215 με的表面应变，同时抑制弯曲变形和剪切应力。；创新点：针对半导体量子器件常用的厚方形芯片（而非传统脆性高长宽比单晶）设计应变单元；采用对称双芯片加载构型显著抑制弯曲变形和剪切应力；集成高密度RF/DC布线并实现与高压压电致动器的严格电隔离，避免器件层产生不必要的斯塔克位移。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：设计并制造压电单轴应变单元，采用高对称双芯片加载构型，集成高密度RF/DC转接板，将致动器封装在接地法拉第笼中；通过有限元模拟优化应变均匀性；在200 μm厚硅片上施加单轴应变并进行表面应变测量验证。

papers.title: Handbook of Error-Correcting Codes
papers.abstract: Barcode scans, clear phone calls, reliable data storage, satellite communication, and large-scale quantum computation are all made possible by error correction. We present a handbook version of The Error Correction Zoo, a curated reference of methods for protecting classical or quantum information from errors during storage and transmission. The handbook includes descriptions of these error-correcting codes and a classification according to the symbols they use. It also catalogues relations among codes and related objects such as sphere packings, lattices, designs, groups, and classical and quantum phases of matter. The collection is intended both as a rigorous reference and as a practical aid for tracing the web of code relationships and uncovering new connections.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：handbook version, classification, reference, relations among codes）；研究对象：纠错码（error-correcting codes），包括经典纠错码和量子纠错码，以及与之相关的球堆积、格点、设计、群、经典与量子物相等对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 本文以手册形式呈现了“纠错码动物园”（The Error Correction Zoo）的精选参考内容，系统描述了各类纠错码及其分类，并整理了码与码之间、码与相关数学物理对象之间的关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：本文以手册形式呈现了“纠错码动物园”（The Error Correction Zoo）的精选参考内容，系统描述了各类纠错码及其分类，并整理了码与码之间、码与相关数学物理对象之间的关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但本文旨在提供一个兼具严格参考性和实用性的手册，帮助研究者追踪纠错码之间的关系网络并发现新的联系。
papers.method_zh: 文献综述与分类整理，基于已有的“纠错码动物园”数据库进行结构化编纂和关系梳理。

papers.title: Pulse-Duration Scaling of Ultrafast Laser-Induced Damage Threshold in Hybrid Gratings
papers.abstract: High damage threshold gratings are in demand worldwide as critical components for next generation ultrahigh intensity lasers. Here we investigate the pulse-duration dependence of ultrafast laser-induced damage thresholds (LIDT) in hybrid multilayer dielectric gratings, touted to combine superior performance properties of both metallic and multilayer dielectric (MLD) gratings, using a dynamic finite-difference time-domain model incorporated with linear and non-linear absorption models. Simulations agree with reported experimental LIDT values for three representative designs and predict scaling exponents which vary with pulse durations ranging from 10 to 500 fs. The results reveal strong dependence on both material bandgap and grating field distribution, providing guidance for designing high LIDT gratings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：dynamic finite-difference time-domain model incorporated with linear and non-linear absorption models，simulations）；研究对象：混合多层介质光栅（hybrid multilayer dielectric gratings）在超快激光作用下的损伤阈值（LIDT）及其随脉冲宽度的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混合光栅的超快激光诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）随脉冲宽度（10–500 fs）的标度指数会发生变化，且该标度行为强烈依赖于材料带隙和光栅内部的电场分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混合光栅的超快激光诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）随脉冲宽度（10–500 fs）的标度指数会发生变化，且该标度行为强烈依赖于材料带隙和光栅内部的电场分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用动态时域有限差分（FDTD）方法，并结合线性和非线性吸收模型进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Mean-field limits for stochastic particle systems on dense graphs
papers.abstract: We study stochastic interacting particle systems whose interaction structure is described by dense weighted directed graphs converging to a graphon. In the thermodynamic limit, we prove a law of large numbers for the empirical measure process and derive a deterministic nonlinear master equation describing the macroscopic evolution. The limiting equation retains the heterogeneous interaction structure of the microscopic system through the limiting graphon, allowing for spatially non-homogeneous behaviors such as localized or community-type interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：stochastic interacting particle systems（随机相互作用粒子系统）、law of large numbers（大数定律）、nonlinear master equation（非线性主方程）。；研究对象：随机相互作用粒子系统，其相互作用结构由稠密加权有向图描述，并收敛于图论（graphon）。该体系允许空间非均匀行为，如局域化或社区型相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在热力学极限下，证明了经验测度过程的大数定律，并推导出描述宏观演化的确定性非线性主方程，该方程通过极限图论保留了微观系统的异质相互作用结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在热力学极限下，证明了经验测度过程的大数定律，并推导出描述宏观演化的确定性非线性主方程，该方程通过极限图论保留了微观系统的异质相互作用结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机相互作用粒子系统的平均场极限理论，通过图论（graphon）描述稠密加权有向图的极限结构，并利用大数定律推导宏观演化方程。

papers.title: Color-Rule-Function Encoding for Combinatorial Memory
papers.abstract: Combinatorial memory is a class of memory in which information is encoded in the set of paths through a structured mesh. In this work, we introduce a systematic encoding framework, referred to as the Color-Rule-Function (CRF) approach, for representing information in combinatorial memory. The method consists of four key steps: selecting a sequence of paths in the mesh, assigning values (e.g., colors) to each cell, defining a set of rules based on the values encountered along each path, and constructing a Boolean function that determines the state of each path. . The coding procedure is illustrated by several examples. The design space scales of the CRF scale fundamentally faster compared to conventional memory. This apparent advantage arises from the use of rule-based and functional representations but is accompanied by increased hardware complexity. A possible hardware realization of the CRF framework is discussed. Importantly, the hardware overhead can be substantially reduced through the use of customized modules. The examples of the customized design are described in the text. The combination of CRF coding with customized module design may lead to a practical advantage in data storage density. According to the estimates, the data storage density may exceed Exabit per centimeter squared. A key problem that requires further investigation is related to the minimum Hamming distance between an arbitrary target bit sequence and the closest sequence realizable within the CRF framework under fixed hardware constraints.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：encoding framework, Boolean function, design space scaling, estimates）；研究对象：组合存储器（combinatorial memory），一种通过结构化网格中的路径集合编码信息的存储体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出颜色-规则-函数（CRF）编码框架，其设计空间扩展速度远超传统存储器，理论存储密度可超过每平方厘米艾字节（Exabit/cm²）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出颜色-规则-函数（CRF）编码框架，其设计空间扩展速度远超传统存储器，理论存储密度可超过每平方厘米艾字节（Exabit/cm²）。；创新点：首次提出基于规则和函数表示的CRF系统编码方法，替代传统直接路径编码，实现设计空间超快扩展；指出最小汉明距离问题（在固定硬件约束下，任意目标比特序列与CRF可实现最近序列之间的距离）是需进一步研究的关键问题。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建：通过路径选择、单元赋值（颜色）、基于路径值的规则定义、布尔函数状态判定四步实现编码；结合定制化模块设计降低硬件复杂度，并给出硬件实现讨论与存储密度估算。

papers.title: Observable signatures of exceptional points from left-right eigenstate distinction
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian quantum systems exhibit qualitatively distinct physical behavior compared to Hermitian systems, a prime example being spectral singularities known as exceptional points. Their relevance in, e.g., quantum sensing, unidirectional transport, and robust lasing makes it important to be able to identify exceptional points through observable features of a many-body system. Here, using as an example a one-dimensional complex XY spin chain realizing both rotation-time RT- and parity-time PT-symmetric regimes, we develop a framework for detecting exceptional points based on the distinction between left and right eigenvectors of the Hamiltonian, which in a non-Hermitian system are no longer the adjoint of each other. We first show that a global measure constructed from the difference between the Hamiltonian and its adjoint locates exceptional points via distinct non-analytic behavior. At the level of observables, differences in local spin correlations evaluated on the right and left eigenstates provide a reliable static detection scheme. In contrast, static bipartite entanglement measures fail to capture this distinction, urging us to study the quantum dynamics of the model. Following a sudden quench, we demonstrate that the time-averaged right-left entanglement entropy difference directly encodes signatures of the exceptional point. In the RT-symmetric regime, it exhibits a pronounced peak at the exceptional point, whereas in the PT-symmetric regime it behaves as an order-parameter-like quantity, remaining finite in one phase and vanishing at the transition. Our results establish a direct link between the structure of non-Hermitian eigenstates and observable signatures of exceptional points, providing a practical route to identify them in existing quantum simulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a framework、demonstrate、study the quantum dynamics。；研究对象：非厄米量子系统中的奇异点（exceptional points），具体以实现RT对称和PT对称的一维复XY自旋链为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于非厄米哈密顿量左右本征矢的差异，构建了可观测的静态和动态信号（如局域自旋关联差异、时间平均左右纠缠熵差），用于可靠地定位奇异点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于非厄米哈密顿量左右本征矢的差异，构建了可观测的静态和动态信号（如局域自旋关联差异、时间平均左右纠缠熵差），用于可靠地定位奇异点。；创新点：建立了非厄米本征态结构与奇异点可观测特征之间的直接联系，并指出静态二分体纠缠度量无法捕捉左右本征态差异，从而提出动态方案作为替代。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：利用非厄米哈密顿量与其伴随算符的差异构造全局度量，通过非解析行为定位奇异点；在可观测层面，计算左右本征态上的局域自旋关联差异（静态方案）以及突然淬火后的时间平均左右纠缠熵差（动态方案）。

papers.title: Learning from almost nothing: How neural networks survive heavy input corruption
papers.abstract: Learning from imperfect data is a central theme in machine learning, connecting practical questions of robustness to fundamental questions of learnability. Here we examine attribute noise: learning from corrupted inputs while keeping the labels intact, a setting that has received considerably less analytical attention than its label-noise counterpart. We consider two types of corruption models: additive noise and replacement noise. Through experiments with multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) on corrupted classification datasets, we find that neural networks remain robust, maintaining well-above-chance accuracy even when inputs are >90% corrupted -- far beyond human recognition. To understand this robustness, we analyze infinite-width networks in the heavy-corruption regime using a mean-field-inspired approach and derive a leading-order decision rule for the classification outcome: the network implements a prototype rule, the nearest-class-mean, assigning each test point to the class whose training-set average it most closely resembles. This leading-order decision rule is universal across a broad range of MLP architectures, holding for any depth, as well as a wide class of activation functions and noise distributions. The same centroid mechanism closely matches finite-width network behavior in our experiments and provides an interpretable and analytically tractable account of why learning can succeed even when individual training examples carry almost no signal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验验证）。判断依据关键词：mean-field-inspired approach、derive a leading-order decision rule、experiments with multi-layer perceptrons。；研究对象：神经网络在输入数据被严重破坏（属性噪声）时的学习行为，具体研究加性噪声和替换噪声两种损坏模型下的分类任务。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使输入数据被破坏超过90%（远超人类识别能力），神经网络仍能保持远高于随机猜测的分类准确率；在无限宽度极限下，网络实现了一个原型规则（最近类均值规则），即测试点被分类到其训练集平均最相似的类别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使输入数据被破坏超过90%（远超人类识别能力），神经网络仍能保持远高于随机猜测的分类准确率；在无限宽度极限下，网络实现了一个原型规则（最近类均值规则），即测试点被分类到其训练集平均最相似的类别。；创新点：首次从理论上严格推导出神经网络在重度输入损坏下的通用决策规则（最近类均值规则），并证明该规则对多种MLP架构、深度、激活函数和噪声分布均成立，为“从几乎无信息的数据中学习”提供了可解析解释的机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用多层感知机（MLP）在损坏的分类数据集上进行实验；使用平均场理论方法分析无限宽度网络在重度损坏下的行为，推导出分类结果的领头阶决策规则。

papers.title: Lectures on Semiclassical Methods for Composite Operators
papers.abstract: These lecture notes are intended as a coherent introduction to conformal field theory in general, and composite operators in particular, through a semiclassical framework for computing scaling dimensions, with emphasis on operators of the form $φ^n$. In doing so, they aim to fill a gap in the literature and to help decode some of the relevant concepts. The physical idea is that at large $n$ an (heavy) operator creates a highly occupied state. Through the state-operator correspondence, this state lives on the cylinder $\mathbb{R}\times S^{d-1}$, and its scaling dimension is the corresponding energy of the theory on the cylinder. The notes are organized as a self-contained route from conformal symmetry to semiclassical dynamics. Part I reviews the conformal group, primary operators, radial quantization, the state-operator correspondence, and operator mixing. Part II builds the semiclassical framework, first in the free scalar theory, where the dimension of $φ^n$ is recovered in three independent ways, and then through the double-scaling limit, the action variable, and Bohr-Sommerfeld quantization. Part III develops the general machinery of periodic saddles, Floquet theory, fluctuation determinants, the Gel'fand-Yaglom method, and the Gutzwiller trace formula. Part IV applies the framework to the $O(N)$ $φ^4$ theory in $d=4-ε$ at the Wilson-Fisher fixed point, deriving the classical elliptic solution, the Lamé fluctuation spectrum, the zero modes, and the one-loop contribution to the large-$n$ scaling dimensions. Beyond the explicit computation, the notes emphasize the role of composite operators as probes of collective sectors of quantum field theory, with extensions to gauge theories, conformal windows, and asymptotically safe field theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：lecture notes、semiclassical framework、conformal field theory、scaling dimensions、state-operator correspondence。；研究对象：共形场论中的复合算符，特别是形如φ^n的算符，以及它们在圆柱时空上的半经典动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过半经典框架，利用态-算符对应，将大n（重）算符的标度维数计算转化为圆柱上理论能量的计算，并系统展示了如何通过周期鞍点、Floquet理论、Gel'fand-Yaglom方法等工具计算大n标度维数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过半经典框架，利用态-算符对应，将大n（重）算符的标度维数计算转化为圆柱上理论能量的计算，并系统展示了如何通过周期鞍点、Floquet理论、Gel'fand-Yaglom方法等工具计算大n标度维数。；创新点：填补了文献中缺乏的、从半经典视角系统介绍复合算符标度维数计算的空白，强调复合算符作为量子场论集体扇区探针的作用，并提及向规范理论、共形窗口及渐近安全场论的推广。
papers.method_zh: 半经典方法（Bohr-Sommerfeld量子化、作用量变量）、共形场论（态-算符对应、径向量子化）、微扰论（双标度极限）、泛函积分（涨落行列式、Gutzwiller迹公式）、具体应用：O(N) φ^4理论在d=4-ε维Wilson-Fisher不动点处的椭圆经典解、Lamé涨落谱、零模及单圈修正。

papers.title: Exact Entanglement Dynamics Beyond Nearest-Neighbor Dual-Unitary Floquet Systems
papers.abstract: Exact results using dual-unitarity largely rely on nearest-neighbor structures, while finite-range interactions typically lead to complications. Going beyond the usual nearest-neighbor setting, we introduce an analytically tractable family of finite-range kicked Ising models that admit exact closed-form entanglement dynamics. The construction is based on a staggered structure in which dual-unitarity is present on sublattices that are then coupled to each other. The central observation is that these inter-sublattice couplings do not obstruct the dual-unitarity of the resulting model. For the minimal interaction range of $r= 2$, we derive exact expressions for all the $n-$Rényi entanglement entropies at all times and show that the result is the sum of the two coupled sublattice contributions. Our framework extends naturally to larger finite interaction ranges and to systems with heterogeneous local Hilbert spaces, without additional assumptions. It thus provides a controlled setting for studying exact entanglement growth beyond strictly nearest-neighbor dual-unitary models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically tractable、exact closed-form entanglement dynamics、dual-unitarity。；研究对象：超越最近邻相互作用的双幺正Floquet系统，具体为有限程（finite-range）的 kicked Ising 模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入交错结构（staggered structure），构造了一类有限程 kicked Ising 模型，其中子晶格上的双幺正性不受子晶格间耦合的阻碍，从而实现了对所有 n-Rényi 纠缠熵的精确封闭形式求解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入交错结构（staggered structure），构造了一类有限程 kicked Ising 模型，其中子晶格上的双幺正性不受子晶格间耦合的阻碍，从而实现了对所有 n-Rényi 纠缠熵的精确封闭形式求解。；创新点：突破了以往双幺正方法严格局限于最近邻相互作用的限制，首次在有限程相互作用（r≥2）的 kicked Ising 模型中实现了纠缠动力学的精确解析求解。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：基于交错子晶格的双幺正性构造，推导了最小相互作用程 r=2 时所有 n-Rényi 纠缠熵的精确表达式，并自然推广至更大相互作用程及异质局域希尔伯特空间。

papers.title: Stabilizing Role of Uninformed Participants in Collective Decision Making
papers.abstract: For groups without strict hierarchy, collective decisions often emerge through compromise. We develop a second-order network model of collective decision-making using a dissipative Hamiltonian formulation, in which informed agents introduce preferred directions while uninformed participants contribute only direction-free dissipation. We show that under low conflict, the model admits a locally unique, exponentially stable compromise state. Using a structured modular network we further show that as conflict increases the local compromise branch terminates through a saddle-node fold rather than through a smooth mean-field symmetry-breaking transition. Modular polarized states persist on branches that are locally separated from the compromise branch. Direction-free dissipation does not shift the static structural threshold, but it delays escape from the saddle-node ghost and pushes the observable onset of polarization to larger conflicts. Our work identifies a dissipation-mediated mechanism, complementary to connectivity-based accounts, through which uninformed participants stabilize collective behavior in biological and engineered swarms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“develop a second-order network model”、“dissipative Hamiltonian formulation”等理论建模和数学分析的关键词。；研究对象：集体决策中的群体行为，具体研究在无严格等级制度的群体（如生物群体或工程集群）中，知情个体（引入偏好方向）与不知情个体（仅提供无方向耗散）如何共同影响集体决策的稳定性与极化转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现不知情参与者（无方向耗散）不会改变系统发生极化的静态结构阈值，但会通过延迟系统逃离“鞍-结幽灵”区域，将极化现象的可观测起始点推向更大的冲突强度，从而起到稳定集体行为的作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现不知情参与者（无方向耗散）不会改变系统发生极化的静态结构阈值，但会通过延迟系统逃离“鞍-结幽灵”区域，将极化现象的可观测起始点推向更大的冲突强度，从而起到稳定集体行为的作用。；创新点：提出了一种与基于连通性的解释互补的、由耗散介导的稳定机制，揭示了不知情参与者（方向自由耗散）在集体决策中独特的动力学稳定作用，而非仅仅改变静态网络结构。
papers.method_zh: 采用耗散哈密顿量形式，构建了一个二阶网络模型。通过理论分析（证明局部指数稳定）和结构化模块网络上的数值模拟（揭示鞍-结分岔）进行研究。

papers.title: APTLAS: An Indexed APT Literature Repository
papers.abstract: Atom probe tomography (APT) literature is broad, rapidly growing, and dispersed across a wide range of journals, which can make it difficult to identify prior work on a given material system, instrument, or analytical approach. Conventional search engines (e.g., Google Scholar) excel at general retrieval but do not preserve the domain-specific metadata that often determines the relevance of an APT publication (e.g., analysis mode, laser wavelength, or instrument configuration). Herein, APTLAS is presented, which is an indexed repository of published APT literature. At present, the database contains ~2,300 records, each accompanied by metadata extracted from the source publication. The accompanying web tool, available at https://aptlas.bavleyguerguis.com/, allows users to browse and filter by material system, instrument, application, publication type, or keyword search.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：非实验/计算/理论文章，属于数据库与文献工具开发。判断依据：摘要描述的是“indexed repository”（索引数据库）和“web tool”（网络工具），而非物理实验或理论计算。；研究对象：原子探针层析技术（Atom Probe Tomography, APT）领域的文献资源。具体涉及材料体系、仪器、分析方法的文献元数据。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明物理结论。核心贡献是构建了一个包含约2300条记录的APT文献索引数据库，并提供了可按材料体系、仪器、应用、出版类型或关键词筛选的网页工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明物理结论。核心贡献是构建了一个包含约2300条记录的APT文献索引数据库，并提供了可按材料体系、仪器、应用、出版类型或关键词筛选的网页工具。；创新点：相对于通用搜索引擎（如Google Scholar），该数据库保留了APT领域特定的元数据（如分析模式、激光波长、仪器配置），从而支持更精准的领域内文献筛选。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 文献元数据提取与数据库构建。具体手段：从已发表的APT出版物中提取元数据（如分析模式、激光波长、仪器配置等），并建立可检索的索引数据库。

papers.title: Physically Constrained Ensemble Gaussian Process Modelling for Expensive Quantum Systems with Heteroskedastic Noise
papers.abstract: Accurate modeling of quantum many-body systems often requires computationally expensive simulations such as Density Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG) or Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) calculations. These methods, while precise, impose significant time and resource constraints, limiting their use in exhaustive parameter exploration. Moreover, these expensive simulations can contain variable errors over the large unknown parameter space, which needs to be quantified and propagated. Thus, predictive modelling is required to estimate the functional space accurately over scarcely sampled data with heteroskedastic noise, while preserving the physical relevance of the estimation. Therefore, we present a Physically Constrained Ensemble Gaussian Process (pc-EGP) framework designed to efficiently model complex and noisy quantum systems under physical consistency constraints. The proposed method first enforces physical constraints as a user controlled weighted penalty to the data-driven loss function of the Gaussian Process (GP) surrogates. Then an ensemble of such GP models is trained with variable noisy simulations via numerical quadrature method where these multiple GP(s) at different nodes is integrated as a quadrature weighted average. We first demonstrate the framework on synthetically generated data before applying to quantum systems. In the first case study, we leverage DMRG simulations of the Bose-Hubbard Model to predict the critical interaction parameter Uc governing the superfluid-to-Mott-insulator transition. In the second case study, we demonstrate our method on QMC simulations, of a quantum liquid confined inside a nanoporous silicate with the goal of optimizing a chemical environment to realize a one-dimensional superfluid. Compared to conventional GP, pc-EGP achieves a better balance of accuracy and physically meaningful predictions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论混合类型。判断依据：关键词包括“Density Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG)”、“Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC)”、“Gaussian Process (GP)”、“predictive modelling”。；研究对象：量子多体系统，具体包括：Bose-Hubbard模型中的超流-莫特绝缘体相变（临界相互作用参数Uc），以及纳米多孔硅酸盐中受限量子液体的化学环境优化（以实现一维超流）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种物理约束集成高斯过程（pc-EGP）框架，相比传统高斯过程，能在异方差噪声下更准确地建模昂贵量子模拟数据，并保持预测的物理合理性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种物理约束集成高斯过程（pc-EGP）框架，相比传统高斯过程，能在异方差噪声下更准确地建模昂贵量子模拟数据，并保持预测的物理合理性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 物理约束集成高斯过程（pc-EGP）框架。具体包括：1）将物理约束作为加权惩罚项加入高斯过程代理模型的损失函数；2）通过数值求积方法训练多个高斯过程模型，并对其输出进行求积加权平均。案例中使用了DMRG和QMC模拟数据。

papers.title: Collective Emission in LH2 Assembly Beyond the Point-Dipole Approximation
papers.abstract: Collective emission in light-harvesting assemblies is governed by the local transition dipole and finite geometry of emitting units, a fact that point-dipole approximation obscures. To go beyond this picture, we develop a non-Hermitian Hamiltonian using the quantum electrodynamic dyadic Green's tensor for a purple bacteria. We construct it for the isolated 24-bacteriochlorophyll conical frustum and its P42$_1$2 crystallographic assembly. The P42$_1$2 unit-cell symmetry is found to invert the bright-dark ordering of the single ring, placing subradiant states at the low-energy end and revealing the entire crystal to be the energy-harvesting entity. Tilt-driven switching is activated only in crystal geometries where the finite dipole-carrier (LH2) lies perpendicular to the growth plane. Vacancy and orientational disorder work only in cooperation to renormalize the switching threshold from higher polar angles to lower values.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：non-Hermitian Hamiltonian、quantum electrodynamic dyadic Green's tensor、理论建模。；研究对象：紫色细菌中LH2（捕光复合体2）组装体的集体发射现象，具体为24个细菌叶绿素分子构成的锥形环状结构及其P42₁2晶体组装。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: P42₁2晶胞对称性反转了单个环的亮-暗态顺序，使亚辐射态位于低能端，揭示整个晶体才是能量收集实体；倾斜驱动的开关效应仅在有限偶极载体（LH2）垂直于生长平面的晶体几何中被激活。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：P42₁2晶胞对称性反转了单个环的亮-暗态顺序，使亚辐射态位于低能端，揭示整个晶体才是能量收集实体；倾斜驱动的开关效应仅在有限偶极载体（LH2）垂直于生长平面的晶体几何中被激活。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于量子电动力学并矢格林张量构建非厄米哈密顿量，用于描述孤立LH2锥形环及其P42₁2晶体组装中的集体发射，超越了点偶极近似。

papers.title: Scaling law of asymptotic freedom in collective charging of quantum batteries
papers.abstract: We establish a universal scaling law for collective charging of quantum batteries, independent of microscopic details. We prove that the ergotropy-to-energy ratio approaches unity at least as fast as $\sim N^{-1}$ with the number of batteries $N$, implying generic asymptotic freedom. We further show how the universal $1/N$ scaling can be overcome: when the battery state becomes asymptotically pure, the convergence can be substantially faster, including $\sim N^{-b}$ with $b>1$ and even exponential scaling in $N^2$. Rigorous finite-$N$ upper and lower bounds on the ergotropy-to-energy ratio are further derived, providing nonasymptotic guarantees for the universal $1/N$ scaling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：establish a universal scaling law, prove, derive rigorous bounds。；研究对象：量子电池（quantum batteries）的集体充电过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子电池集体充电时，ergotropy（可提取功）与能量之比随电池数量N增加至少以~N⁻¹的标度律趋近于1，即存在普遍的渐近自由；当电池态趋于纯态时，收敛速度可显著加快，甚至达到N²的指数标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子电池集体充电时，ergotropy（可提取功）与能量之比随电池数量N增加至少以~N⁻¹的标度律趋近于1，即存在普遍的渐近自由；当电池态趋于纯态时，收敛速度可显著加快，甚至达到N²的指数标度。；创新点：揭示了集体充电中渐近自由的普适标度律（1/N），并指出通过制备渐近纯态可突破该标度，获得更快的收敛速度。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：建立普适标度律，证明ergotropy-to-energy比值的渐近行为，并推导有限N的严格上下界。

papers.title: Negative heat capacities in spherically symmetric sectors of $d$-matrix quantum mechanics
papers.abstract: We consider the $SO(d)$ and $O(d)$ invariant sectors of the bosonic $d$-matrix harmonic oscillator with $U(N)$ gauge symmetry. The micro-canonical degeneracy $\mathcal{Z}( N , d , k )$ for fixed energy $k$ is expressed as a pairing between an $N$-dependent vector and a $d$-dependent vector in the space of partitions of the integer $k$. This pairing formula is derived by counting invariant words in multi-matrix variables $X^i_{j,a}$, using properties of Clebsch-Gordan multiplicities (Kronecker coefficients) for the symmetric group $S_k$, Schur-Weyl duality and harmonic analysis on the homogeneous space $U(d)/SO(d)$. Analytic formulae for large $N$ and $k$ with $ k \le N $ are obtained using group integrals over $U(N)$ and $SO(d)$ (or $ O(d)$). The micro-canonical heat capacity in this regime is negative and turns positive, at a critical value $k_{\rm crit}$, due to finite $N$ modifications to the counting, thus forming what we denote as a characteristic caloric fold in the $ E $ versus $T$ curve. Data from the pairing formula is well fitted by $k_{\rm crit} \sim { N^2 \over 4 }$ for small values of $d$. A derivation of this large $N$ formula is given using a matrix model approximation and semi-classical analysis of the eigenvalue density. The large $N,d$ limit of the degeneracies reveals a key role for ribbon graph combinatorics. The caloric fold is also notably a property of black hole thermodynamics in anti-de-Sitter spaces. We propose the spherically symmetric \(SO(d)\) and \(O(d)\) invariant sectors of \(d\)-matrix quantum mechanics as tractable matrix systems for capturing key features of dual descriptions of black-hole thermodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：微正则简并度、配对公式、群积分、半经典分析、矩阵模型近似。；研究对象：具有U(N)规范对称性的玻色型d-矩阵谐振子，具体研究其SO(d)和O(d)不变扇区中的负热容现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在k ≤ N的大N和k区域，微正则热容为负，并在临界值k_crit处转变为正，形成E-T曲线上的“热容折叠”。该折叠是反德西特空间中黑洞热力学的一个特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在k ≤ N的大N和k区域，微正则热容为负，并在临界值k_crit处转变为正，形成E-T曲线上的“热容折叠”。该折叠是反德西特空间中黑洞热力学的一个特征。；创新点：将d-矩阵量子力学中球对称扇区的负热容与反德西特空间中黑洞热力学的“热容折叠”特征联系起来，提出该体系可作为捕捉黑洞热力学对偶描述关键特征的可解矩阵系统。
papers.method_zh: 通过计数多矩阵变量中的不变词，利用对称群S_k的Clebsch-Gordan重数（Kronecker系数）、Schur-Weyl对偶性以及齐次空间U(d)/SO(d)上的调和分析，推导出固定能量k下的微正则简并度Z(N,d,k)的配对公式。在大N和k区域，使用U(N)和SO(d)（或O(d)）上的群积分获得解析公式，并通过矩阵模型近似和本征值密度的半经典分析推导k_crit ~ N²/4。
